name: Abiding Savior Lutheran Church
reviewSummary: A traditional Lutheran congregation in Lake Forest offering a reverent worship experience with a strong sense of community.

name: Aliso Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: Pastor Mike Fabarez is one of the most faithful expository teachers. The sermons are extremely detailed. Excellent church focusing on direct Bible teaching. Friendly community and robust children ministries.

name: Alive Church
reviewSummary: Very personal, welcoming community church. Great worship music and practical teaching.

name: Alive Church - Gainesville Campus - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary:
Alive Church is awesome! They teach you how to have a personal relationship with Jesus. We do life together! My first time visiting and I love it felt the holy spirt
Moving in this church love to go back 90 day Tithe challenge😭😭😭Alive Church is less about God and far more about MONEY. Every single service, they pushed for contributions, justifying it with lines like, “Don’t you want air conditioning and a clean facility?” Meanwhile, the bathrooms gleamed with marble and luxury fixtures, and the pastors clearly lived well off the congregation’s giving. They also blurred biblical order by placing women in the role of pastor, when Scripture calls for men to be Christ-like leaders. On top of that, they made it feel very much like a “black church,” emphasizing who truly belonged and who didn’t. And when Memorial Day came, they couldn’t even honor fallen soldiers—but on Mother’s Day, they went out of their way to exalt mothers. The whole thing reeked of the very hypocrisy Jesus condemned: using God to enrich themselves, create power, and divide His people. I've been coming to the church since the end of January of this year.  It's a great atmosphere and they lead with the word of God. I was initially intrigued because the lead pastor(s) were young adults. I've only heard pastor Aaron Chapman speak a couple of times since I've been there but it was awesome.  I'm sadden that he is leaving this campus. I'm also grateful for the new leading pastor(s). God bless everyone! It is a wonderful church it very laid back the music is awesome

name: All Saints Catholic Parish
reviewSummary: A traditional Catholic parish in North Dallas offering reverent liturgical worship and strong parish community.

name: Anchor Faith Church - St. Augustine Campus
reviewSummary:
First, I just want to say I am EXTREMELY disappointed. I am a ministry leader with 2 Christian non-profits and I was looking forward to experience this church that was well reviewed. Here is my full experience. This church does not sit in scripture. They talked for 20 minutes about pressuring people to give and said that (this is an exact quote) "You may unlock the promises of God by giving $100." They also wanted to raise thousands of dollars for "church cars" and $13,000 for a bus for one of their missions trips. They are not stewarding their finances well from an outside perspective, so I would recommend being careful with donating. The worship was an hour and only 4 songs, meaning they sang each one for about 15-20 minutes. The pastor preaches more that THEY (Christians) are holy rather than Jesus. He preaches on a spirit of feelings and not an overflow of the Lord or scripture. He gave many personal stories and read a total of 2 (singular) verses through the entire hour long sermon. In fact, the pastor did not even have a Bible when he was preaching. He talks about how we perform miracles and we are strong because we are Christian. He may have been trying to say that we do that through Christ, but he did not mention that a single time. They talked about the Kingdom of God quite a bit which was their only saving grace. God is talked about and they preach with emotional conviction, but the spiritual strength was not there. Again I need to emphasize, the pastor read TWO VERSES. IN THE ENTIRE SERMON. I don't even know if I can call it a sermon. He told 3 personal stories of his life and talked, but BARELY mentioned scripture. I do not want to put a bad review on a church, but people need to know. I pray for them and I hope that they dwell more in scripture and go back to the basics of raw faith. The inside looked very much like a Church. The outside looked similar to the rest of the Mall, where it's located. They were very friendly & helpful. The Church entrance was not very well marked. Enjoyed our visit even though it was to attend a good friend's fineral. A Powerful, Life-Giving Church – Anchor Faith is Home!

Anchor Faith Church is more than just a place of worship—it’s a family. From the moment you walk in, you feel welcomed, seen, and loved. The atmosphere is full of faith, passion, and purpose, and you can tell right away that God is moving in this place.

The teaching is always powerful, Bible-based, and delivered with clarity and conviction. Every message challenges you to grow, walk in your purpose, and live out your faith boldly. The worship team is incredible too—spirit-filled and genuinely uplifting.

What truly sets Anchor Faith apart is the heart of the people. The leadership is strong, sincere, and fully invested in building up the church and the local community. Whether it’s through outreach, youth ministry, or small groups, they are committed to making a real impact.

If you’re looking for a church that will strengthen your walk with Christ, connect you with others, and empower you to live out Kingdom purpose—Anchor Faith Church is it. 5 stars all the way! If you are looking for a church that lives how the Bible says we are to live, this is the place. The Word of God is preached, and applied by this family of believers. They are actively involved with the community as well. My wife and I have attended Anchor Faith Church for a few years-certainly long enough to know the Pastors, leadership and staff. While I didn’t know the name or place at the time, this is the church I  prayed for many years to find. It is Scripturally founded and Holy Spirit led. The people and Pastors exude Agape love. From infants to the aged, we are all surrounded by effective, heartfelt care. I love this place. This is my home and these are my people. I simply couldn’t imagine recommending any place of worship more highly than Anchor Faith Church.

name: Anthem Community Church - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary: Happy to call Anthem home! Anthem Church has been such a blessing in my life! Their practical and engaging teaching has not only deepened my understanding of the Bible but also equipped me to apply its lessons in my everyday life. What really sets them apart is their genuine commitment to serving the community—both in action and financial support. Their dedication to funding and partnering with local nonprofits is truly inspiring. Attending Anthem has not only strengthened my faith but also motivated me to grow personally and serve others with purpose. I’m so grateful to be a part of this amazing church family! This is a non pretentious, easy to attend church that provides great music, a great message, and great child care. They are a community, pulling people together in the name of Christ. It just feels good to go. They welcome believers and non believers alike, and allow people to find their path without being pushed. They are non judgmental- it’s a place where you can be yourself. I love it here. Affiliate of North Point Community Church in Atlanta. We went to Woodstock City in metro Atlanta and moved down here and found Anthem. While I always loved the messaging while at Woodstock City, Anthem provides a smaller, more intimate church experience with the same great message we are accustomed to. Our children LOVE their kids' programs, Wambaland and Upstreet. They have fantastic programs for older children (middle and high school aged). If you want your children to develop a meaningful relationship with God, they do an amazing job of facilitating that and make everyone feel loved, welcome, and part of the Anthem family. Always inviting and a moving experience. Always leave feeling blessed and refreshed. I love when my kids run up to me excited to tell me what they learned or when they have a new Bible verse they memorized. God has really blessed my family and I through the leaders at this church.

name: Awaken Church - Port Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
Hands down the best church around. You're welcomed from the second you walk in, on any day at any time. There is never a person "not in the mood" to give you the longer explanation, or help you. There is never a time where you feel uncomfortable, and if you do, someone is around eventually to offer a helping hand or direction.
From trying to figure out who God is to learning what a village actually is.. this is the best church to be apart of.
Thank you guys for always being there for us and helping me to know God, and my babies too. We love you, see you soon. 🦋 I have watched a few sermons online and they are great! This is a great church forsure! I'm currently a member of the volunteer team at new day christian church so I haven't been able to be there in person yet , But I hope and pray that soon I will be able to because I would love to meet these wonderful people! I noticed that they want everyone to get to know each other and love each other! That is what we need I'm so happy to see them push that message! Praise the Lord in Jesus name! Been going here for years Pastor Brian and his amazing wife Pastor Jacqueline are wonderful loving people who have a strong 💪 group behind them i encourage anyone to check this Church out it's not your normal service like you had when you were a kid Pastor Brian takes the scripture and breaks it down into real life scenarios to make you understand and appreciate the word in a whole different way We felt that the lord led us to Awaken; and we are glad he did! This is a house of the lord on Sundays and a school the rest of the week. Yet we saw the Bible leading its ministry, and felt Gods hands and feet in the church and community right away. Pastor Brian and his congregation made our family feel welcomed and encouraged us to get into a connection program. So we could become involved with what Gods people are doing in the church and community. Grace is preached, and his spirit is felt from the moment we arrived, happy to be apart of this growing body of Christ! We love our church!!  The community feel and most importantly the presence of God we feel
In every service!!

name: Awaken City Church - St. Augustine Campus
reviewSummary: We were camping in St.Augustine for the month. My wife picked this church to attend. We found it very welcoming, worship music was top notch, teaching was everything a Christian needs to hear. Sadly this is our last Sunday to attend, going home on Wednesday. Love to all those in attendance. From our first Sunday two years ago, we felt welcomed upon entering the service from start to finish. The pastors, greeters and parishioners went above and to accommodate. Since then, ACC has become our church family and we’ve forged relationships along the way. My husband and I have been attending Awaken City Church for a year and a half,  after an exhausting church hunt! We feel God has led us here and we have finally found our church home! From the moment you walk in the door and are greeted with genuine warmth and smiles, to the beautiful music and the awesome message given by either of the two pastors, you feel the Holy Spirit moving through you and through this church. Come join us for a wonderful experience! Love being part of this friendly, loving church community as we have formed many new friends and are also able to serve and help others. You hear the Word of God and how it applies to your life and you can also join life groups to grow with each other. If you're looking for a church with real people who actually care, you need to visit Awaken City. Since day one, my husband and I have felt welcome and part of the church family. The messages from Billy and Jeff are always practical and Biblical, and the worship is great at creating an atmosphere conducive for the Holy Spirit to move. You won't leave church empty handed. Plus, they have a big heart for our community and our world, and are sure to make missions a priority. Happy to be part of this church family!

name: Ballantyne Campus
reviewSummary: Unbelievable contemporary worship experience. Elevation Worship is legendary. The messages are always so practical and relevant. Changed my life.

name: Ballantyne Presbyterian Church
reviewSummary: Systematic and deep expository preaching. Very faithful reformed community.

name: Basilica of The Immaculate Conception - Jacksonville (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Such a beautiful church! I am visiting and as a lifelong Catholic, I treasured the offer of confession shortly before Sunday mass and the rosary being prayed softly over the loud speaker for all in attendance while we wait for mass to begin.

After the rosary, the Divine Mercy chaplet was recited. This was something new to me but so beautiful!

Mass being offered at 10am allowed me to travel the 20 minutes to get there easily, no rushing.

Such an inviting, lovely parish! So glad I visited! Went for morning Mass on a Tuesday at 7:30 a.m. It was about 30 minutes long. The church is beautiful inside and out, with a long history and very well preserved. There is good information available, and the atmosphere is peaceful. Very cool piece of history and also an active church building with daily worship services and confessions. One of the most peaceful and beautiful basilica’s I’ve ever visited!

Church parking across the street from the main entrance! Music program was excellent. Love the more traditional feel. Men in suits ladies wearing mantillas. Very moving, and spiritually rich mass. The LORD must have been pleased.

name: Basilica of the National Shrine
reviewSummary: The largest Catholic church in North America. A stunning architectural masterpiece and national pilgrimage destination with daily masses and reverent worship.

name: Bay Chapel - Tampa Palms Campus
reviewSummary: I have been lucky -- blessed (yes!) -- to sit by to some of the leadership from Bay Chapel in Tampa twice over the past few months. Their love of Jesus is infectious. An amazing group of people doing incredible things. God bless you!! Love is the best word to describe this place. I grew up in a Southern Baptist church, always felt judged, condemned, people giving funny looks if someone was not dressed right or reading a different version of the Bible. From the moment you walk in this place the entire staff and Congregation pour out nothing but Love. The people are what make this place such a great Church, but it's God's presence in them that shines the most. If you want a place to feel welcomed and love, this is your Church Great church amazing crew highly recommend This is not a church, it's THE CHURCH for you and your family. My family has lived in the Tampa Bay area for over 120 years. We have even pastored church's all over Tampa Bay. This church is the best church I have ever attended including our own when we pastored. The music is the best! The children's ministry is the best and we have 7 grandchildren. And all the pastors, staff and volunteers are truly loving to all the guest. You must visit Bay Chapel. My wife and I have been going to Bay Chapel for about six months and I want to share our experience. We have always felt welcomed and part of this family. I always sense God’s presence in this place. For example, in this morning’s service, I didn’t want the music to end because the praise was so meaningful. That is what Heaven must be like, right? And Pastor Bria’s preaching today (as well as how Pastor Wes preaches as our shepherd)  is biblically-based and beautifully vulnerable. I have never written a review on a church but felt led to voice this experience. If you are seeking a place to worship with kind and loving people, then try Bay Chapel. Bill Barksdale

name: Beach Church - Jacksonville Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Beach Church in Jacksonville Beach is a wonderful Christian church. The building is very nice, beautifully designed and decorated, large, has comfortable seating and childcare. The praise and worship team is truly fantastic and they do a great job every week. All of the pastors are really excellent as well. I was raised Baptist, My Husband was raised Catholic and we both enjoy coming here. They have a 9 AM and 11 AM service every Sunday. The people who come here are very welcoming and friendly! While this is not a church, I attend regularly, I recently helped out in their evening, homeless shelter, where they provided accommodation for nearly 90 individuals during a period of freezing temperatures.
They run a professional, kind, and generous operation that merits a tip of the hat Praise God for Beach Baptism in the ocean today! Jesus is smiling today!!!! I love this church!  The people are genuine and welcoming to everyone.  The music is outstanding and Pastor Jerry gives great practical sermons that can be applied to everyday life. Definitely a new experience!! It will kind of grow on you...  If you are more conservative,  this (church) will take some getting use to.

name: Bedrock Church Sarasota - Sarasota Campus
reviewSummary:
We love Bedrock! It’s such a welcoming and friendly environment. The sermons are always meaningful, the pastor is amazing, and it truly feels like being part of a family. We’re so thankful to have found this church! My first time going to church since I was a child—I had some questions for Pastor Blake after the service and he was happy to talk me through my questions and gave me a beautiful leather bound Bible because I didn’t have one at home! Definitely my favorite church I’ve ever been to, everyone makes you feel completely at home even if you’re brand new to the church or to faith in general and the service was very insightful and eye opening! Will definitely be going again :) Bedrock is a wonderful church with strong Biblical teaching, great worship and super nice people.  Pastor Blake has such an approachable, authentic and genuine style but doesn’t water down the truth of the gospel and expresses the great hope we have on the cross. He has great knowledge of the Bible but isn’t too preachy and talks so much about how the all of it impacts our lives. He makes it much more relevant to what’s happening today and we really have not found this kind of spot on teaching at any other church we attended in Sarasota. The worship style is engaging but not too much of a “show”. Thankfully, no strobe lights or massive performances on stage. Bedrock is one of the best I’ve seen, experienced and now a part of when building community.  From the day we walked in our family has been welcomed with open arms.  Blake is one of the best I heard when communicating the gospel.  The way he breaks it down, brings a story line and then at the end, brings it all together with nexts steps to grow in your faith.  The worship is an experience that really ushers in the Holy Spirit to move the way it needs to.

If your looking for a community of believers who are like minded, growing in there faith and just want to “do life together” Bedrocks your place.   Thank you guys for what you do!! Bedrock Church is a great community of believers who want to grow and serve and help point others to the cross. We enjoy the well thought out worship and the strong biblical teaching and preaching each service.There are many opportunities to be involved and use your gifts and talents for the Lord. Bedrock also is truly striving to be a light to the community it is a part of and is a very welcoming place to worship.

name: Bent Tree Bible Fellowship
reviewSummary: A grace-focused Bible fellowship in Carrollton with deep expository teaching and strong community life.

name: Bethel Church
reviewSummary: Global hub for charismatic worship (Bethel Music). Focus on the supernatural and revival culture. Attracts visitors from around the world.

name: Blakeney Campus
reviewSummary: Great community and awesome youth eGroups meeting in the Blakeney area.

name: Boca Raton Community Church - Boca Raton Campus
reviewSummary:
The church impressed me with being the most friendly, Bible preaching church I’ve ever experienced as a 1st time attendee. My wife & grandson were with me & had a great time meeting & getting to know several people before & after service.

We loved the music & the acoustics & the seating was excellent.  First time I’ve seen an escalator in a church ... very functional with their movie-theater style seating!

The preaching was very thought provoking, insightful, encouraging & moving.

Can’t wait to bring our entire  family here for Christmas services in December when we plan to be in Boca Raton for the holidays. Pastor Free really is something else! He treated me like a pastor never should! Real arrogant and self centered! Please don’t ever go to this Church they will just ridicule you and try to take your money! Horrible horrible place! SHAME ON YOU PASTOR FREE! I love this church!!  Pastor Mathew is a scholar and a teacher of The Word.  He is a faithful man of God, and the music there is THE BEST! Yes yes yes. Really lovely kind people of all backgrounds. Always greet each other with a smile and a hug. Praise and worship is me meaningful and powerful. Sunday school is informative and follows the days message. If your looking for a good place to belong, belong here. We feel very welcome when attending Boca Community Church. We are always greeted with a number of genuine smiles welcoming us to worship. The music is very moving and prepares us to listen to Pastor Bill speak. Pastor Bill speaks the word of the Bible. He does a great job of of helping us relate his message to our own lives. This is a great place to worship. We are blessed to have such a great place to grow and worship.

name: Bow Down Church - West Palm Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
As visitors who have ministered for more than 40 years, desiring  the church to realize its apostolic calling, we were delighted to hear a message which provided the meat between the bread of worship and mission: discipleship. Excellent word, thank you, Bow Down Church.
Revs. Charles and Diane Wonnenberg My wife and I are vacationing in WPB and found Bow Down Church on Google. God is definitely in control as this was where we were supposed to be this morning. Excellent worship and Pastor Chris's message was right on! Excellent church, great outreach is happening and when we come down next year we know where to get filled ☺️❤️👍🇺🇸 I've been going here for a year now. In Titus, the women's group, I was able to get real with the other women in a safe and welcoming space, something that I haven't found at other places. I will say that if you go here, you go because you hold God's word as truth and THE standard, humbly submitting to Christ and acknowledging we are nothing apart from Him! If you want to be challenged in your faith, not some sugar-coated, people pleasing version of our faith, but biblical, real, soul cutting truth... with people that are genuine, loving, and on a quest for Christlikeness then this is where you need to be.

Check a sermon out online and come on over. Amazing church, completely Holy Spirit and biblically lead. Very welcoming and involved with the community. If you’re skeptical about churches to attend, save yourself some time and troubles and check out Bow Down! My wife and i attended this church for 2 months while wintering in Florida last winter.. The Pastor wants us to bring Bible. How about speaking directly to Candace Owens one on one before calling her names from the pulpit. The Bible says go to someone first then bring them before the church... I'm bringing this to you direct... i expect that your view on Israel gives you 'permission' to slander another now in front of millions of people.

name: Bridge Community Church - Orange Campus
reviewSummary:
I would describe Bridge as a multi-generational, community Church.

My wife and I were married in September 2022 at Bridge by Pastor Andy. The entire church staff made the sanctuary so beautiful for our special day! It was perfect and we feel so blessed.

My wife has been attending Bridge Community Church since she was 10, and I started attending in 2016 when we first started dating. Many of her bridesmaids were her close friends she grew up with at Bridge, and many of my groomsmen were close friends that I have made at Bridge over the last 7 years.

We love our church family and feel at home at our wonderful church! The place the holy Spirit is moving mountains. I had backsliden for over 27 years and Jesus has brought me to my knees so I can praise him the way I was meant to and submitting my will to his. This church is blessed with the Holy Spirit. My ears had heard all about Jesus for years, my brains knows who he is but going to this church my eyes have seen him and my heart is in love with him greater than my first love. Thank you Bridge for opening the door to my wife and I. God is good Wonderful GODLY people felt very welcome!!! Love this church. Have been going there since 2004.
Pastor Danny is great, and so is the entire staff.
'Following Christ Jesus' is the main focus.
** In short, we see a family that is united by a common desire to live for God and a drive to open their hearts to those in need of what only He can give.
We seek to achieve this on a practical level through worship services, home groups, regular Bible studies, special events, outreach to the homeless and working poor, church services in the Orange county jail, daily emergency food distribution, periodic overseas outreach ** Bridge is an amazing church. With a warm welcoming loving congregation. Great worship and soul feeding word of God preached every Sunday

name: BridgePoint Bible Church
reviewSummary: A Bible church in west Houston known for expository teaching and a warm, family-oriented community.

name: Broadway Christian Church - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary:
First time.  Attended contemporary service.  Nice people. I love Broadway Church and consider it my church family and home. I've been attending Sunday service there and Celebrate Recovery Thursdays for over a year. There's something for everyone there and I highly recommend it. Love this church. The "new" service has great modern Christian music, super friendly parishionersv and is very inclusive. We feel the love. This pastor at this church helps me with groceries but they say that they can't help nobody else I spoke to the lady that they help with groceries but meanwhile they said they can't help nobody

Please on Sundays do not give money to this church. Dial 211 and see if they help you but we have to stop giving money to churches that don't help people because I came out here for a job got stranded and they can't even help me get back so to test this church pretend you are member of this church tell them you behind on light bill see if they will help you out you will see the true greedy church they won't help you let's get these churches shut down please Broadway Christian is such a warm and welcoming church. My husband and I looked for a church for almost a year. We have a contemporary and classic service and many opportunities to grow and serve the community.

name: Buckhead Church
reviewSummary: Part of the North Point network, targeting the urban Buckhead demographic. Modern production, practical teaching, designed for young professionals.

name: C3 Church Naples (Non-Denominational) - Naples Campus
reviewSummary:
A great church To make home – – even if you’re just a seasonal attendee.

Jean is an excellent biblical pastor and preacher

If you come as a stranger, you won’t leave like one —  just make sure that you join for the food after service We visited multiple churches before coming to C3. None of them felt like "home" until we came here. You can truly come as you are, but don't expect to stay that way! Pastor Gene is very knowledgeable and will challenge you to grow in your faith and I love that! This is a true non-denominational church, which means everyone is welcome no matter your denomination as they keep the main thing the main thing and don't believe on dividing over non-Gospel issues. The staff and members are welcoming and super nice too! Beautiful and loving church. Come as you are, they make you feel at home no matter what. My sister it’s a member of this church, and I visited while on vacations in Naples. Great location, and facilities. They even have a designated parking for first time visitors, you guessed it right, that’s where I parked my rental. God is doing amazing things here at C3 Church! My husband and I started going to C3 four years ago and fell in love. It truly is a real church for real people. It doesn't matter where you are in your walk with God, you are always welcome to hear His message at C3. My husband and I absolutely love C3! Pastor Gene has taught us so much while we’ve been attending here. C3 has everything a church should. Fellowship, prayer, the breaking of bread, and phenomenal teaching. It’s hard to find teaching like this anywhere else. Our walks with Christ has deepened tremendously since being involved with C3

name: Calvary Baptist Church - Covington Campus
reviewSummary:
This has been my home charge for quite some time! The preaching is dead on and very thorough and educated in scripture. They have a lot of activities. I’m not currently involved in a lot, but they are available. If I could change only one thing, I would change the singing and song service. Jay is very Set in his ways. We rarely if never sing any hymns. We never have any specials. We stand a great deal. The things he says seems so rehearsed and not natural. He seems to be reading everything. We have Same front leaders and you cannot really hear their parts. It is an excellent church and I would highly Recommend this church for its Bible, preaching, and atmosphere Calvary Baptist Church Covington ky is a Bible teaching church. They offer Sunday school at 9:15 and a church servchurch. 8:30 & 10:30.
Mondays they offer a drop in sewing group. Wednesday nights or Thursday mornings Precepts bible studies are offered. Their are a few ladies nights throughout the year . I also enjoy belonging to a book club through the chuch. One of the most warmest friendliest churches in Kentucky, love love loved it!!! We have been attending Calvary Baptist Church for 19 years. We love the church and the people. The pastor preaches from the Bible. They offer a lot of Sunday morning bible studies including classes for teens and kids. A really nice family church. In its day this church was beautiful

name: Calvary Chapel - Miami Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Awesome church! Especially great bilingual worship! Also a group prayer with hands holding was super lovely - the highlight and the best part of the service ❤️ I wish it was there every service!
Also would be so great if there was a group chat to build community 🙏💗

I read many unkind reviews about food distribution, maybe to solve this only give food to those who came to the service and gave glory to God, not to random people?

God bless you 🤗❤️ 🙏 🕊 They reserve tables for regular patrons but they should put reserved signs on the tables. I had two backpacks and they placed me in the middle and moved my backpack to a place i couldn't check. Someone got there after and let him pick a table. They thought i was a foreigner. I watched services virtually during the height of the pandemic in 2020. Pastor Robert & the worship team really got me through would could have been a difficult time for me. I
looked forward to the mid-week worship. During that time I delivered groceries as my job was not considered essential, and coming home to watch was a way for me to wind down in the evenings with God’s word. I live in Orlando, and hope to visit in person. Blessings to all 🙏🏽 I enjoyed every Sunday I went here. They check temps and have limited seating, so get there a little early. I have never had an issue being able to sit though. I really like the younger pastor, every time I have heard him preach I have learned and absorbed new insights. You can tell he is very smart & knows the Bible well. Also does not preach too cheerful or too condemning. The worship is awesome! All of the worship team are very talented & it sounds good every week. Video is of them. I love that song 🎶 also, I stayed after one Sunday for complimentary coffee & baked goods & everyone was very nice and friendly. Please make the experience with the homeless community not about the ones you chosen to like and chosen to give the fresh ,good expiration dates to
And those you feel are undeserving.
Please don't belittle or humiliate those in need.
They are not your punching bag .
Are you miserable?
Do you not like feeding good wholesome meals to orphans,sick and handicapped individuals who trust your hands?
If not
Please allow another group of volunteers to happily take your positions of food distribution days( Monday and Thursday)
How you treat the less fortunate is integrity on your hands or not
It's up to you.

name: Calvary Chapel Boca Raton - Boca Raton Campus
reviewSummary:
I felt really welcomed, im just starting my process to come back to God. This church has been really good for me. IG: TRAVELWITHARCHER86

It's been quite some time since I last attended church, and my heart has felt some form of guilt. I've struggled with my understanding of God and have consistently, for years, desired to discover the clarity and a sense of certainty within my understanding and belief of God. I still am in the same head space. However, thanks to a wonderful friend who invited me to church tonight, I feel a sense of peace. The message from the young pastor who led the service was impeccable and RELATABLE. The message and story tonight (6/7/2025 Saturday) was about David and Nabal. I was captivated and fully invested from start to finish.

I want to directly give my thanks to the pastor and the PHENOMENAL band who touched my heart and re-invigorated my desire to search for my understanding and love for God.

Thank you!

-Joshua-
U.S. Coast Guard Veteran I truly love this church and I’m grateful to be a part of it. However, I feel the childcare situation needs more attention. Today during service there were 16 children placed in one room, ranging in age from 2 to 4 years old. While that may seem manageable to some, I personally felt that the age gap is far too wide and the ratio of children to caregivers is concerning. Younger toddlers have very different needs and abilities compared to older preschoolers, and it’s important for their safety, development, and overall experience that this be addressed.

Edit: today they moved my children to a different classroom without being told or informed of the change. The children’s ministry is a mess and for that reason I am leaving Calvary. I really feel  at home here. Truly a Bible centered church. The service was great and would love to be here full time. A Warm, Bible-Centered Congregation at Calvary Chapel Fort Lauderdale

If you’re seeking a friendly, Bible-focused church in South Florida with practical teaching, welcoming community, and opportunities to grow, Calvary Chapel Fort Lauderdale is a standout. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with hospitality, clear teaching, and a supportive, family-friendly atmosphere.

What makes it special
Grounded, practical teaching: Messages are verse-by-verse, easy to apply, and relevant to everyday life, offering clear takeaways for faith and daily living.
Warm, inclusive community: The congregation feels welcoming to newcomers and families, with a culture of genuine hospitality and support.
Discipleship-minded programs: Strong classes for adults, couples, and youth, plus study groups and outreach opportunities that encourage growth and service.
Family-friendly environment: A relaxed, inviting setting that’s accessible for all ages, with kids’ ministries and family activities that make church feel like a shared mission.
Prayerful, worshipful atmosphere: The worship experience is heartfelt and uplifting, complemented by a focus on prayer and spiritual growth.

Experience and vibe
Careful, faithful community: Calvary Chapel Fort Lauderdale emphasizes grace, practical faith, and authentic community life—creating a space where you can belong and grow.
Outreach and impact: The church is active in local outreach, missions, and community service, translating faith into action.

Practical tips
Arrive early to connect with others and settle in before worship.
Check schedule for services, midweek studies, and outreach opportunities to find your fit.
Explore small groups or volunteer opportunities to deepen connections and service.
Invite a friend or family member—sharing the experience often leads to meaningful conversations afterward.

Bottom line
Calvary Chapel Fort Lauderdale offers a warm, Bible-centered worship experience with a strong sense of community and active outreach. Ideal for families, newcomers, and anyone seeking authentic connection, solid teaching, and meaningful ways to serve. Highly recommended for those looking to grow in faith and live out their beliefs daily. Great place for your kids education.

name: Calvary Church - Clearwater - Clearwater Campus
reviewSummary:
I came to Calvary Church during a season of searching — not casually, but with intention. I was specifically looking for a Baptist congregation because of my deep personal connection to First Baptist Church in Lakeland, where I recently had the privilege of contributing to their campus through my work with Distinct Designs Custom Cabinets and Casework in Largo.

Only about four months ago, I was sanding surfaces, assembling drawers, fitting cabinetry, sweeping floors, and delivering finished pieces room by room — all alongside the great Jarek from Poland, one of the finest craftsmen I’ve ever known. To build even a small part of a church like FBC Lakeland was an honor. I prayed quietly as I worked, imagining the countless believers who would one day use those spaces. That experience left a mark on me, and it made me long for a Baptist church family of my own.

That longing is what led me to Calvary.

From the moment I arrived, the people here were warm, kind, and genuinely welcoming. The pastoral care team reached out quickly. Gaye Lene was attentive and organized, and both Pastor Mike and Pastor Justin took the time to speak with me about baptism and next steps. Their willingness to meet, listen, and guide me meant a great deal.

Calvary is a large, active congregation with strong teaching, heartfelt worship, and a sincere commitment to Scripture. You can feel the love of Christ in the way people greet you, pray with you, and make space for newcomers. For many, this church is home — and I can absolutely see why.

But as I continued my journey, something unexpected happened:
I found myself drawn back to a place that had been quietly woven into my life for decades.

I ultimately found my spiritual home at St. Alfred’s Episcopal Church on Curlew in Palm Harbor — a church I likely attended as a child with my grandfather, Harry B. Vassie, co‑founder of the NSA and later a beloved member of the Palm Harbor community. He served in the Coast Guard Auxiliary on Lake Tarpon and carried himself with the kind of dignity and quiet service that shaped my understanding of faith long before I had words for it.

For the past nine years, I’ve walked with Father Pete at Enterprise Dog Park — a man who never pushed, never preached at me, never tried to steer me. He simply listened. Month after month, year after year, he offered a gentle, patient presence that spoke louder than any sermon. And today, when he preached, something in his words reached a place in me I didn’t expect. His sermon brought tears to my eyes — not from sadness, but from recognition. From the sense that I was finally standing where I belonged.

So while Calvary was an important part of my journey — and I am grateful for the time I spent there — my path ultimately led me somewhere else. That doesn’t diminish Calvary in the slightest. Not every church is meant for every person, and that’s part of the beauty of the Body of Christ. Different voices, different traditions, different ways of drawing people closer to God.

Calvary is a good church with good people, and I’m thankful for their hospitality. If you’re searching, Calvary is absolutely worth visiting. And if your journey takes you somewhere else, that’s okay too. Sometimes God leads us through one door so we can recognize the next one when it opens. Thanks but no thanks.

In this country we have the freedom of the press, and Google reviews is a way for citizens to participate.

name: Campus Church - Pensacola Campus
reviewSummary:
Very friendly church. Great for all age groups & stages of life. The kids classes are well staffed. The preaching was wonderful with plenty of scriptural references. This is a place where Christians and families can thrive. The campus church is not just a college/student church, everyone is welcome. Campus Church in Pensacola, Florida is a large congregation (could be classified as a megachurch). The church is located on the property of Pensacola Christian College, however, the church is a separate and distinct entity in which anyone in the community can attend. The church is an Independent, Fundamental, Baptist Church and conducts services accordingly. They follow a typical order of service, starting with video announcements, a worship service with traditional and new hymns, corporate prayer, and then a sermon (typically expository) from the Senior Pastor Dr. Jeff Redlin. Although, the church typically does not include an altar-call style come-down invitation.

Campus Church has a variety of ministries it conducts. For adults, the church has multiple Bible study groups during the Sunday school hour. They also have Wednesday evening small groups that meet for a variety of reasons (Lifeshare book study, Grieving and healing heart ministry, Overcomer Conquer series, Woman to Woman ministry, etc.). For the youth, they have an active Teen group which meets on Wednesday evenings. They also have a nice Children's Sunday School program which utilizes Joyful Life curriculum (last I checked, this could be changed by now). The church also conducts a Master Clubs service for the children on Sunday evenings. Campus Church conducts a variety of other ministry events and community events as well.

Campus Church is a great ministry. Though, no church is without some drawbacks. The size of this ministry makes it difficult to have a church "family" feel. It is nearly impossible to meet and fellowship with the majority of the church as the student attendees leave periodically throughout the year and the church members are so vast in numbers it is difficult to build those relationships. Although, after you eventually build those relationships, the bonds created can be great. Ever since COVID, Campus Church has started heavily relying on technology (livestream, video announcements, QR code Gospel tracts, Online giving, Realm) to which I personally feel is negative to the ministry, however, that is an exceedingly personal opinion. There is no stated dress code for non-PCC attendees, however, it can feel very judgmental if you arrive in anything less formal than Khakis and a Polo.

Overall, I recommend Campus Church as a great Bible-believing church in the Pensacola community. Although, I would recommend considering the drawbacks, and weighing them against the positives of the ministry. This is not everyone's style of church, but it should be a church everyone can consider to call their home. HUGE auditorium with plenty of seats. Several big screens so you can see everything going on, and the sound system was very well designed. The music was God honoring and the message was well presented. Coming from a small church congregation, I felt "lost"/out of place, but we still enjoyed worshipping with other brothers and sisters in Christ. 💜 It is a large church, but their goal is not to have a big church. It is to serve God. The pastor preaches good, Biblical messages, and even though you could get lost in the crowd, they work very hard to make sure that you are seen and understand you are welcome and valuable. Oh we highly recommend this place. We came here with our 6 children. We have always listened to pastor Jeff on rejoice radio from Idaho but since we were going to Destin for vacation we really wanted to stop by Campus church. The orchestra was beautiful, the choir was beautiful, God’s word was spoken by pastor Jeff. It’s a blessing to be here. The parking lot for visitors is plenty enough and we were guided by the helpers outside when we told them it’s our first time. It really is a blessing if you can come to this church!

You’re not joining a church you are joining a family with Christ. You feel so good when you come in here. People greet you nicely, are attentive and make you feel welcome. I wouldn’t be where I am today had it not been for this wonderful church and community. Love you guys so much. Thank you for everything you’ve done in the past years. 💯❤️🙏🏼 This is a place where without religiosity we are invited to have a relationship with God. There is work to do in this church. I hope this church does not become like Sardis or Ephesus churches mentioned in the Bible. Praying for your leaders and for your church.

reviewSummary: European Gothic cathedral in northern Kentucky!  Knowledgeable and friendly tour guide. We did not have a tour scheduled, but the host at the door basically gave us our own private tour. The organist was practicing when we were there, so that made it extra special. I was in town for work. It was a beautiful day so my coworker and I walked here from our hotel, the Radisson. The stained glass is amazing as well as the mosaics. It does not take long to view everything, definitely look at the hours and visit if you're in the area. One of the most beautiful Churches I have ever been in. The Volunteers are some of the most nicest people. I'm not Catholic but I enjoy going and love sitting in the pews and soaking up all the beauty and usually I say a few prayers of thanks. I've struggled with religion but somehow when I walk into this Church that all seems to go away and I feel like I am home again just like when I was a child and going to Church all the time. Our volunteer who was giving us information about the cathedral was very knowledgeable and welcoming. This church boasts two organs, one of them being the oldest working one of its kind in the world. name: Celebration Church - Jacksonville (Southside) Campus
reviewSummary:
Love my church and my pastor!! My family has been EXTREMELY blessed to call this church our HOME! We are a diverse group of Bible-believing Christians that seek the Lord beyond Sunday. I have been challenged, grown and molded in my time at Celebration through dedicated leaders of Bible study and other courses and classes offered. I serve in kids ministry and I know that the volunteers genuinely love and care for those babies with the love of Jesus. I praise God every day for my church family and I pray protection over our leaders and body physically, spiritually and mentally. Celebration Church was the final church I attended in Jacksonville before heading back home to Virginia Beach, Virginia, and what a great church to end that season with. If I had known it was only about 19 minutes away, there would have been many Sundays where I would have split my time between Celebration and the Church of Eleven22 campuses.
The worship music was incredible. In my opinion, very few churches have compared to the energy I experienced at 2819, but Celebration came close. It felt like a full-fledged concert for Christ from beginning to end. The worship was alive, powerful, and full of passion.
I had seen Pastor Tim Timberlake on Instagram and watched some of his reels before attending. I already knew he spoke well, but hearing him in person was different. He preaches with passion, boldness, and volume. He is not timid about the Word, and he does not seem concerned with people’s opinions. I appreciated when he said, “Don’t ask me, go to the Word. Don’t believe what I say.” That is the kind of preaching people need — bold, biblical, and pointing people back to Scripture instead of personality.
The people were also great. While I was sitting with my service dog, a lady named Frenchy came over, sat down, and asked if she could join me at the table. Of course, I said yes. Frenchy, shout out to you and your son. You were both great people. In a time when I needed fellowship, camaraderie, and simple human kindness, you listened, were polite, and made me feel welcomed.
There was also a man whose name I cannot remember, but he wore a cowboy hat. He brought me coffee and helped seat me in a place that was convenient for me and my service dog. He was also an Army veteran, and I appreciated the brotherhood and hospitality. Thank you, bro.
Celebration Church left a strong impression on me. Great worship, great preaching, great people, and real hospitality. I cannot wait to come back into town, hopefully with friends or family, and introduce them to the people and church we talked about.
Keep preaching the Word. I decided to visit this church during a time when I was trying to reconnect with my faith after having drifted away for a while. At first, I appreciated how digestible everything felt, it’s definitely an easy place for newcomers to step into without feeling overwhelmed.
However, when I made the decision to pursue baptism, I was surprised by how informal and unstructured the process felt. It seemed like something you could simply sign up for and complete after a service and then drive home without much guidance, preparation, or spiritual authority. For me, this was a deeply significant step, and I found myself longing for more direction, tradition, and spiritual grounding.
Over time, I also found it difficult to connect with the overall tone of the services, especially the sermons. They often felt crafted more around relatability, humor, and keeping the audience engaged than around reverence or a deep, scripture centered message. The frequent jokes and casual tone made it harder for me to experience the sense of sacredness and reflection that I personally believe church calls for. I guess I was hoping for something more rooted in tradition and exploration of the more challenging aspects of faith. Most of the sermons are just the pastor telling you what you can do to receive bigger blessings, which I do not believe is the fullness of the church.
The use of pop style music, teleprompters, and the overall presentation style further contributed to this feeling that the church is more focused on optics than reverence. Instead of being drawn into a space of reverence and contemplation, I often felt like I was attending something designed more to entertain an audience than to spiritually ground us.
Ultimately, I realized I was looking for a more structured and deeply rooted expression of faith. This led me to return to the Catholicism, where I feel a stronger sense of tradition, guidance, and reverence in worship.
I truly believe this church may be a great fit for those who are new to faith, but ultimately there is really no spiritual authority held at this facility and if you plans to grow in your faith, I would use this church as a steppingstone to do so. The message was “Hidden in Plain Sight “
It was good to be home and to take time to have and experience in our growth of being believers.

Look forward to Tim coming back to Union Church in Maryland . Church is alway AMAZING!  Been coming for 2 years now. This is the first time I’ve heard it like this. Today the Sound Engineer should be ashamed! There was way TOO much bass in the music during worship, it was difficult to concentrate. I hope this issue is fixed, if not I’ll be skipping worship in the future.  I could literally feel it in my chest and my daughter who is 14 even asked, why it was like that. Never got adjusted, never got lowered, never changed. MISERABLE!

Will gladly update this review if this was a 1 time thing. Tried to even ask who to speak to about the issue, no one knew.

name: Center Point Community Church - Naples Campus
reviewSummary:

reviewSummary: Champion is very welcoming to new members. One can find a sense of community, fellowship and practical stewardship in this space. What an Amazing church! CHOC Children's Hospital Sacred Space & Interfaith Ministry - Main Campus
Christ Church Plano - Plano Campus
reviewSummary:
We enjoyed our visit on Sunday July 5th and felt right at home. Very friendly and welcoming. They had a very nice playground for kids. I’ve been going since February and I love it. From being greeted at the door to taking holy communion, everything and everyone is Christ centered. The Sanctuary is beautiful, the children’s facilities are great. We are very blessed to have such a great church in our community. Welcome to church in Rivendell. Are you too Catholic for Protestants but also too Protestant for Catholics? Are you tired of Ted-Talk sermons and rock-band worship? Want to put some church back in your church? CCP might just be the place for you.

The architecture of the main sanctuary looks to be of elvish origin,  attested to by the green and gold theme and simple elegance of it all. It brings in the feel of a traditional cathedral but with a modern minimalist twist. I truly enjoy seeing the clear blue Texas skies and rolling clouds ⛅️ through the filtered windows as I worship.

The sermons are relevant for today but with a traditional liturgy and excellent music ministry that ties you back into your connection with church history. The people are very friendly. The clergy all come from diverse theological backgrounds, but all have found their place and home at CCP. All of them are very approachable, collar and all.

They have an excellent children and youth ministry that our kids have enjoyed thoroughly. Bring a dollar on Wednesday nights for the pizza served to the 4th - 12th graders.

There are many ministries that reach the local community and beyond.

We have been taking their foundations class and have really enjoyed it. Every class begins with a fellowship lunch together. We've not been going here for very long but have found that people already know us by name.

If you want to dip your toe back into the traditional church scene, I truly do recommend giving this church a try. Great church to go to regardless of denomination. Incredibly friendly and welcoming, and the music and staff are excellent. Attended a wedding here. The church was beautiful, clean and full of natural light. The fellowship hall was spacious and turned into a beautiful reception venue. There is tons of parking and the seats were comfortable.

reviewSummary: We found this Church after a power-hungry bishop destroyed our Anglican Church that had been the focus or our religious life for 20 years. This Church provides us with the beautiful Anglican liturgy without the need to pay homage to unscrupulous and arrogant bishops. Most importantly, the clergy are caring, intelligent priests who provide incredible sermons every Sunday. What an incredible blessing Christ Church has been! The church family is small and very special. I have grown tremendously in my renewed faith and treasure this church and the closeness of our members. Excellent family Worship in the Anglican tradition.

reviewSummary:
Christ City Church has truly impacted my life in such a powerful way. Even though I’ve only been there for a couple of months, I already feel so welcomed and spiritually refreshed. From the worship to the Word, I genuinely feel the presence of the Holy Spirit every time I attend.

reviewSummary: Christ Community Church has been an incredible partner to Hoops on Mission for years. Looking for a new church. I will go back. Was of God not of the world. Big difference!!! We attend Christ Community when we are in Ft Myers for the month of March each year. Pastor Chad Woolf is a great preacher! His messages are alway Biblically sound and culturally relevant. This church also has a heart for outreach. I highly recommend if you are looking for a church to attend and a place to engage. Visited here and there for a few months. Never thought I’d hear a pastor on the pulpit describe how and why he was vaccinated and practically tell the congregation they should do the same. Sad times we are living in.

name: Christ Community Church - Pompano Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I love this church. I went here my entire childhood through late teens. I had a slight falling out due to my own reasoning. But I am now starting to come back after 4 years. Pastor Dylan is amazing. The church as a whole will always be a special place for me This church has a feeding for the homeless and poverty stricken every Saturday morning. Every other Saturday a special group comes with a great meal, and mobile showers and clothing is also available. You can take the community bus which picks up at the Broward county transit center at 8am on sat. Mornings. Awesome church great Pastor always feels like family very welcoming and a very good strong presence of the Lord is always in the house You cannot call yourself a reformed church and have female Elders, it is unbiblical. The bible is very clear on it. Great Church. So helpful to the community. Thank you

name: Christ Community Church of Laguna Hills
Christ Culture Church Louisville - Main Campus

reviewSummary:
I absolutely love my church. I’ve been attending since 2011. Pastor Rick Blackwood and his team were transformational for me. The new team of Pastor Omar, Carlos, Gideon, Tucker and others are filling those giant shoes nicely. I’ve grown so much of the years and I’m so grateful that I found this place. Not sure what rating to give this church. Attended for the first time this past Sunday, and while the message was honest and to my knowledge Biblically sound, I was slightly concerned at the lack of prayer. When the only prayer is the call to salvation and a flashy blessing at the end but there is no constant and humble communication throughout the service thanking God and reflecting all glory back to Him — I wonder, is the church and the worship team receiving the glory?  You are merely a vessel and should act more like one. This is my personal experience.
🚩1.Your not greeted when you enter, your immediately asked for your bag. To check for drugs or weapons
🚩2.There is no “physical” pastor, it’s a live visual electronically on a screen.
🚩3. Within a minute of me sitting down, a man came right in front of me and took a few picture’s. no there was not a single person sitting behind me all the way back. So that was very strange to me.
Again this is just my personal experience. It felt weird the moment I entered and it seems more like a rehearsal, versus an actual church. I’m not aware of the show that was being put on, but it definitely rubbed me the wrong way. The atmosphere didn’t feel very welcoming and I think there should be a disclaimer everywhere for any church.If there is not a physical pastor in it. When I go to church, I’m going there for the word of God. I want to be in Gods presence and physically hear from the preacher. The preacher is going to not only speak the word but feed off of the other energy and spirits in the place. Giving the word or the message that we may personally all need. So I did not stay long.
God bless anyone who does go to this church, it just wasn’t for me. Have a blessed day Absolutely an amazing church.   It’s Bible based  it’s a very kind loving environment.   We were here visiting.   The worship was top notch.   I suppose the only thing I didn’t like would be the fact that the senior pastor was preaching from the main church so he was on the screen but honestly it was just fine the msg was spot on.       If we lived in Miami this would be our home church.   The set up is perfect.  The safety team was fantastic.   I’m sure they don’t call them that but they were great The most amazing church! We have been coming here for about 13 years and are so happy this branch reopened. The staff, pastors and volunteers are second to none. Im grateful to be plugged in as a volunteer and that all members are encouraged to help be the hands and feet of Christ here. I can attest that the children's ministry and small groups are life-giving. My family and I have been blessed by this church and are so grateful for Pastor Gideon and all the wonderful members. If you are looking for a great church that focuses on God's word and living it out with your family, this is the church for you!

reviewSummary: What a wonderful church! We'd been attending the main campus at Palm Beach Gardens for several months before trying out the Boca Campus and finding this church family so close to home has been a huge value add to our lives. From our very first Sunday we felt warmly welcomed and genuinely included. The people are so friendly and the campus staff team are top notch! So grateful to have checked them out and now we have a new church home. If you're looking for a church in the area, I'm certain you won't be disappointed with Christ Fellowship Boca. Christ fellowship church has great people music and prayer. From the moment you enter their service you are welcomed and included. Kids and adults love it and we will continue to return. Feels so great to be there every Sunday Today was my first Sunday attending Christ fellowship at the Boca Raton location.  Everyone was very friendly and welcoming. I loved the look and feel of the actual church and the live worship music was great. I currently attend another Christian church and wanted to try this one out. I do have a few “cons” if you will. There were no Bibles to be seen. The actual sermon was not a live human preaching in the church. name: Christ Journey Church - Coral Gables Campus
reviewSummary:
Every week after the service,  Christ Journey Church encourages members to join a ministry if they feel a calling in their heart. In response to that encouragement, I completed all required steps, including passing the mandatory background check and complying with additional requirements necessary to serve.
However, despite meeting every requirement, I was left completely in the dark. Certain individuals within some ministries chose not to move forward with my participation, yet no explanation was provided no conversation, no feedback, nothing.
This raises an important question: after someone has fully complied with all requirements, why are concerns or issues (if any) not addressed directly with the individual? On what basis are these decisions made appearance, past experiences, personal background, level of faith?.  Are the Ministries in Christ Journey exclusively for some people, and not for others?
I am genuinely asking: What would Jesus do in this situation?
I do not recall Jesus rejecting people without explanation or refusing them the opportunity to grow, serve, or be restored. I believed Christ Journey Church to be a family-oriented church a place to congregate, to find truth, honesty, and love for one another.
Sadly, that has not been my experience.
As a result, I have made the decision to stop attending Christ Journey. Finally, after much searching I found the place for my worship, sharing and service to God, the creator of heaven and earth. Finding others that understand and work together to help one another is amazing. I am in for the "journey". If you need to connect to the Creator, this place will offer you patience and love as you embark on your "journey". Come as you are. I am so happy to have made the decision one sunday to attend this church because i haven’t missed one since. I love this church the praising, praying and ways they teach and guide is amazing really has helped my life in so many ways and will continue to.  My family and I started attending Christ Journey around May of last year. We came from another church where we had been attending for quite a while, but we truly felt we were being called to leave and find another church home. Christ Journey has been that for us 100%. It has brought about healing, the people are so genuine, the preachings are taught in a way that is fresh and exciting while remaining whole and true, and the presence of God is felt in a way I’ve never seen at any church in Miami. This church has been a blessing to my family and I can’t wait to continue to grow in what God has for us! Also, if you have kids, they will absolutely LOVE CJ Kids! The time, consideration, and attention to detail taken with each craft, story, lesson, and event makes us so happy as parents and the kids love every second of it. ❤️ I love my Church community everyone is so friendly and welcoming and I love hearing Pastor Bill preach  you should go by and see for yourself

reviewSummary:
The Church of the little Flower has been our place of worship for 3 generations.  My daughter went to school there in the 80’s.  We are practicing Catholics but it’s not the stunning historical location but the amazing clergy that inspires and moves the soul with their word of God! I recently completed my OCIA program through the Church of the Little Flower. The program was 6 months, and throughout that time we frequently visited COTLF, while also being part of a "Teaching Mass" with Fr. Manny & Deacon Fleitas. After my program, I was baptized during the Easter Vigil Mass at the church. My entire experience with COTLF has been nothing short of transformational and my wife and I also celebrated our marriage sacrament there. I highly recommend this church to any and all families looking for a great community. I had the pleasure of attending a beautiful wedding at the Church of the Little Flower in Coral Gables, Florida. The experience was truly memorable, thanks in part to the informative rehearsal two days prior.

The Church of the Little Flower is a picturesque venue with its charming architecture and serene surroundings. The wedding ceremony itself was a breathtaking affair, with the church's ornate interior creating a perfect backdrop for the couple's special day.

What stood out to me was the well-organized and informative rehearsal held two days before the wedding. It ensured that everyone knew their roles and the order of proceedings, making the actual ceremony smooth and enjoyable. Everyone was courteous and accommodating, making sure everything went off without a hitch.

The Church of the Little Flower in Coral Gables, Florida, offers a beautiful setting for weddings and events, and the added benefit of a thorough and helpful rehearsal made the entire experience even more special. It's a place I would wholeheartedly recommend for anyone seeking a memorable and well-executed wedding ceremony. There is no other church community like the Little Flower family. Attending Sunday mass is amazing! My favorite is Christmas! I love the homilies but my favorite part is the music and the ambience that is created. The versatility and melodies that come from the organ is phenomenal. Hands down to the Organist. Then the choir starts to sing suddenly it feels heavenly. Completely at peace. Honestly, no other place like Church of the Little Flower. Wonderful church for weddings and photography. They are well organized and have simple and easy instructions to follow. Shay photography of Fort Lauderdale:)
