Love my church.Been going almost 2 years.Great music even better sermons.All the pastors are great,The lead pastor Luther Stanford is a awesome pastor love his way of teaching the Bible .He really makes church enjoyable....I cook meals youth services on Wednesday's. The youth pastor ,Chaise is very good a his calling to .It is very enjoyable on Wednesday's also.😇😇😇🙏😇🙏👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍👍I give The City Church experience 10 thimds up.Can I hear an "AMEN" After only 2 visits Pastor Luther knew mine and my wife's name. Pastor Luther is a true shepard to his congregation and a great Bible teacher. He has never flaunted his Phd and you will truly get new insight to the word of God through his teaching. We welcome you to visit our church and feel the love of Christ. Great worship, great fellowship and great opportunities to serve a great God. Good teaching and fellowship. Humble staff. They helped their community after the hurricane even though they were also in need. They minister to the well and broken alike. Come as you are.

name: City Church of Gainesville - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary:
I love this place. Great church in downtown Gainesville. If you're new to Gainesville, near UF or downtown this is a great church to check out!!
Chipper, Ryan, Jay & the crew are great folks. They are remodeling the building and it’s going to be an awesome facility when it completed. Everyone is very friendly and always makes you feel welcomed.  Your church community becomes your family and this church does that perfectly. The Lead Pastor is very genuine and down-to-earth.  If you ever need a community of followers of Jesus, this place will make you feel right at home! Completely Recommend!  5 stars! Nothing more needs to be said! My family and I began attending City last summer. Since that time we've become involved with small group, and a local outreach/service. I highly recommend this church for a number of reasons. Firstly, the people have a heart for this city and community, and they express it in very practical ways. The church actively engages with mercy and justice initiatives in the community, and its presence downtown is very intentional in order to be a place of refuge and hope. The Pastors are men of integrity and with deep knowledge and reverence of the Bible. There is clear and transparent governance, the voice of the congregation in decisions is welcomed, and the church body is invited in sharing their testimonies, using their talents, and supporting missions. A unique aspect of this church is weekly communion, which reminds us of the importance of this sacrament in remembering Christ's mission and love, and inviting others to participate. Amazing community of believers with wise, loving elders/pastors leading the sheep. On our first Sunday, and every time we've had people with us who are visiting for the first time, the lead pastor has come over to intentionally talk with us and actually want to get to know those who are new.
We've found so many people on Sunday and in our community group who are extremely loving, caring, mature in their faith, and genuinely in love with the Lord.
The church community also does an amazing job of looking for opportunities to get involved with loving downtown Gainesville, especially with those often marginalized or overlooked.

May the Lord continue to use City Church for His glory! Being involved in a City Church has been such a great experience from the community to the gospel-centered teaching to the social events. I've enjoyed walking alongside the people during this past year and growing in understanding of Christ's love and sacrifice for us.

name: City Church Tallahassee - Tallahassee Campus
reviewSummary:
We attended the Christmas Family event this past Christmas and it was magical for all! My son had amazing time playing  in the bounce houses and going on a train ride. We enjoyed hot cocoa along with arts and crafts. we were even able to snap a picture with Santa!  Thank you City Chirch for hosting this event! My family and I have attended City Church for roughly 10 years, and never been disappointed. We love it, and so do our children. There are tons of ways to get involved and it’s been nothing short of amazing watching the congregation continue to grow at an astonishing rate. The music is phenomenal and Pastor Dean preaches directly from the Bible. He does not waver to what people  WANT to hear, should it oppose scripture; yet he is incredibly graceful & tactful in the way he represents Gods Word. City Church will remain our home for many years to come and we are exceedingly grateful to have started attending here. City Church is like no church I've ever been to. The moment you drive/walk on campus someone is there to greet you and welcome you. This is a Bible based, faith based church that makes no apologies for loving God and telling the world of His good news. They have a large children's service that kids are thriving in and learning about Jesus and God and the Bible. They're music ministries is uplifting and moving. They have a wonderful middle school youth fellowship that meets every Wednesday and am amazing college ministries that is reaching college campuses across the country. If you're looking for a home base church, check it out! Lots of musical talent and an excellent congregation. The pastor has tons of energy and passion - strong messages. I was moved by the love, spirit, and baptisms - my first visit was today. Jessie was very friendly at the guest support table. I look forward to getting “plugged in.” Thanks! For YEARS I have been hearing so many positive words about City Church, and finally decided to give it a try. We have spent the last 5 weeks at City Church. Thus far, the sermons feel relevant and relatable.

After attending Catholic Church for nearly 25 years, I decided I wanted our kids to experience something different within the Christian faith so that their journey to Christ could truly be theirs. City Church felt like "something different" yet still comfortable and close to home.

We arrived at the beginning of a series on politics, and I maybe cringed a little. Politics in church?! Is that even appropriate?! Glad we stuck around for it, even if it made me feel uncomfortable at times.  Found myself truly looking forward to Sundays!

I have so much respect for Pastor Dean Inserra's willingness to actually discuss the really difficult societal topics by tying everything back to the teachings of the bible with sensitively and without judgement. Looking forward to the next series through Christmas and Easter.

We definitely feel welcome here, plan to stick around, and eventually get involved. :-)

We really enjoy the music, too!

name: City Lift Church - Fort Lauderdale Campus
reviewSummary:
2/22/26--A day or two ago I started to feel something missing inside me. I needed to be around believers. I needed church. The Bible says, “Let us not give up meeting together… but encouraging one another” (Hebrews 10:25). My soul was saying, go find your people.

So yesterday I searched for churches near me. I found one… but when I checked their beliefs, it was more like a we made God to our liking and image and not the other way around a  club with a cross decoration. I was looking for a Bible-believing church, not a “feel good and go home” place.
I prayed: “Lord, lead me.”
Because the Word is clear: “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me” (John 14:6).

Then I found City Church. I went straight to the statement of faith like a spiritual detective 🕵️‍♀️ — if it doesn’t say salvation through Jesus alone by faith alone, I keep scrolling. But this one… this one was solid. I said, maybe this is it.

Just because I am in Florida does not mean I will visit any church. Even on vacation my faith travels with me 😄.

I woke up super early (that is already a miracle — resurrection power level). I took a Lyft and went. But before that… my husband and I had an argument about his brother, the professional, certified, gold-medal pathological liar. Yes, I arrived at church holy on the outside and boiling on the inside. I even said, “Get me a flight back to New England. I am homesick. Florida is not my place!” yes, I don't like Florida , there , I said it!

So there I was — mad, dramatic, and in a Lyft — very spiritual moment.

But when I arrived, a kind gentleman greeted me, and I smelled coffee and pastries… and suddenly my sanctification process started ☕🥐. I was still fuming inside, believe me , I wanted to talk to noone. I made the conversation with that gentleman short and told him look, I am a believer, It is okay! I wanted to be alone , he led me to the sanctuary and I sat there writing in my journal, in my mind with my thoughts and prayers.

Truth to be told, People were so friendly. The worship was beautiful. And the message — wow.
Not many churches preach in a way that challenges you. This one went deep into Scripture, even into the book of Revelation (yes — the book many churches treat like it is classified information).

“He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the churches” (Revelation 2:7).

The message reminded us that we must share our faith. And I felt convicted — in a good way. Because honestly, I have been quiet.
But “we cannot help speaking about what we have seen and heard” (Acts 4:20).

So here I am sharing with you:

Jesus is salvation.
Only through Him we receive eternal life.
“And this is the testimony: God has given us eternal life, and this life is in His Son” (1 John 5:11-12).

There is a New Jerusalem prepared for those who belong to Him (Revelation 21). That is our real home — not Florida, not New England 😄. I have to remind myself of this.

Any other way leads to eternal separation from God. The Bible says it with love and truth, and real love tells the truth.

So now you know.
The choice is yours.

As for me — I arrived angry, homesick, and dramatic… and I left with coffee in my hand, peace in my heart, and my boarding pass to heaven already confirmed ✈️.

“How lovely is Your dwelling place, Lord Almighty… Blessed are those who dwell in Your house” (Psalm 84:1-4).

This building used to be a library they rent there, so for those complaining about not being handicapped friendly I did see a ramp a  long ramp that leads to the entrance on the side of parking lot.
What I can tell you based on Sunday morning preaching , I would def visit again. My experience at City Lift Church has been phenomenal so far. Coming from an Organizational leadership perspective everything from the coffee station the times, the functionality, the structure, the delivery, and the communication has been very intentional. I don’t feel judged or pressured, I feel loved and accepted. City lift Church is welcoming and aesthetically pleasing.

The service is meaningful, powerful, uplifting, and engaging. The pastor has a way of connecting with all walks of life and making you feel seen and heard. The First Lady is always joyful, expresses gratitude, patient, and calm. Her harmonic tone brings ease yet pulls you in as she shares whether it’s a word from the Bible or a testimony.She’s a bright spot in an anyone’s day. The two together is dynamic you can see the hard work and hustle, but also see the softness and care for others. You can see their heart through their actions, their words and their presence.

And last, but not least my kids absolutely love it from the first day they stepped foot in the doors. The lessons are meaningful and fun, and it’s always great to discuss after church and always excited to go the next time they’re with Mommy. 10/10 experience! This is such a great church where the theology is sound and Pastor Matt teaches with clarity and conviction. The worship team truly creates an atmosphere that invites the presence of Jesus into the room.

And the community, just wow. We’re not meant to do life alone, and being part of this church is a beautiful reminder that God is in the “together” moments.

I’m so grateful for Pastor Matt and Pastor Alyssa and their obedience to God in creating a Christ-centered space for the people of South Florida.

If you haven’t visited yet, come join us at ArtServe at 10:30am! In the past, I was searching for a small church close to home. From the very first time I visited, I felt truly welcomed. That feeling stayed with me, and before I knew it, this became a place I can call my own church.
I’ve already started serving, and even though it has only been one month, it honestly feels like I’ve been here for a whole year. The love, connection, and sense of belonging have been unbelievable.
The pastor is truly inspiring, delivering messages that are both powerful and easy to understand. You can feel the genuine care and passion for the people and the community, which makes a big difference.
One thing I really appreciate is how comfortable and relaxed the atmosphere is—you don’t have to stress about what to wear, you can just come as you are. I love it here! The people are always so welcoming & kind. I’ve never felt pressured to serve God or participate but the pastors allow it come from your heart. Pastors are family orientated and really about the people. Worship is great and the preaching is biblical.

name: Citygate Ministries - Fort Myers Campus
reviewSummary:
Awesome place of praise and worship. The pastors are fun and very down to earth. The service is shorter than my past experience but the amount of teaching cannot compare to the longer services. At City Gate you get the Word, Ministries, encounters,and blessings. Most of all the Pastors and their wives are one of us on and off the alter. Thank you Jesus for answering my prayer as I transition to SWFL A place to call home and find family. They offer many groups and workshops. You can find community without judgement. This church has changed my life. CityGate is my home church and I so enjoy it! Seen in the videos and pictures in this review is a Sunday morning service and a couple pictures from Men of Honor/The Herd, CityGate’s Men’s Ministry on Tuesday evenings.

From the first time I walked through the doors, knowing only one person who attends, CityGate has always welcomed me in and encouraged me to become involved.

During my time, I have been able to volunteer at a women’s conference, be a youth group leader for 9th and 10th grade boys, be part of the choir, and everything else that I can’t remember.

I so appreciate that CityGate speaks life during this world living broken.

CityGate does not shy away from the difficult topics and approaches everything with a biblical context and focus.

Glad to be part of CityGate! The pastor called and completely agreed with my battle. Thank you guys for being vigilant.

Thanks for the call and look forward to the meet. This was my first experience and I loved the praise and joy.
Thank You God

name: Clearwater Community Church - Clearwater Campus
reviewSummary: I attended this church for about 4 months. It's a nice, easy going, medium-sized church. I was happy there until I learned that they prohibit women from attaining leadership roles within the church (such as becoming an "elder"). I spoke with one of the pastors and was offered a meeting so that he could explain their reasoning in depth. I declined, as there is nothing that he could say that would convince me to continue bringing my daughters to a church that intended to teach them that they are someone less qualified to lead just because they are women. Jesus preached inclusion and love, not division and discrimination. I will not be going back. I’ve been coming here about a year now and the preaching is awesome, straight out of the Bible. The people are warm and friendly and I truly look forward to seeing EVERYONE. If you’ve been thinking about joining us, just do it. You won’t be sorry. The worship service is pretty great too! I attended this church 3 times after moving down here trying to find the right church home. Great church, sticks to biblical teaching not all about a performance, motivational talk or lights/smoke show type of sermon which is a relief. That being said the third visit the sermon was about Matthew 34-36 and the topic of telling the truth. My 8 year old was present with me when of all examples the pastor decided to go into detail how Santa is a lie and not real. Which IS TRUE. I became a believer 1 year ago, my husband is not. I talked about not lying about Santa, he had no desire to nix that tradition. So when the kids asked I said nothing. So not to disrespect my husband or my God. If I were at dinner with an unbelieving family would I say 'Mommy and Daddy don't participate in grace because the are going to hell and don't believe.' is that true? Yes. Is there a GRACEFUL way to share truth that is not forceful or eager to spoil other's family traditions. Yes. Don't lie is pretty self explanatory, the nuances of application require wisdom. Lacking grace when explaining Jesus' teachings is just not for me, I won't be attending again. I love my church family. Have been a member for about two years. The teaching is sound and centered on God’s Word. Great programs for the kids, teens and adults of all ages. Come check it out! Wonderful church.  It hosts many recovery groups like CR and FA. A genuinely Christian Church. A truly spiritual place that preaches and teaches the Bible correctly. The staff and members are true Christians.  A genuinely friendly and welcoming place. You have to see it to appreciate it!

Colonial Church - St. Augustine Campus
reviewSummary: The cops threatened to forcefully remove my husband if he didn’t leave while he was having a panic attack. Distasteful and offensive at best. name: Commission Church - Plano Campus
reviewSummary:
Our family had been searching for a church where we could truly feel like we belong- just as we are. With two young daughters, including one on the autism spectrum, finding a welcoming and understanding environment was not easy.
From the moment we visited Commission Church, we felt that sense of acceptance. It’s a place where our child is embraced and supported, and that means everything to us. The church offers incredible childcare and even provides dedicated buddies for children with special needs, which is very amazing. This is a truly Spirit-filled and Bible-based church where the presence of God is real, word of god is taught in truth and you are welcomed just as you are.
Beyond that, there are so many opportunities to get connected, grow in faith, and build meaningful relationships with others. No matter your age or stage in life, there’s something for everyone. We truly feel blessed to be part of this church community and are so grateful we found a place where we are genuinely welcomed and loved. “This church is truly a place of God’s presence and genuine community. The worship is heartfelt, the teaching is biblically grounded, and the leadership demonstrates sincere care for people. I have personally experienced spiritual growth and encouragement through the ministry here. I highly recommend this church to anyone seeking a deeper relationship with God and a loving church family.” Commission Church has changed my life it is the true definition of what a church is suppose to be!! I have been going to Commission since June I am so grateful I listened to the Holy Spirit that led me to Commission! Paster and his wife are amazing the realest people I have ever met! You talk about the Holy Spirit moving come see us , come be apart of our mission!!! Loving God , loving our neighbors!! After visiting numerous churches in Fort Worth and Dallas, my wife and I landed at a Commission Church.  The people are so welcoming and kind! The pastor brings a fresh message that delivers the TRUTH in a loving and understanding way.  The church is diverse and is growing! My wife and I attend now with our kids.  Children’s, pre-teen, youth and young adult leaders are all genuinely caring people that truly want each person to feel connected and grow in their faith.  Love this place. 5 stars! We love Commission Church! My husband and I have been attending Commission Church for about a year and a half. Though we are introverts, the gentle way Pastor Ashish encourages people to get involved has helped us to find our place to serve. In serving, we have gotten to make new friends. I love the multicultural and multigenerational aspect of our church – so many people who love and respect each other.  I also love the Bible teaching and the opportunity to praise and worship the Lord!

name: Community Christian Church of Pompano Beach

The renovations and live worship at the Pompano Beach campus are amazing! I’m so excited to be attending here and meeting new people from the area. The Pastors are the “real-deal”. Both Pastors Jerry & Maria are powerful teacher. I love them.

This is a place to develop spiritual muscles and grow emotionally and spiritually. I love the teachings. Hearing and feeling God’s word come alive in my heart. It’s a loving wonderful awesome     place to experience God as you learn and worship God together in unity. You will most certainly feel the manifestation of His loving, powerful presence every Sunday!

There’s always a special visit from Holy Spirit. He always joins us. God is always present. This is a place of love. Everyone is accepted and will feel connected and loved. “Come taste and see that the Lord is Good”,

name: Coral Gables Baptist Church - Coral Gables Campus
reviewSummary:
FBC Coral Gables is a true blessing to the neighborhood. I recently visited for the second time and had a great experience at the Sunday Bible School. Everyone is caring, thoughtful and genuine. The church is a Christ-centered and bible-based place of worship and prayer. Sunday Service wonderful.
Tks God. This church is filled with the Holy Spirit And the Lord Jesus Christ is alive and well here!! Also just as a heads up at 11 AM is the Spanish worship service, call ahead for English service times!!

name: Coral Gables Congregational United Church of Christ
Coral Gables Congregational United Church of Christ - Coral Gables Campus
reviewSummary:

name: Countryside Christian Church - Clearwater Campus - Clearwater Campus
reviewSummary:
Me and my family have been attending Countryside Christian Church for about 3 years now. I just realized I have never done a review about it. There are so many great things about this church! Pastor Glen and his son Andrew ( as well as many others) do an amazing job at delivering the word in a easy to relate to way. They all teach straight out of the Bible and always make people feel welcomed and loved.

Our son has been attending the youth church there and absolutely loves it. This will be his second year attending the middle school /high school summer camp and he is so excited about it. If you have a high schooler or middle school age child I highly recommend this camp. The first time he went he came back and said he feels closer to God.

As a bonus there is a cafe inside of the church. We eat breakfast there every Sunday. They have pastries, fresh fruit, scrambled eggs with bacon and toast, breakfast burritos and much more. It's all very good food and very reasonably priced. We always look forward to eating breakfast before church starts.

If you're looking for a church that is non-denominational, preaches the good news, and lots of friendly people, this is the church you need to try. We love this church. Everyone is always friendly, the pastor is amazing and carries a well spoken candlelight service was amazing and the choir sung wonderfully songs, everybody knew, and songs we just learned. I would highly recommend this church. We have been attending Countryside Christian Church for almost 6 months now and absolutely love it! The worship team is fantastic and the sermons are always filled with valuable and meaningful messages - the pastors are amazing!! We’ve learned and grown so much in our faith already just in our short time here! ☺️💗 We always feel welcome and have invited numerous family members to attend and they all feel the same.

And their podcast is amazing!!!

We look forward to getting more involved and coming here for many years to come! ☺️ Countryside Christian Church is amazing!! My family and I all attend on Sundays and Midweek, and it is truly a great place with great leadership. Want to shout out Pastor Marcelo— he has poured into my son and made him feel comfortable going to youth group. All of the pastors at this church are incredible, and we are so grateful for Countryside. This month is officially one year for my husband Wayne and I attending Countryside Christian Church. We now consider it our church family. When we came a year ago for a Wednesday night worship service, our lives changed forever. For me, I felt a genuine sense of belonging. Despite the size, this church, the pastors and it's leaders make you feel so welcome, as if you're visiting family that you haven't seen for a long time. Pastor Glenn Davis is the lead pastor and such a down to earth man. He and his wife Elaine are exceptional stewards of God. He's a rare type of pastor, who leads from the sidelines matching the same challenges we all face in life. The culture he has created here is that "you never walk alone" and he's fostered a sense of peace for the church, knowing, that if you fall, you fall into the hands of people who truly love you. The Co-Pastor is his son, Pastor Andrew, and he is a vessel for deep truths and preaches with a purpose. He has an incredible ability to pull you into the word of God and His message and his passion for the Lord is catchier than his punchlines, it is such a joy to listen to him preaching. Pastor Marcelo is the executive pastor of "next gen" and online. He is an inspiration, especially for our youth. There is an undeniable old soul to the quality of his ministry. He echos great revivalst of the past that captivates and encourages you to dig deep within yourself and confront the person that God is calling you to be. Without hesitation, we quickly signed up for bible study, marriage group, woman's and men's small groups, we've taken the growth track class, volunteered a few times and are currently in Alpha. We're both ready to start serving and do whatever we can to be fully dedicated followers of Christ. Because of this church and the messages we've received from God through the leaders, through the small groups and the fellowship we've experienced here, we both have a new found and deeper love for God and pray His light will shine through us, and everyone we cross paths with.

name: Countryside Christian Church - South Tampa Campus
Countryside Christian Church - South Tampa Campus - Tampa (Hyde Park) Campus
reviewSummary:
A few years back, I surprised my mom for Mother's Day by showing up to church at Countryside Christian South Tampa, after some not-so-subtle "hints" that she'd like me to attend church with her since my younger sister who always went with her, had moved to TX. I made it a few more occasions the remainder of the year like most "Christians" often tend to do (you know, the big Christian holidays). I later committed to making it to communion Sunday each month the following year. And did so. After that, for the following year, I made a commitment to myself that I'd attend service as often as I could. I haven't looked back since. I'm a dreamer and often dream of winning that big lottery jackpot and moving somewhere that's much, much cooler and doesn't exist under the threat of hurricanes. Now, it actually kind of hurts me to think about not being able to be at church with the amazing people I have come to love over the past few years. We have a saying: "Welcome Home." And it really is the only way I could describe Countryside Christian Church. I attend the South Tampa campus and have made it to the main campus in Clearwater. The people are all the same. They're all wonderful and welcoming. Our leadership are all kind, loving, welcoming, and caring. If I'm sick and can't make it to service, I can always watch the streaming service, but it just isn't the same. I am glad I surprised my mom for Mother's Day when I did. And I am proud to be a member of CCC. I even took the step to be baptized as an adult (I was baptized as a teen, because it was the "cool" thing). It was truly one of the most amazing experiences. Come home to Countryside Christian Church - South Tampa. Countryside is truly an amazing church. Our entire family loves it! Our toddlers love going to their classes and always ask if it’s church day.
If your looking for a family friendly church that really live out what they believe you just found it. Countryside Sounth Tampa is truly a loving, helpful, and God-filled place. From the moment you walk through the doors, you're welcomed like family. The atmosphere is full of kindness and genuine care, and it's clear that the presence of God is at the center of everything they do.

There are so many ways to get involved—whether it’s through small groups, outreach programs, worship teams, youth ministries, or volunteer opportunities, there’s something for everyone. It’s more than just a church; it’s a place to grow, serve, and belong.

If you're looking for a church home where you can build real relationships and deepen your faith, Countryside Christian Church ST is a wonderful place to be. We first heard of Countryside when a chance meeting with a person in need spoke of their food pantry where he volunteered. We went to the South Tampa campus and were so warmly greeted that we felt like we were with family. We also found that the service was very accurately based on scripture, and very relevant to today's issues. The personalization with us, we realized, was the beginning of building a more personal relationship with Jesus. Clearly, landing on Countryside was not by chance! We love this church!!!  Such a great experience for our family to have a place where we felt welcome from the moment we parked our car.  Everyone is so welcoming and the atmosphere is great.  You are greeted at the door by friendly people who not only make you feel welcome but make it a priority to provide your family with an amazing experience.  Countryside South Tampa Campus has something for everyone in our family from childcare to youth group, adult groups and opportunities to serve at the church and in the community with their Helping Hands ministry.   Ever since attending they have always provided an exceptional Bible based Godly message with a wonderful worship experience.  Pastor Dan and his amazing staff were especially wonderful to me and my family and I would highly recommend this church to anyone who is looking to have a closer relationship with God.  My wife and I whole heartedly believe that Countryside South Tampa can make a huge impact in your life and your families the same way it has for ours.

name: Courageous Church - Tampa (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
If you’re looking for a church home in Tampa, this is it.

I was searching for a place where I could hear the Lord clearly and grow deeper in my faith — and I found that here. The Word is powerful, the atmosphere is genuine, and the presence of God is real.

As a mom of kids under 11, the children’s ministry means everything to me. My girls love coming to church, and that alone speaks volumes. We didn’t just find a church — we found community.

If you’re looking for a place to belong and grow, come visit. It feels like home. 🕊️✨

If you want it even punchier or a little more fire in it, say the word. Courageous Church has transformed my entire family. The pastors lead with their entire heart and the passion they have for the Lord’s people is evident in everything they do and say. We are eternally grateful for Pastor Ben and Pastor Wendy’s faithful “yes” to the people of Courage Church and advancing the kingdom of God. I love Courageous Church! I have found a wonderful church family through the courageous life program here and have been attending for over a year. I love serving with the children and in production! This is an amazing mid size church on fire for the Lord! I would recommend this church for young adults, families, people that have been in church their whole life and children! Pastor Ben and Pastor Wendy care so much about everyone who steps into this building and you will not leave the same! Courageous Church is an amazing local church right in the heart of Tampa 🙏 I’m grateful for everything they do to impact the community. If you’re looking for a Bible-based church where you can truly grow in your relationship with God, find family, and be encouraged in your faith alongside other believers that are on fire for the Lord… Courageous Church needs to be your church home! I mean.....just look at my picture! That picture I took my first time to Courageous Church and I am still here!!  God is all up and through this church. I am so happy I decided to come to this church and become a member. The pastors actually WANT to get to know you personally!! I haven't joined a church since I was a young child and I finally have a church that I feel at home at!! I was even re-baptized ❤️

reviewSummary: A multi-generational, Filipino-American church that teaches you the Bible and how to grow your relationship with Jesus. For the music worship ministry, it is a mix of contemporary and hymns for the band and the choir. There are also ministries for kids, discipleship, and bible study groups for everyone to join. I've been here for 6+ years since I was in high school and there is no other group I'd like to call my church family. Check out their FB for more photos. For anyone seeking to know more who Jesus is, you are always welcome to join any of the groups or ministries :D Covenant Christian Church is a very friendly and loving church , you will be feed spiritually and materially . A lot of opportunity that you can be involved in any area of ministries.. Come and join with  us this Sunday . Praise The Lord. We finally found the house of God where we can worship and glorify Our Lord Jesus Christ. A beautiful and welcoming place to praise the Lord with wonderful people. Great fellowship! God is glorified in this church!

name: Crossbridge Church | Brickell - Miami (Downtown/Brickell) Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been going to Crossbridge Brickell, and it’s honestly one of the friendliest and most down-to-earth churches I’ve been to. The people are warm, welcoming, and really care about building community. What stands out is how seriously they take living with purpose — not just at church, but in everyday life.

The messages on Sundays are focused on the life and teachings of Jesus, and they do a great job of showing how that applies to real life — especially here in Miami. The talks are rooted in the Bible but easy to understand, relatable, and engaging.

They also care a lot about the city — the church regularly supports local nonprofits and encourages people to give back and help those in need. You’ll find a good mix of people here — lots of young professionals (especially in medicine and finance), but also families, kids, and older folks. There’s a great children’s program, and small group meetups during the week help people build friendships and grow personally and spiritually.

On top of that, they host fun events like cookouts and parties where everyone’s welcome, even if you’ve never been to church before. They also occasionally team up with other local churches for worship music nights, cookouts, and community outreach.

If you’re in Brickell and looking for a place that combines meaningful teaching, uplifting music, and a genuine sense of community, I highly recommend checking out Crossbridge Brickell. Here you can belong before you believe! My husband was a skeptic and now is a firm believer all in part to Crossbridge teachings. This church will meet you where you are.

As a person who approaches finding a  church very cautiously , you never know if a church is sticking to biblical teaching until you hang around for awhile. Crossbridge is an amazing gem in the heart of Brickle.  My husband and I recently became official members because we believe in the work their doing.

Our lead pastor Carter has an incredible gift for sharing scripture in a way that feels practical. I always leave church better equipped to progress in my faith.  . Johnny our campus pastor is also so personable, and integral to all of the progession of the church.

It doesn't stop there The community at Crossbridge is SO WELCOMING, no matter how much you may want to run out of there right after service, the more you linger  you start to make meaningful connection . Also Crossbridge has a lot of community driven events  both for the broader city of Miami and the church body including movie nights, dinner parties, food drives , marches, Bible studies and more.

God is doing great things through Crossbridge!
Highly recommend. This is the best church ⛪️ I have ever seen in my life ❤️! I love it, awesome 👌 people and good vibes ❤️ 🙌 💜 God bless pastor John 🙏 his great ! Highly recommend for everyone to go and visit! AMEN Put God first in everything you do! Excellent worship and teaching on Sundays!  Many opportunities go deeper - both in community and in God's Word - throughout the week.  After living decades in another city, Crossbridge was a key factor in helping us feel like Miami was "home." I visited Crossbridge Brickel two years ago and quickly found it to be a community of Christ centered believers with solid Biblical teaching and cross focused worship.   I now call it my church home.  If you are looking for a church home.  Visit!   You won’t be disappointed

name: Crossbridge Church Pinecrest - Pinecrest / South Miami Campus
reviewSummary:
Cross Bridge Pinecrest is truly a special place. From the moment you walk in, you feel a sense of care, professionalism, and genuine community. The environment is welcoming, well-organized, and thoughtfully run, with a team that is attentive, kind, and deeply committed to excellence.

What truly sets Cross Bridge Pinecrest apart is the heart behind everything they do. You can tell there is intention, integrity, and passion woven into the culture. Communication is clear, standards are high, and the overall experience consistently exceeds expectations.

Highly recommended to anyone looking for a trusted, high-quality, and uplifting environment in Pinecrest. A true gem in the community. 💫 CrossBridge is one of the most important parts of our lives today. We were deeply blessed that it was our first church when we moved to Miami nine years ago.

Our closest friends are from CrossBridge Pinecrest. We share our challenges and our victories, and there is always someone walking alongside us through every season of the year.

Through this community, our faith in God grows stronger each day. CrossBridge also creates many opportunities and events that help us connect with others and truly feel supported. Pastors Felipe and Marcus are wise, kind, approachable, and genuine in their love for God.

We are truly blessed to be here. Our lives would not have the same peace in our souls without CrossBridge, our friends, and their prayers.

Thank you, CrossBridge Pinecrest My husband and I have called this place our spiritual home for 18 years. It has been a place to grow in our faith, our knowledge of the Bible, and most importantly, to grow in and be held accountable by a loving community that is corporately committed to honoring God. This church is a reflection of the diversity of Miami. I love playing my violin in the band and our kids are absolutely at home and comfortable here. Their lessons are not watered down, but they challenge them and stay focused on the truth of the radical love of our savior, Jesus. This is a place where anybody can come and belong even before they believe. Questions and discussions are welcome. Atmosphere is modern but not too contemporary, reverent, warm, fantastic musicians and excellent practical teaching. Have been attending for 12 years. Mix of all ages and rich community building and support. Multi cultural and welcoming to all. We were looking for a non-political church where the Word of God is preached truthfully, and where we could find fellowship with other believers. We have recently started attending Crossbridge Pinecrest, and we always feel welcomed. We enjoy the worship services and the sermons. There are many groups available to help us grow spiritually, along with various activities and events. For women, there is a monthly gathering that features inspiring testimonies to encourage one another. We are hopeful that we will find what we were looking for in this church. ❤️

name: CrossRoads - Daytona Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I stand corrected, the church’s website does not identify itself as an Independent Fundamentalist Baptist Church. Google identifies Cross Roads church as an Independent Fundamentalist Baptist Church.

Contemporary music with electric guitar and drums on the platform. Service was opened by a woman (lead singer) who opened the service with prayer (if correct, there is a chapter in Corinthian’s that speaks about women leading the service).

In regards to my comment on a woman opening the service in prayer, please read 1st Corinthians Chapter 14 and 1st Timothy Chapter 2. Women are an extremely intricate part of any church ministry, however, they are not to lead the men.

Most importantly, there was NO presentation of the Gospel to the lost / unsaved visitors present! A presentation (invitation) of the Gospel should always be given to afford the lost to respond. There was NO presentation or even an altar call.

It appears the Pastor is more interested in pleasing his congregation than preaching biblical truths and salvation by and through Jesus Christ! Loved the Walk Through Bethlehem special event.  Very loving and kind church community dramatization of time of Christ's birth place. CrossRoads church has a great children and youth ministries that our kids enjoy. Preaching is focused on teaching the Bible and how to apply it to your life. We also have Bible Institute classes that you can take for audit or credit. We also have an indoor playground with a cafe that is open during the week. This is the same church that I went to one afternoon. On line it said it was open. Certain times during the day. I was new here in fl and desperately needed to speak to a pastor.
When I got there there 2 cars there so I knew someone was was there. After all it said they were open
I went to door and it was locked. I knocked. I knocked and I knocked. Then another car came in and went further down to park and disappeared in to another door but I believe still connected to building. I ran down there. I knocked. I knocked and I knocked. No answer. As I stopped knocking someone must have very quickly come out of the first glass door part I was knocking at, becouse in a blink a car drove away. Back up to glass doors and gave it one more try. ..
I came home and waited for that call from the pastor himself whom I had left it with promising he'd return thier call. Needless to say, I never got a call like he said on his messege.
Too bad .it looked so pretty. Was looking right now today dec 23 2025 for a church open Xmas eve..candl light. Upon comming to website I only then saw by pictures it was the same church & Pastor who ignored both my knock and my call. I was introduced to crossroads three years ago coming here as a snowbird. Loving and caring. The pastors are wonderful. From the music to the worship and Messages the spirit of our Saviour is felt in a wonderful way. God Bless this church.

name: Destiny Chuch of Jacksonville - Jacksonville (Southside) Campus
reviewSummary:
Destiny Church of Jacksonville is such an incredible place to be! It’s a non-denominational church that’s full of life, positivity, and genuine people. I’ve been going with my boyfriend and his family, and every time we go, I leave feeling encouraged and uplifted. The worship is powerful, the messages are always meaningful and easy to connect with, and everyone there is so welcoming. You can really feel God’s presence in the room. Every message is heartfelt and spoken straight from the Bible. I’m so thankful to be apart of this church it truly feels like home! About 10 years ago, my family was looking for a non denominational church in the Jacksonville area when we came across destiny church! We came and immediately got connected through family friends of ours, and we haven’t looked back since! Since then my parents, girlfriend and I have joined the serve team and attended on Sunday. It’s an amazing spirit filled environment with donuts and lemonade every morning! The people are very welcoming and loving! The message is always STRIGHT from the word and the worship is incredible. We are in love with this church! On the outside.it may not look like much but dont judge a book by its cover. First let me say you are greeted and welcomed with open hearts and arms as well as coffee,doughnut and fruit.
The seating was the most comfortable you will ever find for Any church services . The Pastor and Service was excellent and the Spirit of the Holy Ghost Was in the House Praise God.
This is Definitely Word Checking Out.  Hope to See Ya There. Praying For You and Yours. May God Bless and Keep Yall till We meet and Always. Destiny Church is a spirit-filled non-denominational church in Jacksonville that truly makes you feel at home. From the moment I walked in, people were friendly and welcoming. The community is genuine and it’s clear that everyone is valued. The worship is powerful and full of life, and you can tell the team is passionate about creating an atmosphere where people can encounter God. The preaching is straight from the Bible, and it’s always relevant and easy to apply to everyday life. Every message challenges and encourages me in my faith. If you’re searching for a Christian church in Jacksonville that’s full of God’s presence, strong teaching, and a great sense of community, Destiny Church is the place to go. I moved to Jax in 2018 and this makes the third church I have attended since moving and it will be the final church I attend because I have found my church home. What an amazing group of people who make you feel welcome, and just like family from your very first visit to your twentieth visit. Pastor Chris is the real deal and isn't afraid to step on toes and preach the truth... the spirit of the Lord of felt in this church...  each and every Sunday through praise and worship. Come check it out.

name: Discover Life Church | Melbourne Campus - Melbourne Campus
reviewSummary: I am visiting Discover Life Church in Melbourne. I first began attending the Viera campus, and I thank God for allowing me to be part of this beautiful congregation. I pray for the Pastor, the leaders, and everyone who comes together to pray, intercede, and do God’s good work. May His purpose be fulfilled in our lives, and may we continue sharing His love and the message of salvation with others. May God continue to bless this church abundantly. Very disappointed in this church. It was our first time attending with my husband and our 12 month old baby. We haven’t been to church in months and we were really excited to get back into it as we felt that’s what we needed in our lives. We were enjoying the message the pastor was preaching. Occasionally our baby would make a small noise maybe 2-3 times. Everyone got loud at a point and she also did because she is in the stage of copying other people’s noises. She never cried or screamed and they kicked us out. They said “we are going to have to ask you to go to a different area in the church, we are recording”. This was probably the most disappointing experience I’ve ever had in my life. Jesus would never do that. Apart of the message was “read the room” and trust me we read the room, if she was crying we would’ve left, if she was screaming we of course would’ve left. She made the tiniest noise twice and that was enough to kick a family out. So clearly recording the message and making sure the recording isn’t ruined is more important than the family showing up to worship Jesus with their baby. They state they have a family room where you can watch it on the screen and wanted to send us there but at that point it wasn’t worth it to us. We will never be back and we’re just so disappointed in this experience here. I prefer not to say how I truly feel about this church except to say, I pray they become more approachable,  very sad If you are looking for a church that is Spirit filled, speaks truth over you,  multicultural, welcoming, genuinely loves everyone, helps the community, doesn’t judge, has a come as you are mentality and offers a family like community, then this is the church for you! My family searched for a church home for a long time and once we found discover life we knew this was it. Pastor Ken is 💯🙏 a REAL MAN, one that Loves Jesus and the MEN of our community.   I'm encouraged by Pastors line Ken because HE tells it like it is "straight no chaser" JUST like Jesus does and backs EVERYTHING up with the very word of God, the truth is the truth and if that hurts one's feelings, then maybe YOUR feelings needed to be hurt in order for ETERNAL REWARDS to manifest in the lives of the believer or the LOST....... Pastor Ken and the team of associate Pastors, elders and volunteers truly care about YOUR healing and eternal inheritance and will stop at nothing to show you how to develop a relationship and direct access to THE GREAT PHYSICIAN, JESUS CHRIST OUR LORD.   All men need to register for the next FIGHT CLUB at Discover Life, there is sooooo much power in a room full of men worshipping God on a FRIDAY night when the rest of the world chooses otherwise devicive influence and consequences.

name: Downtown Harbor Church - Fort Lauderdale Campus
reviewSummary:
Amazing community and church for our family.  Their services always have a great message to carry along throughout our days ahead.  Band is great. The people are so kind and love the child care during the service.  Highly recommended if you truly want to understand the scripture and how to apply it in your own life and modern day. Every Sunday my husband and I are there, pastor John and Adam are so great, the singers are fantastic   we want to stay longer, cant wait for Sundays to get here :) Good word and Good vibes, but more importantly, the pastors are knowledgeable of the word and intelligent. Great way to start your Sunday and a new week! I will be going back soon. God bless! ( only 4 stars because parking is a challenge). Amazing leadership team. From the moment you walk in you are welcomed, truly welcomed. Great music and practical real life messages add to the overall experience.

For those with children, the youth ministry is just as great. The staff and volunteers are focused on building relationships with the kids while providing the kids with biblical lessons they can relate to.

If you are looking for an authentic church home, where all are welcome no matter where you are in you walk, this is the place for you! I don’t believe there’s a “perfect” church

The singers could sing
The message was Christmas 101
This could be a two star
They could be four star
I’d have to be here 3+ services
But I never heard repent…
No salvation without repentance.

Jesus is Lord
Repent Believe Follow Jesus

name: Eastside Christian Church - Irvine - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary: Loved this friendly church on my birthday with my son, Nicholas, eating popcorn and drinking coffee while watching parts of the movie Otto with Tom Hanks! Pastor Gene Apple then weaved in a message about how helping/blessing others helps/blesses us - just beautiful 🥹🙏❤️ Amazing worship team, beautiful Irvine location, nice building, friendly staff and godly Bible-based preaching - well-done Eastside Irvine! 👏👏👏 I used to attend the Anaheim location of Eastside Christian Church, but now the Irvine location is much closer to home. The welcoming atmosphere and the friendliness of all the volunteers make it a great place to be. Lovely, friendly Bible teaching church. Awesome Church and awesome people! This Church is for Everyone

name: Echo Life Church - Pensacola Campus
reviewSummary:
Came here looking for a bold, Bible-based church with real conviction, left disappointed. They had a woman come up claiming to be one of the pastors/leaders which is clearly not biblical. Then they promoted a “merch drop” during service like it’s a streetwear brand. If you’re serious about Scripture and want a church that isn’t trying to be trendy, this probably isn’t it. Echo Life Church has been such a blessing for me and my family. We first visited in May, just a week after Easter, and it immediately felt different in the best way. After being away from church for over 10 years, it’s refreshing to be somewhere that doesn’t pressure you but lets you reconnect with God at your own pace.

The pastors’ messages are always heartfelt and easy to relate to. The kids’ program is amazing, the staff are kind, and the coffee shop is such a great touch. Echo Life has helped me grow closer to God in a way that feels real and personal. I’m so grateful for this church and the community we’ve found here. Wow! This was our first time at Echo Life Church! It just happened to be their 7th Year Celebration! We really enjoyed seeing their grassroots slide presentation and how they have become who they are today! Amazing testimony to faithfulness and determination 🙌 👏 🙏 ❤️ ✨️
Pastor Joe had a great sermon and Pastor Suzannah, his wife, was one of the energetic Music  Praise Team members!
They have 2 services- 9 a.m. & 10:45 a.m. We are going to participate in their Steps program next week after the last service to learn more about the church and how to serve!

Update! Now it's July and I can't say enough wonderful things about Echo Life Church! They have expanded to 3 services, since I started attending 5 months ago! There is 8 a.m., 9:45, and 11:30! We go to the 9:45 and it's packed out! I serve as a Greeter at 8 a.m. and that service is quite full too! But, don't be discouraged by that! There's room for everyone!!! Pastors Joe and Suzanna are doing an absolutely wonderful job! 👏 The service starts with wonderful live music that changes members, so everyone who wants to serve can! I love the energy and words to the lyrics on 3 screens! Who doesn't want to not praise the Lord with great worship 🙌 music? Believe me! If you and your family and friends, are searching for a happier life with Jesus, Echo Life Church is an absolutely awesome place to start! They have a great place for your kids at Echo Life Children's Church too! Enjoy a nice cup of coffee before and after the service too! Bring it into the service too! Our city is ready for a revival, like the message from Pastor Joe Driver today, who incorporated film clips from the "Jesus Revolution" and "The Chosen" today! We'll have 2 more Movie Summer Sundays- July 14 & 21, 2024! We even have bagged popcorn 🍿 and sodas, so y'all join us! You won't be disappointed!!! Come on Pensacola!!!! This church will put the fresh wind in your sails! The team of people here go above and beyond the church norm. My wife and I attended over a dozen other churches in Pensacola before finding Echo Life. While life took us back to the Midwest a couple of years later, we still watch online every Sunday. I simply can't recommend enough for you to try this church out!
All the best, -Alex This church is led by an absolute amazing group of pastors who genuinely care about everybody has an individual no matter how much or how big the church will grow. They will continually work to get to know you. This The first time in this church I was invited by a friend and upon walking in I was welcomed with nothing but hospitality and warmth. It definitely made me feel like I was already a part of the community. Echo Life Church is definitely an impact I will never forget I will always be grateful for In my life as it has allowed me to build my faith on levels I did not know existed!

Give this church a visit!!

name: Element3 Church - Tallahassee Campus
reviewSummary:
I'm still listening to old CDs from this church. They just gave them away for free over 15 years ago but the CDs are still bearing fruit. Thank you. People here are dedicated to understanding God's word and bringing His word to the world.
There are many ways to serve the community and the world. A Wonderful & welcoming house of worship where one can become a disciple of Christ, find ways where you can help and serve others near & far. Increase your knowledge and understanding of Scripture.

E3 has become my spiritual home. I love how inclusive this church is. So welcoming to everyone who wants to worship at every phase of their faith journey. I am very grateful to have been able to call Element3 Church home over the past few years. Our church has been cautious through the pandemic, but we have been faithful and committed to continue creating opportunities for worship, even when those opportunities have been digital. I'm really excited about our progress as our country finds its way beyond the pandemic, and I'm looking forward to seeing God do amazing things in the years to come. Are we the right church family for you to learn to follow Christ in? I hope so. We'd love for you to come out and visit and see. You can also join us online each Sunday at 10:00 AM at element3.online.church.

name: Elevate Life Church
reviewSummary: A modern, energetic church in Frisco with contemporary worship and a focus on elevating the community.

name: Elevate Miami Church - Coral Gables Campus
reviewSummary:
Great Church, Great Pastor's, Great Place
It's contemporary and very balanced with the word and spiritual gifts, it's a very prophetic place and the people are very nice. I love the people here. I had great experiences here and consider them to a great church to come and visit if your in the area. It's home for us.  We have been part of this church family for years.  Many special events are shared during the holidays and all year long.  Fall and Winter are my favorite!  Can't wait for Sunday mornings.  It's what you need to get you through the week.  Jesus is the Reason for the Season! I agree somewhat with one of the posts here.  The worship is amazing and that the sermon is a bit too long.  However!  It is by far NOT boring!  Pastor Kevin is an amazing teacher and the time goes by very fast.  Because it's Sunday and I do spend time with my family, yes, it would be best if the preaching was shorter, but we should not tell the spirit what to do and I am sure the pastor is being guided by it.  And yes, all churches need more bodies of Christ, but if we are going too judge it by this and other small details, no one would go to any.  I have been going for over a month, but due to my job, I haven not been able to go every Sunday.  I follow the sermons on Sound Cloud and wish I could just go.  It really is much better bring there.  If you think it needs members, then come and give this church the 5 stars it deserves! Only God knows us perfectly. He used Pastor Kevin and Jeremiah to confirm and give me direction in specific and accurate prophetic words last Sunday. Truth resonates from the teaching and accountability of this ministry which bears great fruit! I immediately moved in the favor if God toward my destiny! Perfect love casts out fear. It's a new day and God has great plans for your life too! Listening to the previous sermons via the cloud now that I'm back in Austin...so thankful for godly men and women who are called to preach, teach and declare heaven on Earth!! Go GOD!! I love this church! The preaching is on amazing! I can’t get enough, the word is preached and you know it’s set you free to help you go to the next level! If you want to grow in Christ this is the church to go to! It’s like a small church in a big city. They have everything you need there. Prayer, God’s Love, Freedom, they have coffee & bagels in the Sunday service. The Pastor has a heart for his people very caring and his wife is so kind and loving, I am so happy my son found this church! Couldn’t be any happier. ❤️✨❤️✨❤️✨
