name: Elevation Church
reviewSummary: Known globally for Elevation Worship music. Steven Furtick's preaching is described as 'dynamic' and 'engaging'. The atmosphere is high-energy, concert-like, and attracts a younger demographic.

name: Elim Lutheran Church
reviewSummary: A beautiful historic church building with a wonderful, progressive ELCA congregation.

name: Engage Church - Tallahassee Campus
reviewSummary: Simply the best church in the world. Always focused on the bigger mission, the bigger picture, while telling the biggest more beautiful story of how Jesus came to save mankind. Thank you for Engage. Pastor Adrian is the goat idc. What I like about Engage is the relentless pursuit of Christ and the love that I have received here. Everyone loves me and it’s something that I have never really felt from a lot of other churches. Also, it’s one of the only places I’ve seen where people are actually TRYING to get Christ’s love 24/7, I’ve experienced a lot of fakeness in other places and would always view religion on a negative aspect. Engage has shown me love from the Father is such a powerful way that there’s no other church. Very real bible based teaching. If you want "feel good" non challenging teachings this might not be your cup o tea. I would encourage anyone looking for a church home, anyone looking to fill that God sized hole in your soul, anyone questioning, seeking, to come in give yourself a chance to find what your looking for. The people are friendly, helpful ,non judgmental, and welcoming. We have found a home. Definitely different than any other church I've been to. The people are genuine, you can come as you are, they talk about real life, real issues and keep Jesus at the center. They're creative and intentional about engaging the city they are a part of. Plus worship is lit and Pastor Adrian is always on point. I love being a part of Engage Church because it is one of the only places in my life where I can tangibly experience God's kingdom and its vastness. I love Engage because I'm challenged to never become comfortable where I am, and I am encouraged to learn more every day. I love that my gifts and talents, no matter how small or insignificant they seem, are valued.

name: Excel Church - Jacksonville (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Terribly rude and not very churchly to have your security ask 3 ladies and 2 kids to not sit at your benches and ask them to leave because it's private property. you should be ashamaded of yourselves that you'd rather have an empty courtyard, than filled with a couple women and children. shameful. My wife and I just moved here and fell in love with this church. Great place for children, teens, young adults, and adults to experience Christ in fullness. This place is laid back and arms open, but they don't compromise the Gospel. The church is very friendly and loving. The worship is comparable to HillSong!! **Seriously!! The Holy Spirit is moving in this place. Come check it out It's difficult for me to communicate my full affection for this church.  I attended for 6 years before moving out of the state of Florida.  I have spent 6 more years looking for a church like this one, without success.  The wisest, most genuine, most caring, group of people I've ever met.  The quality of teaching has few peers.  They are proactively involved in their city.  If you are looking for a church home, you should try Excel Church. My family and I relocated to FL a little over a month ago. We do not know anyone in the area and was looking for a church. I was a little hesitate to use google to find a church because I believe you have to be led by God in finding a church. To me googling churches is so impersonal.  Despite my discomfort...I decided to google churches because I had no other choice. I came across Excel Church and attended service. I am so happy I did. They have youth ministry for all ages and Pastor Derrick was great! His delivery was so clear and precise. I did not leave asking myself "What was the message".

If you are new to Jacksonville looking for a church...God will lead you. If you are still unsure check out Excel Church on YouTube and listen to Pastor Derrick message and let the spirit guide you on deciding of this is the place you should be. No frills and show here. Plain and simple truth. The Word of God spoken, taught with simplicity and understanding. Come as you are, but expect to be welcomed and treated with so much love and respect. Pastor Mike and Connie, along with their team of ministers, leaders, and congregation are truly about the business of God. I am not a member, but visit as often as I can, and when I can't there is I-Church.

name: Experience Church - Tallahassee Campus
reviewSummary: Moving away/just attended my last service and so so sad to be leaving this church. Genuinely one of the most welcoming, bright, and truly joyful churches I’ve ever been a part of. Was invited once by a friend and was hooked immediately. Pastor Jordan is not only hilarious but does an amazing job preaching the word AND stands by the door after and personally thanks every person for coming. If you have had bad experiences before and feel like church isn’t for you I truly urge to you to come try experience for a service- you will be welcomed like a friend just like I was. A group of people that truly practice what they preach and love like Jesus. This is the only church where I was greeted outside, at the front door, the sanctuary door and by some others on my way in.  And the greeters seem genuinely happy to serve.  I had visited a few other churches,  but Experience Church is the friendliest I've been to locally.  Great worship and applicable, relevant sermons.  Grateful. My family has attended Experience Church for about a year. From the very beginning we were welcomed with open arms and immediately felt at home. Our family supports the vision of the church and have so much respect for our Pastors and the way they lead and take time to get to know and understand you. Our kids love our church home as well and the youth group is amazing! The teaching from the pulpit to youth is relevant for today and encourages you to be your best self and make serving Jesus priority in your daily life. Worship is wonderful and the teaching bible based! If you're looking for a church family come check us out! You will find small groups to connect with and areas to serve in, if you desire. We'd love to get to know you and am certain you will find Hope, Healing, and a Home! Experience church is an incredible church! From the first day we went we felt welcomed and loved. People want genuine friendships with you. It is a place of wonderful community. Pastor Jordan and Spencer are great leaders! The messages always speak to me and encourage me. It’s a multicultural church where everyone is welcome. Experience Church is one of the friendliest churches I have ever attended.  From the moment you walk in the door, you feel at home with family.  The music is uplifting and encouraging, the preaching is always laid out in a way that allows me to really understand and hear Gods message.  Welcoming, casual and Dynamic!

name: Faith Christian Church - Clearwater Campus
reviewSummary:
What a great experience visiting this congregation.  My spirit leapt the moment I walked in. We were passing through as we continue on the Americas great loop but i wish that I could attend every week.
If you want or need to experience God’s presence go to a Sunday praise and worship service here. Full gospel teaching, pastor and the team members are humble, gracious and true servants of Christ. Wonderful to be in the presence of the Lord! Great church friendly loving people :) Great out reach missionary opportunities. It is right on it
And you can feel God is there
The word it on point Great place to Worship! All feel welcome there!

name: Faith Church | West Palm Beach - West Palm Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Love this church so much!! Anyone is welcome! Service is Sundays at 10am in the high school. Always uplifting and very easy to get connected if you choose to. Amazing staff and always preaching from the Bible. Absolutely LOVE Faith Church, Lots of friendly people who care and Family oriented. Everyone is welcomed with open arms and a cheerful attitude.  Pastors David and Nicole Crank are Absolutely AMAZING people. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a church that puts the Lord First, and wanting to become part of our family. Love Faith Church I mostly go on line no transportation but these past 2 Sundays I have been blessed with a ride and have fully enjoy being in God’s house. The music the people Pastor’s absolutely amazing. Come join Faith Church you won’t regret it. It is not boring at all. Very educational and fun. This church is inside of Palm Beach Lakes High school, and I really hope they are able to get a permanent location because they are doing great things there.

I am visiting from out of state and went with a family member, and I love how diverse the people are and how friendly everyone was. The pastor was live on screen today since he was at the other location for baptisms, but that didn't stop him from making me feel connected to the sermon and what he had to say.

He has a hilarious and entertaining personality, and he isn't afraid to be vulnerable and honest about his own shortcomings and mistakes in order to bring people to the joy and goodness of Jesus.

If you have never been to church or are looking for a church home, try this place out. It will change your life. Even though we entered through the wrong door Pastor Austin and Pastor David greeted us with open arms and showed us the way to join into this loving congregation.  I love this church because no matter where you are from or how you got here they make you feel welcome. They are committed to inspiring you with an awesome worship service and incredible sermons spoken that help you experience the true Love of God. Thank you

name: Faith Episcopal Church
reviewSummary: A peaceful and exceptionally friendly local parish. Truly open hearts and minds.

name: Faithlife Church - Port Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
This church community has been such a game changer in my walk with the Lord. The people are kind friendly, and genuinely do life together. The discipleship at this church is intentional, and biblically sound. So thankful for this church and its people. Couldn’t recommend it more. Faithlife Church is a vibrant, welcoming, and deeply connected community where faith truly comes to life. From the moment you arrive, you can feel the love, energy, and purpose that flow through every part of this church.
The worship is powerful and spirit-led, the teaching is biblically sound and incredibly relevant, and the atmosphere is full of hope and joy. Every message encourages you to grow spiritually and live out your faith in practical, meaningful ways.
What makes Faithlife Church stand out is its heart for people. Whether it’s through local outreach, youth programs, small groups, or simply being there for each other, this church lives out the message of Jesus in everyday life. It’s a place where everyone, no matter their background or season of life, can find belonging, support, and purpose.
There’s something special happening at Faithlife. It’s not just about Sunday services, it’s about building relationships, impacting the community, and being part of a church that truly lives by faith and love. This church has changed my life! Great community, close knit family feel. Love the House young adults group and Rooted youth group, welcoming and warm environment to grow with one another and most importantly your relationship with Jesus. This is truly a spirit filled church. This is the first spirit filled church I have ever attended and you certainly know you have been to church after you have been to this church.  Our Pastor and his family are wonderful.   I have been a member of this church for 13 years and have been blessed in so many ways. Come join us.  You will love it. This church has questionable theology and preaches out of a paraphrased Bible "translation". The music is SO loud, it's uncomfortable. They bribe the kids with video games and candy. And if that is not bad enough, when we visited for the 3rd time, the pastor's wife told me my kids were not welcome in the sanctuary because they are a distraction, and that I should sit in the nursery with them if they won't stay alone. They "love kids" if they don't actually have to see them. So if you want a church with half truth preaching and anti-family culture, this is the place for you!

name: Family Church - St. Augustine Campus
reviewSummary:
These people are some of the best in the world. They are certainly doing God's work as instructed in the Bible, you should read it, well worth your time! This church is fabulous. It is exactly what I have been searching for. Come as you are....if you want to dress up, okay. If you feel like getting spiritually stronger in jeans, that's cool too. You can literally feel God's energy through the assistant pastor who preached last week. GOING tomorrow to listen again. I love ❤️ their music too before and after the sermon. They also volunteer their services through their awesome food pantry, which is held on the 1st and 3rd Saturday of every month. 8am-10am. Truly we were BLESSED TO COME HERE THANK YOU  😊 🙏 I wasn't sure when the Food Bank was. I finally found out its still on the 1st & 3rd Saturday, from 8-10am.

Wherever we saw it listed on Thursday is NOT CORRECT.

This is a great food bank. I bring my elderly friend here once a month. It really helps her out, since she can't drive anymore. The food they give out is really good. It helps when you're on a fixed income and the price of food has gone up so much. Thank you so much for what you do for the community. God bless you. Real deal preaching, truth, no neo-liberal "church" doctrine, Bible based church. Very welcoming, our daughter loves the kids ministry and we have been welcomed warmly every time we have been. Both the pastor and the associate pastor present a fiery sermon that both engage, as well as challenge the congregation. "Family" is the right name, because that's how you feel when you are here. If you are looking for a place to grow in you faith, look no further than Family Church.

name: Family Church Downtown - West Palm Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Super thankful to call these amazing family of God my church family!!! They have something for all ages and all stages of life at first it was a bit rocky but once I got to learn more about the foundation of the church and what they are about God really laid it on my heart to not only attend the church but to serve this amazing church and spread the gospel of Jesus to our neighbors and each part of the serving team whether it be on Sunday mornings or Thursday nights all come together as one and I would Highly recommend this church to everyone super Thankful and blessed for this church!! Let the record show: I am writing this review to inform, not to attack.

In June 2025, I reported a sexual assault by a member of Family Church Young Adults. From the beginning, my experience has been deeply disappointing. Instead of pastoral care, I was met with disbelief, spiritual manipulation, and attempts to silence me “for the sake of unity.” I was told that if I spoke out, I would be causing division in the body of Christ.

No one from leadership consistently walked alongside me, checked on my well-being, or provided meaningful protection (as they are trained and obligated to do). At one point, I was even pressured to meet face-to-face with my perpetrator to “hash things out” and “get to the bottom of the truth,” because “it was possible that I had misunderstood the whole situation.” This was neither safe nor biblical.

The church also allowed my perpetrator to attend our co-ed overnight Young Adults retreat, despite my expressed concerns and discomfort. When I continued to raise concerns and finally went public after three months of isolation, I was removed and banned from fellowship—told not to attend church gatherings at any Family Church location, or I would be trespassed and arrested on sight.

Leadership even attempted to criminally charge me for exercising my constitutional right to speak out online. Family Church went so far as to post police outside a Tuesday night Bible study. The West Palm Beach Police Department confirmed the church had no case against me. However, these extreme actions have now drawn further scrutiny and launched a larger investigation into the church’s handling of abuse.

Scripture is clear:
“Have nothing to do with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them” (Ephesians 5:11). Unity is never built by covering sin; it is built on truth and accountability.

I am now working with law enforcement and legal counsel because what I experienced at Family Church was not only a failure of leadership but also potentially a violation of victim protection rights. This is not about one individual’s sin but about how leadership chooses to handle serious allegations.

If you are considering attending here, please know: churches should be safe places where victims are believed, protected, and shepherded with care. Sadly, that was not my experience at Family Church—nor has it been the experience of others, who are now coming forward because of my bold stance.

I pray they choose repentance, transparency, and true biblical accountability moving forward.
But until then, prospective members should ask: What are they hiding? And how many others have been silenced? Horrible experience 😪 I walked in wanting to hear the word of God not be judged for being homeless or treated as if I was trying to steal something or what she tell me we don't feed or hand out food ok I didn't ask for anything all I asked was how do I get inside and even then she acted like she didn't want me to go in whole time talking to me like I'm dumb just very judgemental yes I'm going thru a rough season and the only food I wanted was god's word. Anyways never going back there i feel worse than when I walked thru the door. I just moved to the area and tried this church out a couple of times. Though this church may not be for me, I encourage anyone who feels led to, to give it a try. This is just my perspective and my own personal experience, so please take my reasoning listed below with a grain of salt

Worship: The music team is so talented, but at times, it could feel more performance based geared toward streaming than a space for the congregation to truly engage with God. The volume and presentation (lots of lights )  sometimes distracted from the heart of worship. But we are living in different times and a lot of churches are like this nowadays, so it's understandable.

Community: The people are friendly and engaging! I did reach out twice via the website to see about a particular small group and see if spots were available, but i never heard back. It could be that the website isn't working properly, but i did receive emails from the church about other things, so maybe they were just really busy!!!

Financial Talk: I completely understand churches need to be transparent about giving, but there were moments when it felt like  financially heavy discussions, but it could have just been the theme for that service. (I went to this church 7 times)

Sermons: The teaching was biblical, but It could feel a little shallow. For example when addressing a message on temptation in corinthians, the example used was "eating too much ice cream" while entirely relatable it felt like the messages would often times avoid addressing deeper real life struggles with sin that adults may wrestle with. I was hoping for more substance and depth, but like I said, maybe it was an off service, too.

Political and personal focus: some services where the message centered around political figures instead of christ felt a little off to me while it's appropriate to talk about current events.  I can understand bring up some things especially in light of recent events, But often time the events felt cherry picked over which ones were actually relevant and it felt more like political commentary and the politization of Christianity.

I will say however  whoever gave the sermon last Sunday about the "main thing is the main thing:  was a phenomenal speaker.

Needless to say, im glad I tried this church out, I will be moving on, but I sincerely wish them the best of luck out there and encourage them to keep it up! Inspired messages with focus on family and children. Something for everyone! Great musicians!

name: Family Church PC - Port Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
We visited numerous churches when we first moved to the area. We kept coming back to Family Church. You will find
Wonderful expositional sermons from Pastor Jim, an awesome worship team, family groups for every one, an excellent children’s ministry and even our school , Family Christian Academy.  Oh, you will also find lots of new people to call family. Please come visit us! The first time we visited Family Church we were warmly greeted.  Upon attending services we discovered that Pastor McCarty and the family groups (Sunday school) teach the whole Bible with accuracy and in a way that's easy to understand.  The friendliness and truth have continued for the entire 19 years we've been attending.  The music is uplifting.  It's a great church for every age with different ministries for children, young adults, seniors, widows, and many others. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
The moment I walked into Family Church, I felt the presence of God in a real and powerful way. The worship is filled with genuine praise, the sermons are rooted in truth, and the people welcome you like family. This church isn’t just a building it’s a home where faith grows, hearts heal, and lives change. Every message speaks directly to your spirit, reminding you that God’s love is alive and active. If you’re searching for a place to belong, to grow closer to Christ, and to walk in purpose this is it. Come experience God’s grace for yourself! 🙌✨ I am a newbie at Family Church PC, but in the few months I have been attending here, I have felt so welcome and like I belong. I love that they teach the Bible verse by verse and the worship team is outstanding! There is always something happening here for all ages. There are Family Groups on Sunday mornings and all kinds of Focus Bible studies throughout the week.  There is a great student and children ‘s ministry and a service every Sunday at 10:30 specifically for Spanish speaking families.  Family Christian Academy is our school for Pre-K through 12th grade.  Stop by for dinner at 5 every Wednesday night and check it out.  You belong here! I am new to Family Church. Here I have found a Family, the church and everyone in it has been very  warm and caring. Pastor Jim gives an amazing sermon every Sunday. I have grown spiritually, there are Family Groups for everyone,  they take you in and you feel like you have come home. Each Service is up lifting and touches your heart

name: Family Church Village - West Palm Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I would like to take a moment to express how truly welcoming this church is. From the moment you walk through the doors, you are greeted with kindness, warmth, and genuine care. The atmosphere is inviting, and it is clear that everyone is welcomed with open arms, no matter where they are in life.

The members of this church make you feel comfortable and valued, creating a sense of belonging that is rare and special. The love, support, and encouragement shown here reflect the true spirit of faith and community. It is not just a place of worship, but a place where people connect, grow, and feel at home. My place of worship,I love learning and worshipping with pastor Kevin Smith he makes you feel like home along with his story times Teaching vs Preaching! Kids have their very own safe place to learn and interact with peers as well. No Mega Church at all. Just the right size and atmosphere for growth. Very disappointing experience. My son sat by himself when he was with the youth because one teen told him to not sit with the rest of the group. It was our first and last time going. Please teach the youth to be kind and welcoming to others. Though I am Presbyterian by conviction, this group of churches function more as I would say God designed. Hence the name Family Church! A Biblical Principle ignored by most places of Scriptural worship: we R to operate as a family, so that the World sees us caring for one another Of The Way! -As with most churches, they have Lost Sight of teachable, memorizable, music! Otherwise, a 9 out of 10. Great people n teaching n serving!

name: Family of Christ Lutheran Church and School
Family of Christ Lutheran Church and School - Tampa Palms Campus
reviewSummary: We are so happy our family found FOC and made it our church. We have enjoyed Worship w Pastor Landon and our kids love Sunday school. The church staff is so friendly and welcoming, and everyone makes you part of the family! Highly recommend to anyone looking for their church home. We love Family of Christ Church.  It is a warm and friendly environment with members of all ages.  Our 5 year daughter loves attending the Kidz Praise group for ages VPK-5th grade on Wednesday evenings.  We have made great friends and enjoy working together on special events and projects that involve our church and school family, as well as the community.  Everyone is welcome there. We have been members of Family of Christ Lutheran Church for 7 years now.  We can't imagine going to another church!  We have enjoyed all 3 services; Saturday night, & the 2 on Sundays.  We normally go to the contemporary service.  The church has plenty of activities for all ages and you can be as involved as you would like. Family Of Christ Lutheran Church is wounderful place! The pastor's and people who attended this church are wonderful and kind! They have children's programs for all ages. They also have programs for adults and senior citizens! My family has attended Family of Christ Lutheran Church since my eldest daughter was 4 years old she is now almost 12 years old!  So in total we have been coming here for 8 years! They also have a nursery to take care of infants and children ages up to 3 and a half 4 year olds go to Sunday school. Over the years it has changed a lot but the main focus is family and community! They serve homeless on Thursdays at 6pm. their services are Saturday 6pm and Sunday 9:15am and 10:45am they also do a Spanish service and have Tamil. As well as a West Campus. Also they have school from kindergarten through 8th grade and a child care center on the premises. My son has been a regular at Family of Christ after school care and summer program for 5 years now. He will be in 4th grade. I have never felt more like family anywhere else. They treat my 9 year old son like gold and he considers them family as well. Hands down the best child care I've ever found for my little one.

name: Fellowship Church
reviewSummary: Led by Ed Young, known for highly creative and visual sermon series. The vibe is modern and attracts a wide demographic looking for engaging, relevant communication.

name: Fellowship Dallas
reviewSummary: Noted for its 'Teaching Team' approach and 'Expository' style. Reviews highlight a 'warm' and 'Grace-centered' atmosphere with a strong emphasis on community diversity.

name: Fellowship Of Believers Church - Sarasota Campus
reviewSummary:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Fellowship of Believers Church is a truly welcoming and Christ-centered church. The teaching is biblical, heartfelt, and practical, making it easy to apply God’s Word to everyday life. The worship is uplifting, and the sense of community is genuine—you feel like family from the moment you walk in. The pastors and members clearly love the Lord and care deeply for people. If you’re looking for a church that teaches truth, loves well, and lives out the Gospel, Fellowship of Believers Church is a wonderful place to call home. ✝️ Fellowship of Believers Church is truly a place where the presence of God is felt the moment you walk through the doors. The worship is powerful, the preaching is filled with truth and the Holy Spirit, and the atmosphere is full of genuine love, faith, and unity. This is not just another church service — it’s a place where lives are transformed, hearts are healed, and people are drawn closer to Jesus. You can tell this ministry is led with sincerity, passion, and a deep desire to glorify God. I’m incredibly thankful for this church family and highly recommend it to anyone hungry for a real encounter with God. Vibrant church with great music, a desire to honor God, and LOTS of of young families. Rather than a strict 1-hour service, they relax in God's Presence and give opportunity for anyone in the congregation to say what they're hearing/experiencing. Very unique and refreshing. The sermon was very good, delivered in a very non-preachy way. My wife, son and I are very thankful to have found Fellowship of Believers. I personally have encountered more of His Holy Spirit and am seeing transformation, becoming closer with my Lord Christ Jesus since attending. Everyone that we have met has been genuine, lovely people. They have a great children's ministry. They have been around for many years and have NO DEBT (praise God)! The pastors are being led by the Holy Spirit and there is a unique framework of accountability whereas the leadership is comprised of three God-fearing married couples leading the direction of the church. I appreciate this compared to other churches, whereas one person may have too much power and influence, they are all being held accountable according to His Word and Holy Spirit. Fellowship of Believers freely worships but is also very rooted in scripture, which I also value, while also practicing the gifts of the spirit without being off-putting, that uplift others. I also very much love that church service may be different every Sunday, being several hours long or shorter, it depends on what His leadings are. There is also just one service, so you have the opportunity to meet everyone when you attend. Church should be this way and not a formula. Full stop. Perhaps most importantly, there are many multigenerational families that attend here, which is a great blessing to be around to see such true wealth (thriving families) especially coming from a broken family and choosing to break generational bondage and seeking to emulate this within my own growing family. We are so thankful to be a part of Fellowship of Believers and hope God can use us to make a difference for His kingdom here. The morning service is usually from 10 a.m., but people come in advance, chat, talk, get acquainted, drink coffee, you have a very friendly, hospitable atmosphere. I really like the unofficial, free, homely atmosphere in this place and good, friendly and kind people of different ages. There is a continuity of generations and there is no spirit of legalism in the ministry, you can pray and go ahead, even to children who praise Jesus during the glorification. If someone has a need, a minister, spiritual guardians and worshippers approach them, they are offered to pray together without coercion, and the Holy Spirit always acts in different ways, not according to the template. There is a very good children's service. I would also like to have a translation into Spanish, Russian or Ukrainian.
Thank God for you!

name: Fields Church OC
reviewSummary: A wonderful community church with deep connections and friendly people. Highly recommend!

name: First Assembly of God Fort Myers
First Assembly of God Fort Myers - Fort Myers Campus
reviewSummary: We have attended a few worship events here and love the church. The church is changing generations and growing! Multiple services and a strong emphasis on missions and serving. I attended the Easter service. I truly believe the Pastor loves the Lord - hands down. I was very disappointed however with the praise and worship. There is no inclusivity with singing but rather a group of people performing songs that no one knows. We only had a smidge of moment to sing (part) of how great thou art. Then they went back to performing. Also, the lady in front of me was so distracting with all her hand motions I wasn’t sure if she was worshiping or directing air traffic. In addition she talked nonstop during the sermon. There’s a time and a place to speak up, and when the pastor is giving his sermon it would be nice for the congregation to be quiet and listen instead of bringing attention to themselves. For over 15 years, First Assembly of God Fort Myers has been more than a church to me—it's been a spiritual home. The pastor is truly a gifted and caring shepherd, whose messages have guided our family for years. We especially love that it's a place for everyone: from incredible, engaging services for adults to a kids' ministry that makes our children excited to come. It’s a welcoming, loving community where faith grows. My wife and I saw Chris Tomlin and his band lead worship here.  We have seen other Christian musicians lead worship at the First Assembly of God church in Ft. Myers.  The church is well suited for a large group of worshippers and the acoustics in the house are excellent.  Also, there is plenty of parking on church property.

name: First Baptist Church of Austin - Downtown Campus
First Baptist Church of Jacksonville - Jacksonville (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
I have friends who live in the area, and this is the church I visit when I am in town. I love this church, and I always look forward to going! Everyone I meet there has been welcoming and kind each time. The preaching is great. Easy to understand while still being rich with meaning and convicting (in a good way). It’s also been fun to see the church campus remodel progress each time I visit. I can tell they have worked really hard, and it’s so warm, open and inviting now. I can’t recommend a church more highly, if you are in Jacksonville you should check it out! Very good church first church I remember going to. Very good people strict and obedient when it comes to the Lord amen. Its been years since I've visited but I know all is well 💞 god bless I've been part of FBC Jacksonville and its worship ministry now for almost 2 years, and I absolutely love it! I've never been in a church that welcomed me quite like First Baptist has. On top of that, to be part of a worship ministry like this one has been such a blessing. The choir/orchestra is truly like a family, and the leadership is second-to-none. Every week, we are led in truth-filled, God-honoring worship and get to experience musical excellence at the same time. I'm also involved with the Student Worship ministry, and it's such a great opportunity for students to learn more about worship and have fun with music. If you're looking for a church home in the Jacksonville area, come visit First Baptist! A time was had celebrated end of the school year luncheon served by JSO STAFF food was delicious & the recognition was beautiful (crossingguards) lifestyle 5 to 30 yrs wow what and amazing achievement
Time frame We had a blast this past year at all the Christmas festivities around campus! First Baptist makes Christ the center of Christmas and provides family friendly events through all of December to enjoy! Their Christmas Fellowship event was a blast! They had sleigh-rides, live orchestra, and even snow in Jacksonville!

name: First Baptist Church of Las Cruces
First Baptist Church of Las Cruces - Miranda Campus
First Baptist Church of Owensboro - Main Campus
First Baptist Church of Panama City
First Baptist Church of Panama City - Panama City Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve served in the military and this Church has the ultimate respect for the people that serve this country. But no one that gets to come home ever has a home to comeback to. That is not anyone’s fault but mine,  I’d love to keep serving this country in that way.?I lost my wife and I can’t get back to anything that even resembles a life Thank you to the good people of this church for hosting the 2025 Man Church Conference. This is a beautiful church with a great staff that loves the Lord. They are to be commended for the work and efforts they put out to make the weekend of February 21st-23rd 2025 a great success! I visited for your service Sunday. It was great to meet a number of great people who gave me insights into the events. Your visitor center personal were top notch and even gave me a packet to help orient me to your campus.
Then there was the service, the tech people (who are always under appreciated) were on point. The music took me back to the days when choir and orchestra were the norm. They somehow managed to blend classic into contemporary. You Church doesn’t know how lucky they are to have them.
Which brings me to the pastor. Finally a man who knows the Word of God and how to teach it! I went for the News Boys concert.  It was awesome!! The church is beautiful and had plenty of seating. Loved worshipping last Sunday with you! I hope to come back on my next vacation. Great music, friendly people and Godly preaching.

name: First Baptist Church of Tampa - Tampa (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: I have come to know many of his congregation. They have become my very good friends. I feel comfortable there. I feel that my healing is coming from the Lord and I believe the Lord put me in the right place. Friendly members.  The word of God is taught with integrity, music program is a great mix of traditional and contemporary. This is my home church and has been for 30 years. Through all the changes in times and personnel, it remains a Bible based, multicultural and multigenerational church. It supports missionary work with a passion as a Baptist church should. Many programs for differing needs . Has fostered seed churches locally and internationally. If you wish a church that is the best it can, go see how they make you feel walking in the door. Amazing place to worship God!! So glad we visited, from the moment we stepped out of our car we felt welcomed and saw smiles. The church is beautiful and the service was amazing. Thank you God for leading our family there. Praise God!!! This church has been around for a long time. My brothers and I used to live on Cardy street just down the road from First Babtist. We attended church on a regular basis as it was the place that we could all go to hang out with our friends not realizing at the time how God played a roll in all of our lives then and now. They had Wednesday Spaghetti  dinners and still offer a Wednesday and Sunday breakfast and dinner for everyone including  those who could not afford to pay, and even had a place in their activity building to go bowling, and a large skating rink where we also had an opportunity  to be off the streets and safe. I also sang in the choir. I stopped by this special place just a few days ago and met Nell who is a member and was gracious enough to show me around. I sat outside in the parking lot of the church remembering those old days at the church. Happy days of my brothers and I when we were young.  Seeing this church agian made me remember the importance of family and helping others as they did for my brothers, friends and loved ones. I plan to attend their Sunday services tomorrow, come and join us!

name: First Baptist Church Pensacola - Pensacola Campus
reviewSummary:
Very neat, friendly, and cool! There is the English service and the Vietnamese service, which are both equally amazing. I really love it here. (Left photo is a photo from July 2023 and the second photo is from April) Was here to see a chorus concert and was amazed at what a beautiful church this is.  Very nice people as well. I was calling in to reference a woman who need help her mother in bad condition and she lost her job trying to help out older mother her mother only have a few months to live and pastor's assistant hung up the phone when I was speaking of the latest need and I think that was pretty rude as a Christian. Very friendly congregation and the Pastor is very knowledgeable!  He takes time to teach and uses excellent examples to share experiences.  I can actually relate to him as a person that accept, and admits, faults and teaches us that it's ok to be human!  He loves The LORD and it definitely shows when he preaches!!  Congregation is very friendly and welcome you constantly!!  My granddaughter loves it because we come to the contemporary service but they also offer traditional as well!  They are very involved with the community and you can tell they genuinely care about others.  I've only been going a little over a year and if I can't get there I can go online and watch!! Excellent church to attend if you need a caring church family! I stayed in this town, when I would have otherwise moved away, only for this church. That was a decade ago.

The preacher is super and the traditional worship services are awesomely inspiring. It just keeps getting better and better.

This is not a huge church but big enough to give choices. The people are low key and friendly. This church is the best reason to live in Pensacola.

name: First Baptist Church-Pompano - Pompano Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
The friendliest church I have ever attended! So proud to now be a member of this church family! Decided to visit for the first time. Checked the website, said service is at 9:30. Left from Deerfield at 9:00 to get there on time. Arrived at 9:30
To an empty parking lot only to be told by the parking attendant they moved church to 10:30. I guess they didn't care or feel the need to change it.on their website. Thanks for nothing. I am sure the church is great it's the big guy that's works that at night me and my husband were walking by the gate around 7 o'clock walking out dog and she love looking for bugs lizards and this guy comes walking up on the other side saying things to intise a problem so my husband responds back to him the same way and this guy threatened us with violence and were just walking by and he gets aggressive saying he been to prison 20 years even followed us half way to our car I think the people you allow to work there need to be better cause that was out of control and he is not letting this go that  guy should be working around any one of public he tries to fight my husband right in front of the church I will start with the fact that pastor Adam is great. He met me in the prayer room as I was new to religion and made me feel Welcomed.
He invited me back and said that I can come into the prayer room anytime they were open AS LONG AS I was let in and given permission.

Couple months later I walk in because I was going through a mental melt down and headed straight to the Church. Walked in the same door after getting buzzed in. I asked the Lady at the desk if I may use the prayer room. She said go ahead and smiled.

20 minutes later a Paster that I didn't grab a name for but was an older gentleman walked in and asked if he could help me with something. I said 'no but thank you so much". To which he replied with "We don't just let anybody come in here and be on the couch" and then asked me to leave.  Mind you I was holding the Bible to my chest and crying.

By the look on his face and demeaning tone. He clearly wanted me out. I then said to him that I was invited back anytime by Pastor Adam and that I was given permission by the lady at the desk to come in. At that point he started apologizing but the damage was already done. I said it's ok I'll leave and he tried to walk after me mend the uncomfortable encounter that he created. I left and told him thank you so much. I WOULD NOT recommend this place at all. How could you be so unkind to some in such a fragile state.

I could have accepted his apology but I was so overwhelmed by the situation that I just wanted to leave. Besides why would someone want to stay at a place of worship after being kicked out and receiving a half apology ONLY because I said Adams name. Had I NOT how would the conversation have gone?

Sometimes it's not what you say but how you say it. Especially coming from a pastor and you being in such an emotional state. Good bible based church with alot of activities and groups.

name: First Baptist Dallas
reviewSummary: A historic downtown landmark known for its unapologetically 'Conservative' stance and massive choir/orchestra worship. The campus is described as a 'state-of-the-art' facility in the heart of the city.

name: First Baptist Of Fort Lauderdale - Fort Lauderdale Campus
reviewSummary:
I have my daughter in their DCA program and they are so amazing!!! They truly are faithful servants of the Lord. As a single mom, they welcomed us with open arms and so much love and care for us. I’m forever blessed and grateful for all the teachers and staff that make the property safe and full of affection. They give me such a peace and rest that my child is in their care and all the fun activities I can’t afford outside of their program, they continually do amazing events and provide such cater to my child’s growth in learning and playing. Thank you First Baptist DownTown Christian Academy! We love you!! Love our church! Creative, lively, and biblical based teachings on 100!! If you’re reading this… take it as a sign to check it out! I love this church! I haven’t been for Sunday services but I plan on starting and enrolling into the Christian Academy.  I’ve been to two Rally Louds here for young adults and the energy is always through the roof! You can feel the presence of the Lord as soon as you enter the building. Everyone is so kind, the music and the performances are great. The ministry here makes you feel so welcomed and apart of a community It’s a great place for young people to come and want to be closer to God. They serve free food and beverages and have a DJ. This place is very clean and sanitized and truly a GEM💎 I brought my friend from work and it was a truly amazing experience. Thank you so much for your services ❤️❤️❤️❤️ PRAISE GOD This is the best church in the area for Christians of all types. The teachings are directly from the Bible, and always carry weight. Come at 10 or 1130 and see Pator David, Nick, or Charlie. I have attended First Baptist Fort Lauderdale for a while now, and I can honestly say it’s one of the most genuine and welcoming churches I’ve ever known. It’s a place where faith feels alive and community is real. From the moment you walk in, you sense warmth, respect, and purpose.

The worship is powerful, the teaching is deep and relevant, and the people truly care. The Sharpen Sharpen Life Groups changed my life. They helped me grow spiritually and personally, surrounded by people who encourage, challenge, and support each other every week.

A special thank you to Brian and Sam for their leadership, patience, and example. Their guidance has impacted my walk with God and my outlook on life more than words can express.

If you are new in town or searching for a church where you can grow, serve, and belong, First Baptist Fort Lauderdale is that place. It’s not just a church—it’s a community that will make you feel at home.

name: First Christian Church - Clearwater Campus
reviewSummary:
It was my first time visiting First Christian Church in Clearwater today.  The atmosphere was warm and genuinely welcoming—no pressure, just kindness and authenticity.

The praise and worship was humble yet powerful, not about performance but about real connection and faith. You could feel that it came from the heart, which made it even more meaningful.

The pastor delivered a sermon that was both powerful and deeply knowledgeable—one of those messages that really makes you reflect and stay with you long after you leave.

Grateful to have experienced such a sincere and uplifting service. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a place that feels real and rooted in purpose. They host a service in Ukrainian language every Sunday at 12:30.
Opportunities for young adults to have potlucks and socialize.
4 stars just cz the service is too long
Free English translation Great place to worship and God and Jesus he is WAITING for you to give your All to him and trust in him to guide your life/family 🙏❤️ God bless you 🙏 I love going to church here. Pastor Mike is excellent and compassionate in every sermon. All the people are so friendly. You are always greeted with a  smile, which is perfect to start any day. If you are looking for a new church I highly recommend  First Christian Church of Cleatwater. We are celebrating  100 years in April. Please come visit and see for yourself. Love God, Love people. Sounds simple, but it is rare to find. Be doers, not just hearers - also rare. Transparency from the heart, adhering to the Word with authenticity, and solid, confident wisdom is what you get with Pastor Mike. That forms 'trickle down' discipleship and shows tremendously in the Body here. It is the definition of leadership toward Christ. My wife and I have grown much in tangible faith here. Thanks Mike, we love you! Come here if you want to meet Jesus for real, be changed by His Love, and develop a heart for His mission to save the lost and take them to Heaven with us.

name: First Christian Church - Covington Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been attending 1st church for about 4 years. This congregation has continually been open, big hearts open minds. We are welcoming to All. We have many ministries that you can participate in or lead.
Our building is beautiful, 100 plus years old.
The Worship Center/ Sanctuary is a perfect atmosphere for a contemporary blended service. We invite you to come worship with us, join the church if you are looking for a church home with a loving family. We are not seeking people to “pay our bills” we are looking to find new desciples to work side by side with to be the hands and feet of Christ in Covington Kentucky. First Christian Church on the corner of Fifth and Madison, Covinton, Ky.  Is a Beautiful  bldg. whose doors are open to all who wish to serve and worship God.  We welcome all people to come in and be comfortable in your skin......straight, gay, it matters not! We had our wedding ceremony at First Christian Church and had a great experience. Sheri and Pastor Tracy were a pleasure to work with. They were responsive and worked with us to meet all our needs.  I would recommend First Christian Church if you want to get married in an open and accepting church that does not feel stuffy with classic traditions. they SERVE GOD & HELP HIS OTHER CHILDREN
they invited Breakfast of Covington to serve the homeless or other hungry people Tues, Wed, Thurs mornings.
They serve community dinners Sun@4pm
They also host two N.A. homegroups,
"Garden of Hope" Fri8:30pm
"Becoming Something From Nothing" Sat10pm
"we serve God by service to others" Truly a place that tries to live up to their mission " to welcome wholly, love authentically, and share God's grace abundantly." I get way to excited when I'm here. It makes me so happy!

name: First Christian Church - Fort Myers Campus
reviewSummary:
My family and I have been attending FCC for some time now, and I can honestly say it’s become a place we truly consider home. From the moment we walked through the doors, we felt welcomed and embraced by everyone. What stands out the most about FCC is the sense of community—it’s not just a church, it’s a family.

We’ve made so many meaningful friendships here, and the connections we’ve formed have been a huge blessing. The people here genuinely care for each other, and it’s clear that the church’s leadership is committed to fostering an environment where everyone feels like they belong. Whether it's through small group gatherings, Sunday services, or church events, there are always opportunities to build relationships and grow spiritually alongside others.

Our kids have also flourished in the children's ministry. It’s not just childcare; they’re learning and growing in their faith, and they love going to church every week. The youth program is active and engaging, which gives our teenagers a place to connect and grow in their own faith journey too.

We feel incredibly blessed to be part of First Christian Church. It’s more than just a place of worship—it’s a community where we’ve grown spiritually, made lifelong friends, and found a sense of belonging! Very welcoming & friendly brothers & sister of God. I joined under Pastor Gary who welcomed me whole heatedly to FCC. I pray God richly bless the FCC family now & forever I had an uplifting Sunday morning at First Christian Church! The spacious setting was perfect for the powerful message from Pastor Jimmy Akers. He spoke about King David and how, from his rooftop, he saw Bathsheba and made a costly mistake. “The Lord sees the heart” (1 Samuel 16:7) was a key takeaway, reminding us that God’s perspective is different from ours. The service was a great reminder to stay humble and seek God’s guidance in all things. Highly recommend a visit for anyone looking for insightful teaching and a welcoming atmosphere! :) When I came to FCC, I had a good bit of church hurt I brought with me. My faith in Jesus never wavered, but my love for the ministry of the Church had been damaged.

I see now that God has used this church and community to patch up that hurt I experienced. The staff truly support one other and the congregation through good times and bad. I feel that my soul is cared for, and I know that on bad days, people will be there to pray with me and uplift me out of the mire.

I couldn’t ask for a better place to call home in Fort Myers and I’m glad that this church has embraced me! Good worship, solid biblical message, great demographics. Seems like a healthy church!

name: First Christian Church - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary:
The folks at this church are friendly and inviting. The Bible is the weekly sermon. Paster Greg is caring. Myself, I’m enjoying being in a Christ based Church. If your looking as I was then try this wonderful church. Love the people so friendly and services was a blessing I recommend to come in and worship  with use I grew up at FCC have been there my entire life my mother was a charter member. We are located very close to the UK Hospital, St Joseph hospital, Baptist Health hospital, and UK Samaritan hospital. The UK Football stadium is 9/10 of a mile from the church. We're 1/2 block off Waller Avenue and 1/2 block off Nicholasville road, we're the church just around the corner. Our
Senior minister Greg Hereford and associate minister Joe Cooper do and outstanding job with the word of God. If your looking for a church home we invite you to come Sunday, come as you are we'll have the coffee ready. When you get there look for the happenings of FCC.
Joe, Jr. I’m a member of first Christian,everyone is so friendly.The fellowship is wonderful. Preaching the word of God and worshipping him in song. Striving to reach all age groups for the Kingdom of God. You won’t be disappointed with your experience.

name: First Christian Church - Melbourne Campus
reviewSummary:
Striking building with a giant, beautiful, stained glass window which catches the morning sun. Welcoming atmosphere open and affirming to all.
Congregation is very friendly and helpful. Screens provide the readings and song lyrics. Snacks and fellowship are offered after the service.
Though only a few musicians were at the service we attended, the music was excellent and well suited. The Pastor friendly and knowledgeable. Her sermon that Sunday provided an excellent lesson covering the historic foundation of shared beliefs.
Although we are members of another local church, we will definitely return to this welcoming and friendly church. The minister, Rev Day Broer is very good. She used to be a schoolteacher in Brevard County and moved on to become a Christian minister. The church building was erected in 1965. It has a unique stain glass window which is amazing when lit up at night. Unfortunately the building has taken a beating over the years and looks a bit run down  but it has a good roof and the AC works so I can't complain!
The services are now shared with the Riviera church. They combined and are now a "snack-sized" church. The congregation is very welcoming and serve the community with gusto! Love Tuesdays
Come and get it. Salad. Food cooked and served
Coffee and a meeting after the meal.
Good to be around those who Love The LORD I don't go here but I've always loved the architecture of this building and remember thinking as a child how cool it would be to sled down the roof of it, if it snowed here. A church were everyone is welcome.  Come hear our great pastor at 10 am Sunday.

name: First Christian Church of Fort Lauderdale
First Christian Church of Fort Lauderdale - Fort Lauderdale Campus
reviewSummary:
The First Christian Church of Ft Lauderdale was started by Maude Bollinger and Ruth Repp who offered Sunday school classes on Repp's front porch to the Ft Lauderdale community which was only 143 people at that time. Church services were held at several locations in Ft. Lauderdale including the old Fort Lauderdale Sentinel building.

In 1925, a benefactor donated land for a church at the corner of Southeast 13th Street and Southeast Third Avenue on the site of a former rock pit. Lumber to build the church arrived on Sept. 16, 1926. The very next day the Hurricane of 1926 destroyed the church records, lumber, the tent they were working out of, and all of their equipment. Two children and two adult members of the congregation lost their lives. The church rose from this devastating loss and completed the church building in 1927. A later expanded building incorporates the original church structure.

I love a historic church and I was able to check out First Christian Church of Ft Lauderdale during a tag sale. They held the sale in their basement! I was amazed that there was a building with an actual basement in South Florida. The congregation was so warm and welcoming and I got invited to church service by Katherine. This church is gorgeous and you can feel the history within its walls. Church services are held every Sunday at 10:45. everytime my family is down here we love to go to this church. Great vibes. Great teaching Wednesday night bible study at 8pm is awesome! If I lived in Fort Lauderdale I would be attending this church. Old school Pastor who also serves on the worship team (as I do) and loves Jesus. Loved the stained glass windows and the word and the anointed. If we move here, this is out church where I will help find someone for video!

Phil
Jesus Lives This is, as I understand it, the second oldest continually operating church in Fort Lauderdale, Florida. It was founded in 1911 and continues today as a place where people from all walks of life worship God.

Although the church was once a formal member of the Disciples of Christ denomination, it has been an independent, non-denominational church for the last fifteen years or more. It is organized in the same manner as the churches in the Book of Acts and is elder led.

There is a sweet spirit among its congregation and, upon entering, you can feel the love of God. The multi-ethnic, international membership is a picture of South Florida. What sets them apart is their joyful, loving praise of Jesus Christ.

Sunday School starts at 9:30 a.m. and the church service follows at 10:45 a.m. with a live band leading praise and worship, a sermon from God's Word and communion. After the service, everyone retires to the basement Fellowship Hall for coffee and fellowship. It's a great opportunity to meet your fellow Christians and experience the move of God's Holy Spirit!

Come and join us. Let us worship the Lord, our God, together.

name: Florida Coast Church - Pompano Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a great church. For anyone who is seriously wanting to be rooting in Christ centered scripture for themselves and or their family this is the place to go in this area.  The people are loving and elders are knowledgeable, personable and loving as well as theologically capable.  It’s hard to find a gem like this. You will be lovingly challenged to grow in holiness. True to the Gospel and sharing the Good News are their top priority! Family in Faith, warm, friendly and welcoming! I have been attending Florida Coast Church for most of its eight-year history, and not a week goes by that I don’t thank God for making me part of this special congregation.  There is a warm, friendly family atmosphere that is felt the moment you walk in the door.  The worship is simple, participatory, and heart-felt.  Sound biblical preaching provides rich spiritual food, bringing fresh insights to Scripture passages I have been reading and studying for years.  Want more?  There are prayer meetings and Bible studies during the week and an active women’s ministry.  This is authentic, biblical Christianity.

In first posting my review a few years ago, I failed to mention the many wonderful people God has used and continues to use at Florida Coast Church, especially our pastor Larry Trotter and his wife Sandy. They are a seasoned ministry couple, having worked together for over a quarter century as missionaries in Mexico before starting our congregation.  Larry’s teaching and leadership gifts are beautifully complemented by Sandy’s caring hospitality and her work with women and children. We love them both! Great church great sound teaching loving people and excellent pastors it is an amazing place for community Florida Coast Church was welcoming and kind to us as visitors. Many people went out of their way to introduce themselves to us and make us feel loved. Pastor Trotter preached a sermon that was Christ centered, expository and encouraging. Prayer was heart felt and they are strong in supporting missionaries. If you are local to the Pompano Beach or Ft Lauderdale area, please consider attending and becoming a member of this authentic, caring body of believers.

name: Forest Park Church - Panama City Campus
reviewSummary:
We held our VPK graduation at Forest Park Church, and it was a wonderful experience! The facility was clean, spacious, and perfect for our celebration. The staff was incredibly helpful and kind throughout the planning and event. We’re so grateful for their support and would absolutely recommend this venue for any special occasion! Just spoke with Pastor David - “this is David”  let’s you know the mettle and humble spirit of this pastor. I phoned to tell him personally how much I was helped by his sermon this past Sunday.

Pastor David is a master of didactic preaching, the lessons
all girded by scripture and presented in a didactic manner are magnificent and shew forth for all to hear and SEE the Glory of GOD in action! Our church went this week to feed the people in tent city.  You could definitely see that the Forest Park UMC  and its people are very interested in doing what is best for those that are hurt by the storm.  We spoke with the minister and his wife and both are full of God's love for all.  I know Shawn York and know where his heart is.  He has sacrificed a lot for the betterment of all involved.  They want each and every one to be in a better place than they were before the storm.  May God Bless those who have lost so much and those that are there to help. I've been a member of FPUM for a decade. Its a lovely church, but too big. I was married 4 yrs ago & bulletins still came in my maiden name. My birthday nor my anniversary was posted, & when I finally decided to transfer my membership, I was told that they were happy I found a home. Wait...I had one. I got lost among the other patrons. It upsets me. I loved this church and the people, but in the end I was left feeling forgotten or judged. We recently visited Forest Park while serving lunch to many tent city residents.  The church volunteered the use of their kitchen and a dozen or more rump roasts.  There is a donation section set aside for everyone to obtain clothes and other supplies. The United Methodist Committee on Relief is on campus helping people obtain needed services.  Many tent city residents are poor with no place to go. The magnitude of assistance needed from the hurricane disaster is far more then news coverage shows.  Forest Park needs your prayers, group assistance and contributions.

One thing though..Zach neefs to provide coffee hour after service's n use our money we give him to run the church to buy coffee n donuts not as a church attendee to foot the bill! name: Fort Myers Community Church - Fort Myers Campus
reviewSummary:
Fort Myers Community Church (FMCC) has been such a tremendous blessing in the life of our family, drawing us closer to our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ. We are forever grateful for the amazing work God is doing through this church and its leadership. Pastor Bill has been given a true gift in sharing the gospel in such an inspiring, relatable, and powerful way. His messages resonate deeply and have helped guide us in walking with Jesus and honoring Him in our daily lives.

We feel truly blessed to have found this beautiful, God-glorifying church. FMCC continually reminds us of God's love for us and encourages us to live out our faith. From being baptized here, attending weekly Bible studies, and having opportunities to serve our community, to Pastor Bill’s amazing reminders of the biblical reasons God brings couples together in marriage during our heartfelt wedding ceremony. Every experience has been a profound blessing.

We are incredibly thankful for this church family, and we look forward to continuing to grow in faith and serve the Lord together. We are truly honored to be part of this incredible community. God bless you all, and thank you, Pastor Bill, for leading us with such grace and wisdom!

With heartfelt gratitude,
Erin & John I was in town visiting a friend. Warm welcome. Greeted as a new comer by multiple people. Worship was great. The message was very well communicated. I went up for prayer and got absolutely crushed by The Holy Spirit. I could not walk. I dropped to my knees. I have never been brought down like that before. It was amazing. Praise God for was I experienced that day. Amazing worship, biblical truth preached without compromise, and a genuinely friendly church family. This is a place where you can grow in faith and feel connected. This is the best church I’ve been to in a very long time… This church truly serves the God of the Bible, as well as Jesus Christ.  Pastor Bill is so genuine, and his messages speaks right to the heart.  My wife and I moved to Fort Myers for the winter months and we found this Church on Facebook.  We walked in and instantly the vibe was amazing.  Young and older people all interacting and being so kind to each other.  The worship was vibrant and extremely talented, and you could tell the Spirit of God was there.  But it definitely wasn't too showy. And at the end of the service we had a lovely young couple come up, say hi, and get to know us.  If you want to go somewhere that's Biblical-based, passionate, genuine, welcoming, and uplifting... definitely check this church out.  We're continuing to go here, so maybe my wife and I will see you there!

Pastor Bogdan is very open hearted man with strong understanding, that only Christ can change people’s hearts! Love this Church so much!

reviewSummary: From the moment we walked in, we were met with such genuine warmth and kindness. It didn’t take long to feel like we truly belonged. Everyone was incredibly welcoming and kind, first day there and they were already inviting me into their family. It is an intimate church were we learn about God's word, no fluff just fellowship and Jesus. I was recently baptized here and am so grateful I stepped through those doors into a deeper understanding of faith! The best people in The World. They share the love of The Lord daily! Daily! Please come & see & worship The Lord. The reopening is April 25 2021 all CDC guidelines still in place. You will love it here. name: Gesù Church - Miami (Downtown/Brickell) Campus
reviewSummary:
Not a typical Jesuit parish ...

Was hopeful when visiting Miami and Sunday Mass was interesting. Gesù is the oldest Catholic Church in all of South Florida, founded in April of 1896. Gesu is in the heart of Downtown with beautiful architecture and stained-glass windows. ent to the 8:15 bilingual mass this morning and walked out genuinely moved. The readings and prayers switch between English and Spanish in a way that actually works — nothing feels forced or repeated just for the sake of it, you just follow along in whichever language speaks to you. Honestly didn’t know that kind of seamless bilingual liturgy existed until today.
The building itself is stunning. Didn’t realize until afterward that it’s the oldest Catholic parish in Miami (1896, current church from the 1920s). The stained glass windows and the vaulted ceiling are worth showing up early for. Quiet, unhurried atmosphere despite being right in the middle of downtown. GESÙ established in 1896 (the same founding year as the City of Miami itself ) is the first Jesuit Catholic Church ⛪️ in Miami. The land upon which the church stands, was donated to the Roman Catholic Archdiocese by Henry Flagler, an entrepreneur industrialist who settled here and built the railroad from Saint Augustine to Key West. A Catholic School once stood by the rectory. Today the school no longer exists and has, unfortunately been replaced by a parking lot. Love this church and the administration. Thank you. 🥰❤️🙏
Gesù Catholic Church in Miami, built in 1895, radiates timeless beauty with its historic charm and sacred atmosphere, a true spiritual landmark of the city.

name: Grace Church at Willow Valley - Main Campus
Grace Church Melbourne - Melbourne Campus
reviewSummary:
I started going to Grace in March of 2025. They welcomed us with open arms. We immediately got connected and started serving. We've become family. If you're looking for a church, give us a year. We'll change your way of things about life. We're transforming the space Coast with the radical love of Jesus! I have attended here 3 times now, with mixed reviews. The first time the worship music was way too loud, but the sermon was good though. Second time was perfect, the worship not too loud, and Pastor Olenski did a great job with the sermon.

However this past Sunday when we attended, it was the fullest it has been since we have gone for this particular service. Not only were there individuals that attended that were disrespectful in the service by talking, there were crying babies, and youth that were disrespectful. I usually don't have issues with children, but if they cannot sit through a service, they should be in a youth program or crying babies stepped out with. It wasnt just one or two, it was several within the area we sat. So it was difficult to concentrate on the sermon. Once again the worship and volume were also too loud.
It is probably just me, but I don't believe this is one for me. But is a very popular church for the crowd that does attend.
The pastors sermons are good and do focus on feeding the congregation. They seem to meet the spiritual needs of the ones that are members. Me and my family moved here in 2024 from Colorado. We went to Red Rocks church and loved it, so we were looking for something that gave us that same, “welcome home” feeling. Grace church not only made it welcome, it also gave me and my family a chance to encounter our Heavenly Father.

I’ll admit the first time we went, we didn’t really talk to anyone. But we kept going, and soon enough we got involved and the Lord changed our hearts through it! :)

There’s different connection groups you can join, I’ve been involved with sisterhood, a mom’s group, and the worship team! Each has taught me more about my relationship with the Lord. So thankful I took advantage of those opportunities! 🥰

I grew up non-denominational and have always had a personal relationship with Jesus, but had strayed away from him with a life of going to the clubs and getting into trouble! After having an encounter with Jesus, and trusting his good plan for me I rededicated my life to Him!

Let this year be the year you go to church and find a relationship with Jesus. If there’s something you don’t like, PRAY about it and listen. He will answer. Grace Church has been home for us for almost 13 years. If you’re looking for a church home that loves God, becomes family, loves your babies like their own, and has their heads on straight, this is it! We’ve seen Grace Church through many seasons and would not have stayed this long if the things above weren’t true. Aaron and Nicole lead SO well with integrity and hearts after God and His will. They are genuine and loving, and are living out God’s calling on their lives with excellence! The staff and volunteers are amazing and the culture is so healthy. We’re so blessed to have Grace Church in our lives! If I were reviewing this church based on its amazingly designed building, it would be 5 stars no doubt! If i were reviewing this church based on its worship team, again 5 stars.. The reason i must give this church only 2 stars is because the church was established for the “sick in spirit”, the prodigals, the lost, the mother with infants and small children. A church more focused on how they “appear” rather than the direct biblical teachings of our Christ.

Ive attended the church for a few months. As i work on the road my wife will go at times without me cuz im gone. name: Grace Church Miami - Miami Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Grace Church has been my home for the past four years, and I’m incredibly grateful for this gospel-centered community. For those who want to drop in and see what Grace Church Miami is about, there is one service every Sunday. It starts at 10:30 AM, and attendees hang around the worship center to chat afterward! reviewSummary: My wife and I are so grateful to be a family of Grace, the fruits of the spirit is very evident at Grace ,especially love .We adore  this church ,may God continue to bless, strengthen and guide the leadership and all members of Grace. name: Grace City Church - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:

Ethnic make up of the congregation seems 60% Caucasians, 30% Asians, and 10% Others. I can recommend this church to anyone in this area looking for a rock solid, legitimate church that you can call a community church. I will post photos later. Absolutely love this church! We’ve easily gotten plugged in and serving on a team and love now getting to be a part of creating the same experience for guests. Pastor Stephen Kimbrell truly brings the Bible to life with his engaging and kind teaching style. He is incredibly approachable, making it easy to ask questions and delve deeper into the faith.
