The staff ensured we had all the resources we needed as newcomers to the faith, which was a great touch. I appreciated how they distributed cards before the service to gauge our learning preferences and spiritual journeys.

One of my favorite parts of the service was the music at the beginning. The heartfelt songs performed by church members really resonated with me, setting a meaningful tone for the worship.

The sense of community at Grace City Church is truly special; it feels like a family. I’m grateful to have found such a supportive place. My kids also love attending—there are engaging programs for them, and they enjoy playing with their friends at church. Plus, there are plenty of community events that bring everyone together.

Overall, I would highly recommend Grace City Church. If you're looking for a place that feels like home, this is it! Grace City Church is truly a place that you can call home. From the moment you walk through the doors, you are greeted with warmth and kindness from everyone you encounter. The members of this church are truly welcoming, and it's clear that they value building relationships with one another.

The community at Grace City Church is truly something special. Whether you're a long-time member or a newcomer, you will quickly feel like you're part of the family. Everyone is so supportive and encouraging, and it's clear that they are all passionate about their faith and sharing it with others.

In addition to the welcoming atmosphere and strong sense of community, the worship services at Grace City Church are truly inspiring. The music is uplifting and meaningful, and the messages are always relevant and thought-provoking. You will leave each service feeling renewed and refreshed, with a deeper understanding of your faith and a renewed sense of purpose.

Overall, I would highly recommend Grace City Church to anyone looking for a place to call home. The people are wonderful, the community is strong, and the worship services are truly uplifting. Whether you're just starting your faith journey or have been a believer for years, you will find a warm welcome and a supportive community at Grace City Church. Amazing church! Very genuine & caring community. We love the Sunday school for our kids! The pastor & family pastor are bible based and powerful preachers & the worship team is so good! Grace City has changed mine and my families life and we're so thankful to find this church in Irvine. They're about disciples making disciples and we have found life long friends here. I highly encourage joining a city group and serving to get plugged in! ❤️

name: Grace City Tampa - Tampa (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Grace City Tampa is the real deal. If you’re looking for a church that’s firmly rooted in Scripture, this is it. Every message is biblically sound, and you can tell the leaders carry a deep honor and reverence for God’s Word. The culture here is incredibly welcoming—genuine, caring, and full of people who actually live out what they believe. The worship? Next level. Easily the best band I’ve ever heard, and it’s not about performance; it’s all about glorifying God. And I love how invested this church is in serving the community beyond its walls. So thankful to call this place home. Grace City is the best Church in Tampa. Great message the pastor puts his heart and soul into. Passionate worship and service. Welcoming entrance and friendly atmosphere. Plenty of teams to join, and baptisms on the regular. Best coffee so far in Tampa great single origin from Colombia to die for.
To everyone try Colombia single origin and the guys are absolutely fantastic Great young thriving church. We visited here when we were over from the UK this weekend and felt very welcomed as a family. Modern worship, great Bible based talk from the lead pastor, thoughtful kids church and a great venue. Would definitely recommend and attend again if we are in town. My first and last visit to GraceCity Tampa was on Mother's Day when my adult daughter, husband and myself visited. We have been in ministry ourselves for 26 years, and were away from home. While the word was good, the people were cold and indifferent to us as visitors. Not even one person spoke to us, welcomed us, or so much as said hello. I post this hoping that you will look into your hearts and ask yourselves if that is how you think Christ would treat visitors.

name: Grace Community Church - Jacksonville (Southside) Campus
reviewSummary:
This is the first and only church we attended since moving across the country. Someone my wife knew from her teen years invited us to attend when we were assembling a list of churches to visit. It was at top of our list and we gladly accepted. 4 years later and here we are. This Body is so welcoming and loving and Pastor Justin preaches amazing sermons! It is so refreshing to be in a church that actually opens God’s Word and teaches straight from it too.
We have been blessed in so many ways by our brothers and sisters here! Pros:

+ Friendly, although misguided, congregation and leadership

+ Opportunities for discipleship

+ Good children's ministry

+ Rich worship music

Cons:

- Sermons are at least 50 minutes. Many people struggle to pay attention for this duration. The senior pastor has said that he himself sometimes forgets the previous Sunday’s sermon outline.

- No real diversity in views. Every man who teaches has received his education/training from the church itself, The Master's Seminary, or The Expositors Seminary.

- Calvinism is taught as a fact based on the misinterpretation of a few passages like Romans 9 and Ephesians 1, and despite heaps of scriptural evidence to the contrary (John 3:16, 1 Timothy 2:3-6, 2 Peter 3:9, etc.). Not only does this seriously impugn God’s character, but it can cause a bizarre attitude in people. They’re the “chosen ones.” I once heard someone enthusiastically say “God could have predestined me for Hell, and it would be for His glory.”

- Dispensationalism and “Left Behind” rapture theology are taught as a fact.

- Dating environment is complicated, bordering on dysfunctional. Singles and relationships must be approved by leadership.

- Overall, I think it’s fair to say that this church flirts with the BITE Model of control. Grace Community Church is a Bible-believing church. Pastor Justin does an excellent job preaching the Bible verse by verse, also known as expository preaching. My family and I recently moved to this area, and the congregants have welcomed us with open arms. We feel at home. We feel loved and are very happy and grateful to God for having led us to this community of believers. At Grace Community Church, you will find a church that is filled with a deep love and fear of God that is joyful and beautiful.
However, what truly sets Grace Community Church apart is their unwavering commitment to biblical truth. The preaching here is expository, focused solely on what the Bible teaches without relying on religiosity or man's opinion. This calls us to stay grounded in the teachings of Scripture and to continually grow in our faith.

The people at Grace Community Church are what make it truly special. The love and fear of God is evident in every aspect of the church, from how members treat one another to the hospitality that is shown to visitors. The leadership models humility and genuine care, always making themselves available and approachable.

My family and I have been at Grace Community Church for 15 years & we highly recommend Grace Community Church to anyone seeking a Christ-centered, biblical church that is dedicated to truth and love. Come and join us to grow in the word of God in a body of believers that seeks to serve and glorify Him above all. Very welcoming group of believers! Traditional/acoustic worship service. Very nice facility with good children's ministry.

Notes on first visit:

Definitely a particular perspective on the place of evangelism in the modern Christian life - message focused
more on being a "stalwart defender of the Church" than a "Fisher of men". Signs/wonders are regarded as a misinterpretation of Scripture.

Overall a great group of Christians and a great choice!

name: Grace Community Church Boca - Boca Raton Campus
reviewSummary:
Today, a good friend picked me up to join her at Grace Community Church for an outstanding Easter celebration service. The congregation was warm and welcoming, and the Church grounds were decorated beautifully for the most important celebration of the year!!!

Pastor Jason gave an outstanding sermon, and the music was AMAZING!!! The singer's voices were straight from God!!! I hope to be back before I move out of Boca!!!

I highly recommend a service at Grace Community Church 🤍🤍🤍 - it's totally UPLIFTING !!! Such a great Church.  Pastor Jason is committed to Boca and really cares about this community!   I have had nothing but great interactions with the staff. If you are looking for a church near you where you can feel like you fit right in then
join me here at Grace Community Church Boca Raton. A super friendly group of family oriented, Jesus followers that worship in spirit and in truth.
(Located on Camino Real about a half mile west of Dixie.)
Pastor Jason teachers straight from the Bible, relevant life-changing topics every Sunday that provide a time of focusing on what the word of God the Bible, says about His love for us and what His will for our lives is for today in these challenging times.
The contemporary worship service is amazing. You are going to love the awesome music, songs and vocals in the time of worship with our church family in the sanctuary and the time of prayer because we all need that!
There is childcare provided, coffee & donuts, of course and an adult Sunday morning Bible study that starts at nine in the El Rio room, adjacent to the sanctuary.
Hope to see you here. Come and make it your home too. When you walk into Grace, you feel apart of the family. Such a nice community - Sundays here kick off the week with such joy! I found an American family here, where every Sunday I really have the opportunity to learn more about God.

It is a joy to see how the church is concerned about integrating young people and children so that we have a future generation of worshipers and people who love God with all their hearts.

I am a volunteer and with great pleasure to be part of this church that is concerned in doing everything beautiful and organized.

It's beautiful the way we are directed to God and the concern to reach more people from the local community to actually have an encounter with God.

I am very proud of the leaders of this church.  People who serve with love, humility and affection/care for everyone.
I really see the love of God in them!
Polite and capable people who bring us closer to God every day.
Definitely I love my church, I love this Grace family that God gave me.
#ilovemychurch

And if you have a child, be sure to visit this place!  Amazing people, worship, message and Sunday school.
Lots of events dedicated to the little ones and adults too. Visit the website and check it out.

I hope you can visit this place and have a good experience like I've been having in the last 2 years

name: Grace Community Church of Willow Street
Grace Community Church of Willow Street - Main Campus
Grace Fellowship - West Palm Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
A great place to hear the word of God proclaimed in a most relatable fashion. There is a Pastor there that give the most amazing hugs. Sometimes the background music and instruments overwhelm the voices of the most excellent chorus. 6/29/2022

Visited Grace Fellowship while I was here on vacation. I chose this one because it is similar to my home church. The Pastor was engaging and the Praise & Worship team were good. When I come back to Florida to visit family I'll visit this church again! I absolutely love this church it’s a honor to be a member they sing beautiful music for Jesus plus pastor Jeff never disappoints with his preaching he’s so amazing at what he does and he doesn’t preach a luke warm gospel I admire how he’s not afraid to say the hard things and that’s exactly what Jesus would want him too do! I ❤️ Grace Fellowship a church for all nations! Don’t look any further choose this church you won’t regret it !!! I attended as a visitor today.  Great Bible based teaching and people made me feel welcome from the parking lot to the greeters.   God Bless this church and all those who attended. I started attending Grace Fellowship this month and I have to say there is such a huge bunch of wonderful people. I love this church. Thank you to Pastor Frank for Baptizing me today. I feel so great words can’t express. I am so excited to start my new foundation at Grace Fellowship. I look forward to service and growing in my faith. Thank you Grace Fellowship

name: Grace Hills Church
reviewSummary: Grace Hills is a warm, welcoming church home. Pastor Mike is wonderful.

name: GraceLife Sarasota - Sarasota Campus
reviewSummary:
GraceLife Sarasota has been such a blessing in my life. From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed, accepted, and at peace. The atmosphere is genuine, the people are kind, and you can truly feel the presence of God there. It’s not about appearances or perfection..it’s about grace, growth, and real connection.

The messages are powerful, honest, and rooted in truth. They meet you where you are and encourage you to become who you’re meant to be. In a world that can feel heavy and overwhelming, this church feels like a place of rest, hope, and renewal.

If you’re looking for a church that feels like family, where you can come as you are and experience real love and support, GraceLife Sarasota is that place. I’m incredibly grateful to have found it. It’s already embarrassing enough when you have to go to a food pantry for the first time in over a year and a guy that works for the church yells at everyone like they are a cattle of sheep waiting in line. There were signs on one side that don’t say exit but the other side had no signs and my gps pulled me in I had never been before . He starts screaming at me you do not park there and I told him I’m sorry that’s why I was going to ask where to go and he goes that’s why the signs are there …. The signs weren’t on the side I pulled into . They might give out helpful items but idk if I’ll ever go there again in need Pastor Joe is awesome.  It's a small but growing church. I'm new there but my husband has been going for over a year. The people are very welcoming. Grace Life is a great place for recovery from alcohol and drugs. The have church service on Sunday, daily AA meetings,  women's NA meeting on Friday night, Bible study on Wednesday night and food pantry on Mondays. Pastor Joe and his wife Jackie are the most generous people I've met, plus they have a day care so parents can enjoy services with no worries. I can't say enough about how they've helped change my life. I thank God they're there. 🙏❤️ Great place to worship. Pastor Joe Davis is an amazing teacher. He loves his people ❤️

name: Granada Church - Coral Gables Campus
reviewSummary:
I visited this church for the first time last Saturday for a memorial for Pam Morse and have to say even though I am catholic I was very impressed with the church building, the service and the overall experience.  We live out of the area but would consider attending service in the future. Chopin for All
A monthly performance by virtuous pianist, in such a beautiful church.  No my doctrine of believe, but nevertheless you'll feel embraced by the warming atmosphere. Check the Chopin Foundation for calendar of events.  Sorry to say that I don't know a lot more about this beautiful building. Granada is my family in Miami because my parents and brother don’t live in South Florida. I am grateful for a spiritual community that is so supportive and encouraging. AND they welcome my students to become part of the family, as well! Granada Church is WONDERFUL!!! From
the senior pastor, Worth Carson, to all the others who fervently labor there I can honestly say that my family and I have been blessed and are being spiritually fed.  We absolutely love this church. May our Lord Jesus Christ continue blessing Granada Church and all who attend it.  Jesus is good all the time. ❤️❤️❤️ Granada truly feels like home! The sermons are deeply rooted in the Bible while remaining approachable and relevant. I love the strong sense of community here, with so many small groups and discipleship opportunities to help you grow in your faith. The children's ministry is fantastic, offering an engaging and meaningful program on Sunday mornings, while the youth group is vibrant and welcoming, meeting on Wednesday nights. Whether you're looking for fellowship, spiritual growth, or a place for your family to thrive, Granada is a wonderful place to be. I highly recommend it!

name: Green Street Baptist Church - Main Campus
Gulf Coast Christian Church - Pensacola Campus
reviewSummary: Had a great visit with Gulf Coast Christian Church.  That visit turned into a new church home! Are you looking for a church that has a servant leadership heart? Come visit, I can't wait to meet you! I have been going to this Church for about 2 years. I am very close to the staff and they are very friendly to everyone. They are the people that helped me get closer to God. I will always go here for church until I die. This church welcomed me with opened arms when I needed my community the most. The spirit of God is truly alive and living in this church!! I have been going to Gulf Coast Christian church for over 5 years. I was rebaptisted by Scott , an elder of the church.God gave me a blessing of my not having to be on oxygen all the time. Thank God and. Jesus hold me in their arms. Amen. Gulf Coast made us feel like family from the moment we walked in. The teaching is easy to comprehend and apply. God blessed me to an amazing family in Gulf Coast and I am so thankful.

name: Harborside Christian Church - Clearwater Campus
reviewSummary:
I came to Harborside Christian Church for a BNI networking event and had a great experience. The facility is beautiful, clean, and very welcoming. It was a great place to bring local business leaders together to connect and build relationships. You can tell this church cares about the community and creates a great environment for people to gather. Grateful for the hospitality and for churches that open their doors to support the local business community. From the moment Harborside announced they were building the chapel, I was in awe. I watched the progress week after week, attended the groundbreaking ceremony, and fell more in love as the mission and heart behind it unfolded. I knew long before I was engaged that one day I would get married there.

Just under two years after it was completed, I got engaged—and there was no question. The chapel was my one non-negotiable. From the very beginning, the process was seamless. Our coordinator reached out almost immediately, we chose our date, and planning felt easy and intentional.

We were incredibly blessed to have Pastor Kurt officiate our wedding. The premarital equipping was truly priceless. We were matched with mentors who were a perfect fit—especially meaningful since the husband was a pilot like my own. Those honest, real conversations prepared us for marriage in ways we didn’t even know we needed.

Our wedding day was absolutely stunning and seamless. From the décor and timeline to the ceremony and music, everything was perfection. I would choose this chapel over and over again. You don’t just gain a beautiful venue—you gain mentors, support, and the love of the entire Harborside Church congregation. Forever grateful. Great venue for hosting community and business events. I came for a BNI networking meeting and the space was clean, welcoming, and well organized. It’s great to see a church that opens its doors to support local businesses and bring people together. Appreciate the hospitality and the positive environment they’ve created for the community Harborside has been such a welcoming place for me as a recent widow and new resident to the area.  The leadership is filled with genuine love for Jesus and for others.  The worship is heartfelt and the messages empowering and inspiring.  It is a place where families are supported and so many options to grow in small groups. I am so blessed to be a part of this Christian community. Have been attending Harborside for about a year and a half and though it can feel a little overwhelming due to the amount of people, the worship and teaching is so good! I volunteer with the widow's ministry and it has just been such an honor to serve in this way. I encourage others to step out and find your place in this huge church family. All Praise and Glory to God!

name: Harbour Church - Sarasota Campus
reviewSummary:
I found this church a few months ago and have now made it my home church. The atmosphere is so welcoming, and every sermon is intentional and relatable. I highly recommend those who are strong in their faith or just exploring it! I recently visited this church and loved the people and welcoming atmosphere but found the volume of worship to be uncomfortably loud. While I understand some enjoy a concert like worship experience, I had to leave early due to a headache from the sound levels.

A slight adjustment in sound levels could make a BIG difference for people who are more sensitive to volume. I’d love to come back again and possibly make this my home church if the sound levels were brought down a couple notches. It really seems like there is an amazing community here and a lot to offer! This is a great church. I used to listen to the sermons on their website. I live close to this church so I found it on Google maps.
I really liked that they pray for understanding before they even tell the message.
After a while listening to the sermons for a few months I had a chance to check it out and so I did.
This church is really big on actually doing community service and helping people and I am a big believer that I should be doing that. I like that this church challenges me to be a better Christian. To actually serve the people and make a difference and do God's will.
As I am not an elderly person I like that the church isn't this full of just elderly people as many churches that I've been to have been.
I have just started going to this church but from my impressions they seem to all have a very loving supportive community. A very closely connected church. A family. I had the pleasure of visiting this church in Sarasota over the weekend, and it was an incredible experience from start to finish. The worship was uplifting and filled with powerful, heartfelt music that truly drew me into the presence of God. The message was biblically sound, insightful, and deeply impactful. You can tell this is a church that values truth, community, and authentic worship. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a Christ-centered and welcoming place to grow in their faith! My favorite thing about Harbour Church is the value for God’s presence and the close runner up is the amazing community!

name: Harrison United Methodist Church
reviewSummary: Great blended worship. The contemporary service in Hammill Hall is fantastic.

name: Heritage Christian Fellowship - Orange Campus
reviewSummary:
...Sometimes you wanna go where everybody knows your name, and they're always glad you came... Thank you for a warm welcome.
I'm a visitor but being welcome like a long term members. God bless and guide you all. Pastor Tom is an amazing and very cerebral teacher. He livingly teaches Gods Word as true truth that reveals to all of us real peace and love! Please give Heritage Christian Fellowship a visit end experience great teaching and wonderful fellowship. Friendly members who exhibit the best form of Christian acceptance and forgiveness. They welcomed me with open arms. Wonderful place, wonderful pastors, and wonderful-accepting church members. No cliques! Such a gift to our community! Warm, friendly, caring and loving pastor’s and church. Pastor Tom and other wonderful people prayed for me the first time I came. Felt so welcomed.

name: Hiland Park Baptist Church - Panama City Campus
reviewSummary:
Red flags and we dont plan on coming back a second time.

Visited on Mother's day and although they looked solid on their website, the preaching was less than 10 minutes of the time the pastor spent up there. Rest of the time was telling jokes or stories that didn't really tie into the passage.
Hope this was a fluke but will not be coming back to this mega church.

The only person who greeted us was at the door despite having an entire welcome  desk fully staffed. First time here, fantastic service, genuine and kind people and atmosphere. The Pastor pulls you in with his words and makes your soul want more. I can't say enough good things! Praise GOD! Excellent place to worship. Wonderful children's ministry. The preaching is solid. So will definitely try this church again. But it’s massive and can feel overwhelming, from the parking to finding your way in and to the right areas, especially if it’s your first time and don’t know the layout. We followed crowds in the side doors and ended up in the youth area. Someone in youth asked if we were new, helped my son check in and then told me how to cut through to the waiting area so I could wait for the next service.
I sat in the foyer and observed from about 9:30-10:15 while I waited for the 9am service to get out and the 10:30 one to start.
I was never greeted, no one ever spoke a word to me as they passed by, but I stayed.
The service was really good, from the music to the preaching, which the message is what we came for. But if you’re late, you may not find a seat if you have 3 or more people and looking to sit together.
Our daughter is moving to PC for college and my son is in The Nutcracker, so we’re looking for somewhere we can go while visiting PC and a church our daughter can call home.
We’ll definitely try this church again.

The message was solid and biblical and there wasn’t any fluff to it and it was delivered well. 5/5 for the preaching. Never have I ever step foot inside of church I felt so quickly at home and at peace with the Lord

name: Hillsong Church
reviewSummary: Synonymous with modern worship music. The vibe is creative, fashionable, and metropolitan.

name: Historic St. Mary's Catholic Church - Main Campus
Holy Family Catholic Church & Cathedral - Main Campus
Holy Trinity Catholic Church
reviewSummary: A beautiful and highly reverent parish in Ladera Ranch. Phenomenal community and staff. Excellent family environment. Childrens programs and youth ministries are top-tier.

name: Homeport Christian Church - St. Augustine Campus
reviewSummary: We broke down on our trip home and couldn't make it to our home Church family.  Homeport was a wonderful Christian family that was very welcoming and appears to be very vibrant.  They also seem to take God's Word very seriously.  I highly recommend you give them a try!  Start fellowshipping with other Christians the way God tells you to! This is my Church home! I love it here! Everyone is very friendly and welcoming. Lots of opportunities to get involved and spread the Word of Jesus. The Pastors are great, I feel like each of them are talking to me, not above me. If you need a Church home, please try mine! Everyone is friendly and welcoming and the message is always biblical. My home church there every Sunday love the people here if you arw wanting a great place to go to fellowship here it is. Great place to donate clothing right off of US1 South

name: Hope Fellowship
reviewSummary: Reviews consistently describe the vibe as 'relaxed' and 'come as you are.' The 'no dress code' culture is a major plus for new visitors. The 'Growth Track' and small groups are cited as easy on-ramps for community.

name: Hyde Park Presbyterian Church - Tampa (Hyde Park) Campus
reviewSummary: Friendly neighborhood church, growing, newly invigorated congregation. Loads of young people, babies and children, along with long time regulars. Very upbeat, interesting and varied people and activities. It feels like another family at this Church . Friendly people  dedicated to serving others , good fellowship.  They love the Lord and they sure love food- launched the  first Food Truck Rally in Tampa!  This is a well run Church with two very caring Pastors. Friendly people, 60 min. Service 9am live band modern service lots young people 18 up, 11:15 am traditional with hand bells for christmas season. They give help to community, adult sun school 10:15 am choose from 2 classes, study bible or Christian book w/discussion. Warm atmosphere, would highly recommend to anyone looking for a place to build meaningful relationships with others. Good fellowship and music too. Lovely church in the heart of Tampa's Hyde Park district. Attended memorial service.

name: Hyde Park United Methodist Church - Tampa (Hyde Park) Campus
reviewSummary:
Today, I decided to leave my church.

I can't sit through another political sermon where the phrase "White Supremacy" is used again and again, and I'm told I'm not doing enough for the LGBTQ+++ crowd.

I want a church that has more crucifixes than rainbow flags and whose bishop doesn't send videos to play about how he protests at whatever the church's politics-du-jour is.

And thus, I am no longer a member of the United Methodist Church. I am attending a 3 week seminar with a catered dinner beforehand. Everything is well thought out. Clean and organized When my wife and I are in Tampa visiting her adult children, we always make time to worship at this loving church. If you are seeking a church home, this is a great congregation to consider. They minister to all with no judgement, in the footsteps of Jesus. Wonderful church. Great welcoming congregation and fantastic Sr Pastor.
Come join us! A great church in Hyde Park with great available classes  . Especially like Reverends  Vicky Walker and Justin.
They have a wonderful outreach center downtown called Portico that offers a wide range of services, classes and a nice cafe.
Check them both out and you'll be very happy you did!

name: Immaculate Conception Catholic Church - Downtown Campus
International Bible Church - Boca Raton Campus
reviewSummary:
May God bless your church!🙏 This is my beautiful Church!
It's a place for prayer, communion with God and friends. We are Ukrainians and we received products in this place. Beautiful souls, beautiful people, so kind and generous! Thank you so much! 🤍 Hi there! I received products here and can say only good words and blessing to them! The products are perfect, definitely recommend to others! Beautiful people, beautiful message, beautiful church that truly helps! God bless! Thank you also for helping my Mom with food!

name: Irvine Campus (Main Campus)
reviewSummary: A world-class megachurch with an incredible campus and professional worship. Outstanding children programs. The sermons are so practical and relevant. Changed my family's faith walk.

name: Irvine Community Church - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
this church literally changed my life. i'm so glad i made the decision to walk in alone, 3/30/25. i was welcomed by everyone and was treated with incredible dignity and kindness. i got saved on 5/11/25. it felt like a miracle. the connections i found with others and God here are impeccable. this church has a firm group of believers. nice size that gives you a small-town vibe because of the regulars so you'll get to know everyone and have a tight-knit small circle. definitely go if you're a believer and live here or are visiting oc. best first church experience Visited whilst on holiday in the area. Felt welcomed by a faithful body of believers and edified by biblical preaching from the pulpit. Hope to worship with them again if in the area. Grace and peace be with you. Great Bible preaching.  Good mix of singing traditional hymns and songs as well as newer songs.  Harmonica player and other instrumentalists join in the music portion of the service.  Fellowship time is friendly.  People are nice and make you feel welcome. I've attended Irvine Community Church (ICC) for almost 10 years. I appreciate that ICC is committed to teaching Scripture, using a careful and thorough hermeneutic.

I worked for Christianity Today International, the publisher of Christianity Today magazine. I was a member of the Evangelical Press Association. I have a master's in Christian Apologetics from Biola University.

I believe the Bible is inerrant because it is God's Word. I would only attend a church that teaches the Bible as such. ICC is a great church for anyone who wants to dig deep into Scripture and be transformed by God. --Holly Vicente Robaina A truly Bible believing church.  Love the expository preaching style.  People are warm and love the Lord.

name: Irvine South Campus
reviewSummary: Outstanding contemporary campus. Friendly people and highly practical messages. Saddleback Kids program is awesome. My children love coming here.

name: Jax Church - Jacksonville (Southside) Campus
reviewSummary: My wife and I have been members/disciples here for over 30 years! We have deep friendships and are fully involved in various aspects of serving GOD’s church! Feel free to come check us out! You’ll feel at home immediately!!  Al and Mo Stein Love this place! People are genuine and friendly and its a Great place to feel like home. Really diverse congregation. I love this church. From the moment I walked through the door I was welcomed. Lovingly! I've been attending here for over a year now. I love how welcoming Jax Church crazy family is. They are always there to answer questions and help lead others to Christ. The first time I attended there was a dinner after the service everyone welcomed me with open hearts and open arms. Our family attends this church. We would recommend it to others too! Felt warmth and acceptance, when I needed it the most.  I have always felt ‘preached at’ in churches, but here I felt like part of ‘a conversation’ and that inclusivity is what helped me to actually understand God and to read my own bible.  Thank you! everyone for being great examples of ‘what God’s family’ has to look like with great compassion, and an accepting love.

name: Johnson Ferry Baptist Church
reviewSummary: A large Baptist church offering blended worship styles with strong family and children's ministry programs.

name: King of Kings Church - Millard Campus
Laguna Beach United Methodist Church
reviewSummary: Laguna Beach UMC is about true acceptance. Very friendly and open hearts.

name: Laguna Niguel Presbyterian Church
reviewSummary: A wonderful, highly welcoming local church family. Friendly people and solid messages.

name: Laguna Presbyterian Church
reviewSummary: A beautiful historic church in the heart of Laguna. Highly welcoming and excellent preaching. Love the blended worship options and the very active kids Sunday school.

name: Lake Forest Campus
reviewSummary: A friendly local church with a welcoming congregation and practical messages.

name: Lakepointe Church
reviewSummary: A massive, multi-campus church in Rockwall/Dallas area. Known for high production quality and practical teaching series.

name: Lakeside Community Chapel - Clearwater Campus
reviewSummary:
I really enjoy worshiping at this church.  The teaching is very very good.  Verse by verse and I am learning so much Pastor Steve delivers very good expository, Bible based, verse by verse preaching sermons every Sunday. It's a
fresh breath of air in comparison to other churches who only delivers sermons whose agenda is to tickle people's ears. I strongly advice you to check out Lakeside if you are seeking and longing to hear God's Word preach as what it says and not take it out of context. You will learn about the Bible in it's entirety from Genesis through Revelation. Great Place, wonderful church that teaches the ays of the bible and the truth found in God, no fallacies or false teachings are found there. They have classes of different subjects that are on a 15 week cycle at the school behind the church and then there is a service in the church itself that is taught by the pastor or occasionally by a guest speaker. Overall it teaches you how to live your life as a Christian without any changes made to the Bible and always offers help to those who are struggling in faith or financially (if member). This church loved me when I hated them and God. They prayed me into salvation by grace alone. What love is this that they cared for me a pill addict. What love is this that I am now free. What love is this that I am now called a child of God! Thank you Lakeside Church and continue glorifying our Father in heaven and the only name by which we must be saved - Jesus Christ - he is mighty to save! I have been attending Lakeside for a year now and the Lord has blessed me through their ministry profoundly. The teaching is nothing but the Word of God in context. Solid food is served every Sunday from the pulpit.
The people have counseled/discipled & edified me throughout my time. With any church one has to do their part to get involved and reach out but once you do they are faithful to come along side you in the race we all are running together for the glory of God.

name: Lakewood Church
reviewSummary: The largest church in America. Reviews center on the 'encouraging' and 'uplifting' message of Joel Osteen. The facility (former Compaq Center) is massive. Critics cite lack of depth, but attendees love the positivity.

name: Lancaster Church of the Brethren - Main Campus
Latonia Christian Church - Covington Campus
reviewSummary: A Bible learning community church that will welcome new guests into our church family. Very nice venue for concerts, acoustically excellent. Love everyone here we are a big family for sure Friendly people! Traditional worship. 2 services- 9:30 am and 11 am. I loved the service and the way the minister told the story about Barbara.

name: LCBC Church (Lives Changed By Christ) - Main Campus
Legacy Church - Plano Campus
reviewSummary: We started going to church here in early 2018.  After just a few weeks, we decided to go to their new member class. We really loved the pastors they have on staff and the way they brought the message of Jesus and salvation down to an easy to understand level. We are now members and part of a life group. Legacy Church is awesome for families with young kids, single adults, or empty nesters.  The women's ministry has great programs and plenty of opportunities to get involved and plugged in. Great to be back in the HOUSE!!! Even though everyone had on masks you could see the smiles in their eyes. So glad we're meeting in person again. In fact, we're having to have an 8:30 service in addition to the 10:30!! Plus, LIVE ONLINE for those not quite ready to be in the building. I love my church!! As an introvert, it has always been a challenge for me to meet new people, especially at church. For this reason, I have always had a hard time finding a church where I feel like I belong. The moment I walked into Legacy Church, however, I was immediately welcomed by genuine, caring people. I felt like I truly belonged, and after 3 years, I still feel like I belong. The people in this church really CARE and have made a huge impact on my life, helping me to trust Jesus every step of the way. Very welcoming environment, friendly staff. Children’s ministry is the best I’ve seen. Sermons include direct bible reading, reasoning and helpful application ideas on real life topics. You hear and feel Love, Truth of the Word and the presence of God in this place. Highly recommend to beginners of faith, or someone looking for a church home near by. Legacy is very warm and welcoming place helping people learn about and follow Jesus. Legacy has a great kids ministry and other groups and programs to help us all grow and advance in our walk with Jesus. On your first visit you’ll feel like you’ve been attending for years! See you Sunday!

name: Legacy Church O.C - Orange Campus
reviewSummary:
Legacy Church on Tustin Street in City of Orange 🍊 CA is located in old The Village 📽️ Movie Theater. Huge parking 🅿️ lot
Has several service types & times. Many in Espanol. Very well maintained inside and out. Great for the community! 🤙 Legacy Church is a BIG family! The moment you stepped in you feel like you've belonged there for ages. Glory of God, Great message and exceptional leaders. Pastor Uzziel and Julie  are amazing  and readily available. Join us and feel the presence of God! Your life won’t be the same. If your looking for a welcoming atmosphere and a place where you can truly make a connection with God. Definitely come to this church I started attending Legacy Church of Orange County since June 2023.  I was looking to go deeper into my walk with God. This is it! The Holy Spirit is a strong presence at every service!  If you need any healing and deliverance, this is the place. English 10 am and Spanish 12 pm and Weds Spanish 7:30 pm.  The worship is Spirit filled. Everyone here is so welcoming! I am learning so much. Excited to start attending Legacy University soon! Awesome church. Pastor Uzziel is amazing. A church where you feel like one of the family with tons of opportunities to serve. The Word is deep and powerful - worship is amazing they allow the move of the Holy Spirit to flow. I loved the cafe options as well.

name: Legacy Church Pensacola - Pensacola Campus
reviewSummary: This church has felt like home from the first time we walk through the doors. We are so grateful that God put legacy church from Pensacola in our paths and they have become nothing less than family. Even our children have grown so much mentally and in the Grace of this place of worship and amazing people. If you need a good place to worship and feel the Holy Spirit fill a room with people who are going to love you for exactly the person that you are, please I so encouraged you to visit our church. 🙌⛪ Good bless Legacy church stands out for its loving and supportive community. Following our move to Pensacola over a year ago, we visited multiple local churches without finding the warmth we experienced at Legacy. Pastor Ryan and Kim have a heart for the Pensacola community. If you are new to the area check out this awesome church. Warmest and most welcoming church I've ever been to. The people are so friendly and genuine. I think the church congregation itself is a direct reflection of the Pastoral Leadership there. Birds of a feather flock together. If you're looking for a place to call home where you'll be welcomed without judgement or condemnation, check out Legacy Church Pensacola. We feel blessed to belong. We absolutely LOVE Legacy Church! The atmosphere and the people are loving and welcoming. This church has everything from the great preaching, powerful moves of God, and incredible worship. I highly recommend to anyone looking for a church to call home! From the moment I walked in the door, I felt such love and acceptance from each person I encountered at RLC! The services are dynamic with in depth preaching from the Pastor, the worship is great, and the children’s department is top notch. There are so many opportunities to make friends and get involved- no matter what your demographic is. I look forward to church every week!

name: Liberty Baptist Church
reviewSummary: Outstanding expository Bible teaching and welcoming community.

name: Life Christian Church - Stanton Campus
reviewSummary: I've made so many great people. The pastor is great as well. It's an overall great church. You must at least visit. Pastor Shane speaks boldly from the Bible and provides in-depth study for those who want to grow their faith in Jesus

name: Life Church - Fort Myers Campus
reviewSummary:
I had been searching for a church in Fort Myers, asking the Lord to lead me to where He wanted me to plant myself and take root. He led me to Life Church, and I am truly grateful.
I look forward to attending every week. The teachings from Pastor Ryan are inspiring, biblical, and relevant. I genuinely feel that the Lord speaks through him to deliver His message to the body of Christ.
If you want to experience His presence and be fed by the Word of God, this is the church for you. The worship is excellent—genuine, heartfelt, and moving. The presence of the Holy Spirit is present. The sermons are enlightening and challenging, firmly rooted in Scripture while still being accessible to all believers. I occasionally invite friends that are new believers and they have understanding of the messages as well.
The sense of community is strong, and from the moment I arrived, I felt welcomed and encouraged in my walk with Christ. I am thankful that God led me here. If you want to feel the presence of Holy Spirit, and be fed by the word of God, this is the church for you. The contemporary worship is excellent, genuine and moving.  The sermons are enlightening and challenging, Bible based yet accessible for new believers.  The sense of community is strong. Trying to pick up our children from the daycare service was nothing short of just terrible….the experience was extremely disappointing. No one was willing to work with me or offer a solution, and no one apologized for the inconvenience. Instead, the security team was rude and dismissive, which made me feel uncomfortable and unwelcome.

This was especially upsetting because just last week my husband accidentally lost our tag, and the experience was completely different. The staff was kind, patient, and helpful. They explained the policy clearly and worked with us to ensure our children were safely returned without any hostility or embarrassment.

Today, however, I was stopped in the entrance hallway even though my husband had walked in just two minutes before me (with our tag). I was only trying to meet him so we could pick up our children together. I have picked up my kids many times in the past without being stopped until reaching the classroom door, so this inconsistency was confusing and frustrating. I will also add I watched several people walk in without a tag (my mom included) so I’m not sure why they had this issue with me.

Instead of being offered a solution, I was followed out of the church by a staff member who continued to speak to me rudely. Not being understanding of my feelings at all and just kept trying to prove her point. It truly saddens me that we were treated this way, especially because we have loved attending services here. Until today, this church had felt welcoming and supportive. We were believing God to find a church in this area and He led us to Life Church. We were so impressed with everything there from the time we turned into the parking lot. Praise and Worship was outstanding and the preaching was wonderful as well. It was so refreshing to hear preaching that led to eight people to joining the family of God. We thank God for leading us to this church we can't wait to roll up our sleeves and join the Laborers bringing in the harvest.
Now we are believing God to find a home in this area, it is too far of a drive from Chicago. We loved everything there keep doing it saints! The worship service can be powerful for a protestant denomination church. The pastor seems to know his church history and bible and best of all, the congregation is amazing. I love coming here to hear the word of God and interact with magnificent people. What a blessing to have this church so close to home even though I am not a protestant. It is still very powerful to see how it moves the congregation and how the community can be involved with such a great mission. They seem to do a lot with the community and mission of the Lord. I hope they can remain active in the community and be a change for the better. The seats ate comfortable and the parking is plenty. The interior is pretty bland but what is lacking in decor is made up for in character. I love how the sermon is applicable to every day life and can be used as a tool for bettering you and everybody around you. I hope to attend this church again in the future.

name: Life Church of Orange CA - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: I believe that this church has lost it's way. For awhile they were really involved and caring about their community. Now it is typical of so many evangelical churches that have lost their way and followed after partisan ideologies rather than true Christian principles. They need to get back to their true roots and what they once were. Christ, Bible, and community centered church. Excellent Spirit-filled worship. Outstanding in every way

name: Life.Church
reviewSummary: Pioneers of the multi-site video model and creators of the Bible App. High-tech, consistent experience across locations. Craig Groeschel's leadership teaching is a major draw.

name: Life.Church West Palm Beach - West Palm Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Nice church with very good sermons and good people. Music is a little loud for me but perhaps that’s because I’m 60.

They have several locations including one in Wellington or royal palm beach and another location in west palm beach.

The Bible app they created is very highly recommended. You get the Bible in any language or Bible version you want included the very popular and easy to understand New International Version. We love our church! Over two years strong at Life.Church WPB and wouldn’t trade it for anything. Love our church family 💜 if you’re looking for a place that you feel instantly welcome, come check it out. One service and you’ll see just how special this place is. Guaranteed. The entire LC WPB team is amazing. You can expect to feel comfortable and at home when you come to LC West Palm Beach. Josh, and his team, take such an active role in serving their community.  I have been a member of LC for about 5 years now and it has changed my life.  Thank You to the LC team for all they do. Love and miss going to this church every Sunday hopefully soon life church will open doors in Port Saint Lucie The best church  loving, caring, on fire for christ. .Whoever finds God Finds life.

name: Lifesong Church - Tampa Palms Campus
reviewSummary:
I absolutely LOVE Lifesong! I came to this church after moving to Florida from Missouri and Florida was such a shock to me but Lifesong made me feel like I had found family.  No judgement, no whispers behind my back. They just loved me without question. The pastor teaches directly out of the Bible and is led by the Holy spirit. Here you will know God is love. Here you will find everything you need to know that God is real and that he loves you. Here you will know the Holy Spirit and here you will find the love your life needs to make the difference, find that comfort and hope that will change your life forever. Here you can find home and unconditional love. I am a retired transplant to Florida.  I came three years ago, alone.  I wanted a good spirit-filled, Word fed church where I could fit.  Lifesong opened their doors and hearts to me.  I have been attending for two years and one of the pastors said it perfectly to me yesterday when he commented that I served for two services even on my birthday.  I said that I wouldn't want to be anywhere else.  He said "Because it's home."  This is a wonderful church that is fed by the Word and Jesus shows up every time!  With all their hearts they truly do Love Out Loud! Lifesong is an intimate worship community who welcomed us from the moment we walked in. Members of the church "love out loud", consistently looking to connect with Christ and to bless others. As you can imagine, this attitude creates an atmosphere that is quite invigorating. Pastor Svend and his wife, Katy, are an endearing couple who I'm convinced can connect with just about anyone. They are confident, passionate, upbeat, and serve as excellent role models.

If you are looking for a new church family, give Lifesong a shot! This is the best church I have ever been to. I love pastor Svend because his words are so encouraging. He is also an amazing life coach. His wife is also an amazing example of a great Christian female. They accept all to come and worship our father. If you want to have a relationship with Jesus and you want to see him work miracles in your life, this is the church to learn how to do that. God bless you and may you find the Lord. Amen Lifesong Church is such an inviting and welcoming place! They have the best worship and the pastor brings an amazing message that can apply to everyone! They have great childcare and people of all ages who attend! This is the best church in Tampa and I recommend everyone check it out!

name: Light of Christ Lutheran Church
reviewSummary: Excellent LCMS church. The verse-by-verse expository study is outstanding.

name: Lighthouse Church - Miami Beach Campus
reviewSummary: If you’re travelling and visiting, I’d highly recommend. Came with the wife and we didn’t know what to expect, but we came out grateful and glad! It is very hard to find a place in South Beach where people worship the Lord with their heart, soul and mind...But do not lose hope...This church did not disappoint.... A young team in the worship, but with a lot of experience... Even during the service , people in need were helped with food etc...It's not the quantity but quality with this church... Lighthouse Church is a beautiful place to worship as it provides the opportunity to feel closer to God. Everybody is very kind and welcoming. I would recommend visiting when you are searching for a community of believers who regularly come together to express their faith. The church was an intimite setting with few faithfull members, yet to find a perminent residence for their worship service which runs during Sunday morning 11:00am and is in need of members to visit and attend morning service. Show your support and if in the area, bring an open mind. Great people! Music, coffee and encouragement from God's Word.

name: Lighthouse Church - Panama City Campus
reviewSummary:
Five stars for Lighthouse Church. From the moment we walked in, everyone was genuinely friendly and welcoming. As a full-time RV family, we visit a lot of churches across the country, and feeling immediately at home is important for us. This one delivered.

Worship was moving and on point - heartfelt, engaging, and centered where it should be. The pastor was passionate and relatable, sharing truth in a way that felt both grounded and practical for real life.

Our kids loved the kids area, which is always a huge win for us. When the kids are excited to go back, you know you’ve found something special.

If you’re looking for a church where you’ll be welcomed right away and hear solid, passionate preaching, Lighthouse Church is absolutely worth a visit. The picture below is some quotes I took from the so called “pastor” The whole service was about what you bring to the church and zero information about the gospel. I have never felt so terrible leaving a church service. Although I’m young I have been lucky enough to grow up in church but seeing all the young people at this church that might not have had that opportunity makes me sick to think they hear  that every Sunday. The fact he mentioned his bad emails that he receives says enough for me. In leadership you can’t make everyone happy but I have a feeling his negative emails are a little different. I don’t even want to call him a pastor but the pastor has put himself on such I high pedestal I hate to see the crash he has when he crumbles from the unrealistic pressure he puts on himself and others. Man you talk about a place where the Spirit is, and the Pastor always allows GOD to use him as a tool. As he always says "Let me fade to the back and you take center stage because I can't save them only you can GOD". You will feel so welcome here from the time you walk in, to the time you are getting to your car. Oh and Praise & Worship there WOW that's all I can say is WOW. Such a wonderful church. Just like me if you attend once , I promise you will attend again becoming a part of the church family. Truly blessed to have found my church home an family. I love this place so much I have never felt at home or so happy in a church since I was little. Especially one that doesn't judge that doesn't complain that is an incredible place to be especially when your going threw your own head when I come there on Monday nights I can't wait for Monday to roll around because Im able to dance and sing and go to the front of the stage and just let out all of my tears! This is a place to come to sit and make friends to learn about christ and enjoy your time!

name: Living Hope Baptist Church Main Campus
Living Word Church - Panama City Campus
reviewSummary: Absolutely love this church.This is my home church. Pastor and tge congregation are very loving and kind Great service, friendly staff. Went there with Wounded Beach Retreat to celebrate the dinner and service that had for the Veterans, Thank you for all you do , Awesome worship experience along with some good solid teaching from the Bible. Faith building experience every visit. Was very thankful it was after we had my sister Donna's funeral Everyone is welcoming. Pastor Miller is great at making the Bible understandable.

name: Living Word Lutheran Church
reviewSummary: A traditional Lutheran congregation in the Katy/west Houston area with a warm family community.

name: livingStone Church - St. Augustine Campus
reviewSummary:
If you live here or you’re on vacation in the area and looking for an awesome Church to attend and be uplifted, then livingStone is the place!  From the the very first time my husband and I attended we felt welcomed and accepted.  The people here are so friendly, caring and have become family.  Pastor Chris does a phenomenal job sharing God's word and breaking it down in a way that is easy for everyone to understand. If you love worship music, we have a fabulous worship band.   We also have a wonderful youth ministry.  Come worship with us, you won’t be disappointed. This is a wonderful place! Folks are welcoming and friendly. Great music. Pastor is by the Word, very relatable and always gives ways to apply his message to your everyday life. We love it and consider Living Stone our home church whenever we're in St. Augustine. There's no need to feel shy. Give it a try. You won't be disappointed!! Pastor Chris has a way of teaching the Bible like no other! We were welcomed from the first steps in the door. The music is amazing. Lots of support and fellowship and the Youth Group is solid. Best church in St Augustine area! Livingstone church is a wonderful place to worship.  Chris, the pastor, communicates the word of God like very few can with a transparent, down to earth personality.
The music is worshipful and the people are very friendly and inviting.  Saint Augustine is fortunate to have  a Bible preaching church such as this one.  If you haven’t done so, do yourself a favor and check it out. We are in St. Augustine on vacation and attended service here. The sermon was thought-provoking and Biblically based. Everyone was friendly and welcoming. There are plenty of opportunities for the congregation to meet outside of Sundays.  This would make a lovely home church for anyone living in the area.

name: Local City Church - Tampa (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: I've been attending this church since the very first day they launched and I can proudly say this is HOME. I've found a community here that has helped me feel accepted no matter where I stand in life. If you are looking for somewhere to grow you relationship with God, your Local community, and yourself, then I hope to see you on Sunday :) One of our major concerns we contemplated while considering a move to Tampa 3 years ago was finding a church HOME to continue worshiping, growing our faith and serving by doing. Local City provides all of that and more. We are so thankful. During our stay in Tampa we went to Local city church on the Sunday, before Tropical storm. I couldn’t stop crying! Thank you Holy Spirit for always showing up, when needed. Pastor was Amazing! We've been 2 times now.  Love having this church right in my neighborhood.  Love the reputation they have built with the school.  Heard great report from a friend who is an administrator at Hillsborough high school.  The music is well done,  preaching alive, interesting,  on the spot in doctrine and Jesus is presented and represented in a way I feel makes His heart happy and brings a smile to His face.  It's definitely worth a try if you are seeking answers to life's hard questions or just need something bigger than yourself. Local City Church is home to us. Everyone treats you as one of their own. When my 17 year old daughter told me she wanted to give it a try, I thought it was just going to be a temporary thing. To my surprise she has felt comfortable there since day one. Yes I say surprise because we all know how teenagers are very quick to change their minds. I have sat and have stood next to my daughter and seen how she has been touched by the power of God. When I saw her tears running down her face I felt joy and knew that she was comfortable at Local City Church. God is one in the same no matter where you worship him. I am glad that she has found it in her heart to allow us to call Local City Church home.

name: Local City Church - Tampa (Hyde Park) Campus
reviewSummary: I've been attending this church since the very first day they launched and I can proudly say this is HOME.
