name: Louisville Church of Christ - Main Campus
Madison Avenue Christian Church (Disciples of Christ)
Madison Avenue Christian Church (Disciples of Christ) - Covington Campus
reviewSummary: Feed homeless every 1st wednesday of the month! Good pastor!! People who love the Lord Feeds the homeless on Monday and Wednesday every week, good portions of tasty food with seconds. Also has items to take home with you. Best church ever and most best feeling is when you feel comfortable . A truly wellcoming community. Very Spiritual and caring people. Such a welcoming place with wonderful music, messages, and people!

name: Main Campus
reviewSummary: One of the most beautiful and welcoming Catholic parishes in the country. The liturgy is incredibly reverent. A wonderful faith family. Mass is always uplifting, especially the choir.

name: Maranatha Christian Church (Pompano) - Pompano Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I love attending services at this church. The worship is beautiful, and the preaching is clear, straightforward, and always speaks to our hearts.

The church is very clean, and the people are incredibly welcoming, kind, and friendly. From the moment you walk in, you feel genuinely cared for and well received.

One of the things I admire most about this church is that they don’t constantly preach about prosperity or money, and they don’t spend the service asking people to give. Instead, their focus is on preaching salvation. They are not concerned with asking anyone for money—they are committed to sharing the Gospel.

They follow the example of Jesus, who never charged anyone to heal, save, or set people free. Instead, He paid the ultimate price by dying on the cross for our salvation.

That is the heart of this church: to preach salvation. That is what touched my heart and has kept me here faithfully for so many years.🙏🏼❤️ Can’t speak for the church itself but two believers who go to this church were amazing and following the foot steps of Christ.

I met them at a coffee shop but even then they stayed and listened to my story of my faith.

It’s funny how the world wants to keep us separated but we always find our way to other believers.

May Gods blessing be upon you all that read this. Amen. Many blessings Amazing People Eu amo a maranatha , os irmaos sao muito atenciosos , o culto e uma bencao sempre ... Batizei na maranata quando tinha 13 anos e irei ficar aqui ate a volta do Senhor!

name: Mariners Church
reviewSummary: Known for high-quality production and a very strong 'Family' focus. The teaching is described as 'Practical' and relevant. The physical campus is often noted as beautiful and conducive to community hanging out. 'Rooted' is a key discipleship keyword often mentioned by members.

name: Melbourne Church of Christ - Melbourne Campus
reviewSummary:
My grandmother and I have had horrible experiences with their food pantry workers! A FEW of the women that help with their food pantry have just been SO rude to myself and my grandmother! They treat us like we're trying to steal from them, they are so nasty and quick to get onto you about any little thing they can! They are not helpful and they are just so quick to be so rude ! If they are volunteering, I have NO IDEA why! And if they ARE getting paid, then STOP paying them! Im not too worried about myself but I don't understand why they treated my elderly grandmother so poorly! They have terrible attitudes! Besides those few women, others have been great, helpful and nice and all the men have always been helpful gentlemen! Loved attending worship here while visiting friends in Melbourne this week. The pastor is awesome. He is a younger pastor with an excellent ability to reach the family. The song leader was absolutely wonderful. They were all so passionate about doing their part in worshipping Christ. The rest of the church family was incredibly welcoming and friendly. It is a large building so there is plenty of room for more people to join in a really wonderful church. I can't wait to bring my wife down hopefully after Christmas.
If any of you ever visit Washington PA area. We would love for you to join us in worship as a part of our family. Beautiful church . There is a food pantry on Tuesdays from 9-11 am . Anyone who is in need of a little bit of dry goods and clothes are welcome to come.  The volunteers are so cheerful and always have a smile on their face. My son has his boy scout meeting here. I haven't been to a church meeting here, but I  can tell you about the building. The church is very large, the meeting rooms are spacious, the bathrooms are nice and clean. As far as the main room, it's very large with plenty of seating. There's even tables in there for events. I went for the free food and toys they were giving out to members in the community. I was impressed with the care and help they provide but very disappointed in the people who were there taking advantage but acting rude instead of greatful for any help. Thanks to all the kind wonderful souls who donated there time and items so people in need can have. This place is a regular food bank for the needy. God bless all of you.

name: MELBOURNE COMMUNITY CHURCH - Melbourne Campus
reviewSummary:
I enjoyed my visit to Melbourne Community Church this morning! They are tucked in the strip mall at the corner of 192 and Wickham Road behind the Walgreens.

Great community of believers and great message about the purpose of prayer by Pastor Brandon Harris who joined as the church’s teaching pastor in 2022. The church was founded in 2002 and longtime worship pastor Walter Staub, ordained by MCC in 2003, still leads the congregation in worship today including some of his original songs.

Beautiful, faithful church here! Amazing church that absolutely lives up to their name. It really is centered around the community, and you'll feel so welcome if you stop in. Pastor Brandon is phenomenal and the worship team truly is next level.

If you're looking for a church experience that's personal and genuine, I highly recommend checking out MCC. I've been a member of this church for the last few years. One of the est things that ever happened to me. :-) Pastor Curt is a teaching pastor. . I'm learning so much from the Bible. The praise and worship team is awesome. And there's a lot of original songs. I could go on and on about how much I love this church. Come learn about Jesus. :-) Pastor Brandon delivers the Gospel message straight on.  Going through the Bible book by book... Brandon has insights I haven't considered due to translation from Greek or Hebrew. A message where Jesus is the focus as the Son of God, Savior and Redeemer of our sins. A wonderful experience in a small community Church. Great homey experience with a Pastor who reads scripture and compared them to current events. It is close net and an experience we look forward to each week

name: Memorial Drive United Methodist
reviewSummary: A traditional Methodist church along Memorial Drive offering community-centered worship and family programming.

name: Metro Life Church - Dadeland - Pinecrest / South Miami Campus
reviewSummary:
Greetings family Metro Life Church.
I would like thank, very thanks family Metro Life Church and also to the leaders Steve Alessi, Mary Alessi and all family, moderations that always mention my name that am a regular always watching online, even far. I feel God’s presence in every detail, and I left with a renewed heart. May the Lord bless you all abundantly!
Sincerely
Rochester Santos Silviano from Brazil 🇧🇷, always watching online regular...
God bless you Metro Life Church Dadeland campus is a landmark church in our city! There’s a place for everyone in our family; 0 - 99. The praise and worship is vibrant, the word is challenging, but the community and relationship is what I love most :)

Look no further if you’re looking for a place to connect and call home 💗 My life would not be the same if it wasn’t for this church that I get to call my own. Finding a healthy church that you can integrate with and having healthy relationships has been such a blessing. Worship music is amazing, and the Pastors live by what they preach. If you are looking for a church to call your own don’t hesitate to come in and experience it for yourself. I love Metro Life Church🩵 Metro Life Church is a life living organism.  I have been affiliated with it for over 25 years.   This Church is incredible,  I have never seen anything like it.  It gets better and better with time.  The Alessi family has raised four incredible children who are now adults and they are "ALL" involved in the Ministry, on fire and totally committed.  In this Church,  they don't beg for money. Come check it for yourself. LUCY SMITH Metro Life has been such a blessing. Pastor Mary’s sound track is always playing in my house. God’s doing something special in my heart. He’s also doing something special here and I want to be part of it. ♥️ Thank you, Metro Life.

name: Miami Beach Baptist Church. - Miami Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Miami Beach Baptist Church is a true gem serving the Miami Beach community.  The warm, welcoming atmosphere instantly feels like home. Pastor Ryan Price delivers heartfelt, Bible-based sermons that resonate with those exploring faith, and the congregation is supportive and diverse. The traditional hymns are absolutely amazing, filling the sanctuary with uplifting, soul-stirring melodies that deepen the worship experience. Sunday services at 2:30 PM and Thursdays at 7:00 PM are perfect for connecting with others. Highly recommend this nurturing spiritual community! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Great place to attend Sunday afternoon church services. I have just discovered this small and modest church. Pastor was wonderfully enthusiastic and caring. I feel it will be a good place to learn about  Biblical truths without progessive distortions. I am planning to get Baptised here in February. I have been longing for a bible based church for a long time! I love pastor Johnny, his wife Ana and the community at Miami Beach Baptist church. Come get your soul nourished with God’s living word every Sunday at 2:30pm!! Peaceful, I love to be here

name: Miami Beach Community Church - Miami Beach Campus
reviewSummary: I was a member of this church since I was about 8 years old. I’m 28 now. I stopped attending at 17, when my mother came and told the church I have been being molested for the past few years by the head usher and the members of this church turned the cheek. Not sure why this morning I felt the need to share but anywho, choose your church wisely! My husband and I love visiting different churches when we are traveling. This was a great church with a strong sense of community. We were welcomed and treated like we had been coming to this church regularly for years. Great service and it was perfect place to celebrate Pentecost Beautiful church located on Lincoln Road, the service was nice and the ac was cold My Husband and I travel back and forth to Miami from CT. For many years I walked by this church, either ot was closed or We didn't have time to stop in for Service. Back in May while walking by,  without a word to each other, We walked in.  We have now been to three Services. And I just watched The Service from this am. It was very uplifting to me. Please stop in if You are in area. Thank Paster Cynthia.. I became a member of this church recently but have been coming for years.  Pastor Cynthia Lee is beyond inspiring and truly gifted!!! The music Director, Jose, the fabulous choir, and the entire church team is outstanding.  Everyone from every walk of life is welcome and we are truly a family!

name: Midtown Fellowship
reviewSummary: An urban, authentic community church in Nashville's midtown targeting young adults and professionals.

name: Mission Basilica
reviewSummary: A breathtaking historic basilica and deeply spiritual place. The liturgical services are wonderful. Absolutely beautiful. Serra Chapel is a sacred treasure.

name: Mission Hills Church
reviewSummary: A community-focused church in Mission Viejo offering a casual, family-friendly worship experience.

name: Mission Road Church - Tallahassee Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful, amazing, loving church! The building itself isn’t what makes it a church, it’s the community and people there that make it a church. Everyone is so kind. The sermons are always amazing. The worship is really fun (My dad plays guitar on the worship team). And they have a babies room, a preschool-kindergarten room (at least I’m pretty sure that it’s preschool-kindergarten), and an elementary room for the kids to go in during service. They also have their own little sermons in there. And every Wednesday, they have Students!!! It’s so fun! We get to pray, play games, hang with our homies, worship, listen to a sermon, it’s just so great. I love my church. I love praising God, especially when I’m at Mission Road Church. Peace and Love, y’all! ✝︎❤️
“The Lord is my shepherd, I lack nothing. He makes me lie down in green pastures, he leads me beside quiet waters, he refreshes my soul. He guides me along the right paths for his name’s sake. Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I will fear no evil, for you are with me; your rod and your staff, they comfort me. You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil; my cup overflows. Surely your goodness and love will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the Lord forever.”-Psalms 23 i was made to feel special and welcome! such a laid back hip place to celebrate Jesus’ salvation! honestly i haven’t been to church in years besides tv church. very moving music! and the sermon was very motivational! i highly recommend anyone check out Genesis Church! There is no judgement, clothing, whatever! i didn’t run into a single negative vibe! the entire church was a overflow of positivity!  amazing! i feel charged up! ready to celebrate Easter! They have a ton of events please look into it! Love this Church and Pastor Scott! The church has changed quite a bit from when I first attended. At the beginning of service, the sing to praise the Lord. It used to be 3 songs and now it is four songs which reduces the time that  Pastor Scott preaches the word! I would rather here the word than a 30 minute gospel concert.
All chorus people on stage used to sing altogether. Now , they do not leaving only Pastor Stephanie to do the lead singing! We are praising the Lord and everyone should be singing not just Pastor Stephanie! I do love this church and love going to it! I just wish they would go back to the 3 songs and preach the word longer. Such a wonderful place to call home. I have became a member in October of 2017 and have loved it ever since. The first day I attended Genesis Church was when a hurricane knocked out most power in town. I was looking for a church to go to and the one I originally planned on going to was closed. Genesis had no power in its main building, but some how there was power in the small one. The service was so touching and the atmosphere was very welcoming. I felt comfortable there. Pastor Scott and his team do a great job of being available and making sure that everyone who comes into Genesis is talked to by someone. Genesis Church also does a lot of local events, trying to help our community. I appreciate the compassion there is at Genesis. Genesis Church is amazing! I'm beyond grateful to have found this church a few years ago! Being around people and a pastor who are so passionate about God's love and the importance of showing His love in our daily lives, has given me the support and inspiration to continually grow in my faith and relationship with God. I also enjoy working with the young children in Genesis Kids, connecting with the families and giving back is so rewarding!

name: Mission Viejo Campus
reviewSummary: A beautiful campus. High-quality worship and excellent messages. Highly recommend.

name: Mission Viejo Christian Church
reviewSummary: A wonderful, bible-centered community. Love the modern worship and friendly people.

name: Mount of Olives Church
reviewSummary: A wonderful, active church in Mission Viejo. Kid City is amazing for children. Great blended services. The messages are highly relevant and practical.

name: Mount Paran Church
reviewSummary: A spirit-filled worship community in Atlanta with a diverse congregation and engaging worship experience.

name: Movement Church - Port Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: I’ve been to churches all over the USA, & can honestly say this church has been my Family.  Pastor Nate speaks only the truth, directly from scripture.  His family is filled with the Holy Spirit & it shows in their teaching & singing.  Sunday is my best day of the week because I know I am welcomed & loved at Movement.  This church is what keeps me staying in this area.  I’ve met the most wonderful people there & feel blessed. I’ve held off on writing about this for a couple years now, but after long consideration I’ve finally decided to document it. There was a Sunday service I came to with some male pastor (I don’t remember his name), but it was the fourth part in a multi-week story about David. The topic of sex came up, and slightly homosexuality, and the pastor spoke in a manner of wanting to agitate the youth by reinforcing traditional, anti-progressive ideals. I understand, it’s a church, and they have certain traditions, but the manner in which this particular pastor seemed delighted in the offense of the youth completely turned me off from this church. I never stepped foot in it again, and while I was recently looking for churches to go to, as I would like to return to a weekly service, something told me to submit this review, as a warning and hopefully a lesson for the pastor. Work in God’s name, and don’t be a jerk. I love this church!!!! You feel the holy spirit here.  The staff is amazing.  I love Pastor Nate and his wife Michelle.  Tracy at the children’s ministry is wonderful.  I found my home here!! Thank you Jesus!! ❤️✝️ This is my church home! The moment you walk in, you feel the incredible energy and love. The messages are always relevant and powerful, the people are so welcoming, and the pastor is amazing. I also love that there are three different service times on Sunday, which makes it easy to attend. If you're looking for a church that feels like family, this is it! From the first time I went to Movement, I knew I had found my community. During service you feel the Spirit working through even the hearts of the hardest stone, and bringing about the most amazing life changes. 4 years into being a member of the church, and my daughter and I have grown to truly know the Lord and have been baptized with this church family. There is something for every walk of life, whether the coffee addicts with the best Frappes or macchiatos at the coffee shop, Bible Study for working parents, Young Adults, Student Ministries (which the leaders of are beyond phenomenal), or the many outreach programs that the church is partnered with. I truly cannot recommend a better community, and church family to anyone searching.

name: Murdock Christian Church - Port Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary: Very friendly people. Love the bible lessons! A small group  of Christian sinners worshipping and sharing the love of Jesus together Great ppl and you feel the love here Was a very nice bible study

name: Naples Christian Church - Naples Campus
reviewSummary: I had the pleasure of attending Naples Christian Church this morning and was warmly welcomed by Jamie.  Was able to witness their delightful Christmas play that truly brought the joy of the season to life! As Proverbs says, “A cheerful heart is good medicine” and this church delivered! :) Great sermon, singing and community. Naples Christian Church is my home and it's people are my family.  My faith and connection with God grew when I walked through its doors, got involved, and invested in its people.  As a family we have experienced great highs and challenging lows - and surprise, we are not perfect - but through it all we strive to love, follow the Spirit and do what we can to help Christ radically change lives. Above all, I learned at NCC that it really isn't all about me - but about worshiping and working for the God who orchestrates it all.  I am proud to call NCC home. My church family  home for 33 years. A special place to worship, be accepted and feel the love and unity of believers. You feel like family from your first visit. Most caring and kind people I’ve ever met !!!

name: Naples Church of Christ - Naples Campus
reviewSummary: We attended service only which started at 9 AM,  Good sermon. The worship was uplifting. The sermon and worship were bible based.  God wants us to be loving, kind and generous to others. This Church exhibits the spirit of love. That is a wonderful place to workshop with God and Jesus it is a big congregation and very friendly and helpful and loving people. Bible study is first at 10 am then church services is at 11 to 12 at night is at 6 PM on Wednesday night it starts ai 6: 30pm.we enjoy it there. Great service worshipping God! They are very liberal, like a denomination.

name: Naples Community Church - Naples Campus
reviewSummary:
I found Naples Community Church online recently.  I feel I was led there by to Lord and my experience has been wonderful. The people there are very warm and friendly. The music and worship are inspiring and the worship leader's singing can bring tears to your eyes. I always watch for a Gospel message from the pastor and he has delivered it every time.  His messages are not long but short and sweet and you can tell he truly loves the Lord. I know I found a church home for my winters in Florida. Naples Community Church is an amazing gathering of warm and friendly people who welcome all attendees. The music and song component is inspirational and Pastor Kirt shares his remarkable gifts as a speaker with insights in the Old and New Testament and how they relate to the human condition grappling with today’s issues. So thankful to have found this  gem! Mariann Wilson & Gary Helms I'm up North now and can't wait together back to Naples and NCC.           There are a lot of churches here in CT but nothing compares to NCC.           The first time we attended we were treated like a long lost friend returning home. And love those old soul piercing hymns.                                     See you soon. Visited Naples Community church in April 2021 when we were vacationing in the area.  A wonderful and very hospitable congregation.  I felt like I was at my hone church in Delaware.  Just about every week since my visit I try to watch Pastor Kirk’s sermon online.  If you are in the Naples area pay them a visit - you will not regret it!

Jim
Bridgeville DE Every service reaches into my soul… I feel God’s arms around me in this church! No strangers… clearly he lives within its walls! Music takes you away to a spot we all belong in our world today; we are one in this lovely place.

name: Naples United Church of Christ - Naples Campus
reviewSummary: The benefit concert by world-renowned organist, Andre Knevel was well received. I was invited to give my personal recovery testimony from alcoholism for St. Matthew's House during the benefit. There were approximately 150 attending donors. A very memorable night that raised money for a great cause. A delightful evening of operatic musical pieces and Queen presented in a totally different way. We loved the string quartet’s rendering of their hits! The venue, the staff, the music, and most of all, the musicians were excellent, extraordinary! We loved every minute. Love the concert w the 4 Orchestra i instruments.  Wonderful amazing would go again in a heart beat. The venue was beautifully lit by hundreds of candles. Our talented string quartet brought Vivaldi to life. They talked about the pieces and we took away new knowledge. A wonderful experience overall. Wonderful event.  The musicians were excellent and the insightful commentary was very helpful.

name: National Community Church
reviewSummary: Led by Mark Batterson, known for creative teaching and a multi-site model including a coffeehouse church. Very urban and culturally relevant.

name: New Beginnings Christian Church - Tampa (Hyde Park) Campus
reviewSummary:
Such a Godly, Jesus loving church. My husband and I have been overwhelmed by the amount of love and acceptance we feel from the people here. Genuine, Jesus seeking people. It was easy for us to get involved, there’s always something to do or get involved with.

The preacher is always spot on and has such a gift for teaching the Bible. He never sugar coats but always preaches through love.

They got a new worship leader recently and he is amazing. Always spot on!

We send our baby to the nursery and when we pick her up she’s always happy, fed, well napped and changed. And I’ve never seen a cleaner nursery! That Sunday school teacher is a miracle worker!

We felt very safe sending our child to Sunday school. They have a check in system and everybody seems to know everybody. All the families are very friendly and opening to us. You’ll get invited to lunch by 5 different people before you leave.

Overall I think we’ve found a “home” here. The church is growing so fast and we just feel so blessed to be apart of it. Great church made up of real people. Pastor Steve is phenomenal and does a great job of articulating the message in an easy to digest manner that enables real world application. I absolutely love this church. We recently started coming here after leaving our regular church we had been at for years. It just got to big and just didn't fit us anymore. New beginnings has made us feel at home from day one! I am naturally a very anxious person but literally every person here I've met is so genuine and real. Steve keeps it real and is not scared to preach it like it is and I appreciate that. Also there is a great women's group and a men's group my husband and I attend which is awesome plus the child care staff is amazing... so basically if you are thinking about trying this church out do it!! Trying to find a church home after military displacement is always difficult! However, New Beginnings has been such a God sent! The motto of this church precedes it! Real People living Real lives! Only the Bible truths given with nothing left out! Warm and friendly environment! And just love calling this my new church home! Attended the drive up service for the first time a few weeks ago.  There is such a sweet spirit there.  The singing, and the message were much of a blessing to those of us in the drive up congregation.  Blessings to Pastor Steve and all who were there.
Matthew 18:20 - For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there am I in the midst of them.

name: New Covenant Church - Pompano Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I love everything about this church except one thing.. if you park on the grass please be careful because there are fire ants nests... I got stung pretty badly and had a pretty bad reaction a couple weeks ago... These ants were seriously venomous.... I wasn't so much pain I couldn't go into the service just make sure you have socks and shoes on if you park in the grass be careful... The lake is beautiful as well....Godly place New Covenant Church is a great, local church to go to. Pastor Adam is an awesome pastor, who makes the sermon fun and easy to understand. Getting involved has helped me grow as a person and develop my relationship with God. Everyone is loving and welcoming, and connect with you on a deeper level. Coffee from their cafe before service is delicious. I’m also involved in their youth group on Friday nights. I love NewCov! New Covenant Church is truly a place where God’s presence is felt and His people are loved. From the moment you walk in, you’re greeted with warmth and genuine care. The teaching is rooted in Scripture, Christ-centered, and relevant for everyday life. Worship is heartfelt, and there’s a real sense of community and family among the people.

Whether you’ve been following Jesus for years or are just beginning to explore faith, New Covenant is a great place to grow, serve, and belong. I’m so thankful to be part of this church family! From the very first time I attended their service I felt like family.  They accepted me the way I was.  I was also impressed by the solid teachings that I received.  I immediately invited my family members to attend, and they are presently attending New Covenant Church.

Carlos T What a great church, not too big not too small also in a great location. The pastor keeps the service interesting, fun, and easy to understand. Everyone there is super nice, welcoming, making you feel like home. There always having different events going on for everyone to be a part of. Awesome church!

name: New Day Christian Church - Port Charlotte Campus
reviewSummary:
We were planning on attending a church while on vacation, after watching their online sermons for two weeks, we decided to visit New Day Church in person. We were immediately greeted at the door by someone who
noticed we were first-time visitors and made us feel right at home. We absolutely loved the service, especially how the pastor preached directly from the Bible as the ultimate Word of God. A truly welcoming and biblically-grounded church! ✅ Good worship

✅ Great sermon

✅ Welcoming atmosphere

We’re just visiting on vacation, but I’d stay in this church if I’d live in the area. Pastor is honest and God fearing person. His message is solid straightforward and fundamental. I’m grateful for visiting. Imagine your sole purpose being to bring people closer to God and you use Mother's Day as your opportunity to alienate a very specific group of people and to tell thousands of people children are better off in orphanages and foster care than to be adopted by two loving men. Sorry, single dads, too. You're against this pastor's (not God's) plan for your life. God took your wife? Against God. Wearing a kilt? Against God's plan.

Good thing I was called by name by GOD and not as an anonymous recipient of this pastor's blasphemous opinion, otherwise I'd be truly lost. New Day is a great Christian Church that preaches what the Bible teaches. Great up beat worship, messages that are from Gods word that you can apply to your life no matter where you are. Highly recommend and they have a great youth group for younger children too. 2/22/26- very big church! Loved the sermon- even though it was a guest speaker vs. the actual pastor. The music was too loud-especially the bass to hear the words of the songs the worship team was singing since I didn't know the song. People were friendly.

name: New Hope Ministries - Naples Campus
reviewSummary:
The church staff refused to pray for me.  .since I was not a member of their congregation.
You will know them by their fruits.   Do NOT Donate any of your hard   earned money this ministry.  I did file complaint to the chamber of commerce. .
Give your money Directly to the needy.  Not the party animals. Here. Love EVERYTHING about this church!! The pastor abd his wife are wonderful. The congregation is very welcoming!! I'm happy to go there!! Don't ever let anyone say Reformed Pentecostals are all about the $- there are 2 Free Coffee Bars here- all they ask is for you to use a lid so you don't stain the carpet 😄  On a more serious note, Pastor Thigpen is one of the wisest Preachers I have ever heard. He teaches the Word very well and is straightforward about the full spectrum of the denomimation. This trickles into and through the congregation, producing an educated, balanced, circumspect community- who also relies on and enjoys the active fellowship of Christ and one another through the Holy Spirit. Very well balanced. Many opportunities to serve. And the coffee's great 😀 One of the best churches in Naples. Love pastor Grant. Pastor Grant and Susan are two of the most sincere and loving couple! They have dedicated their lives to serving Christ. Smaller intimate environment where they know your name. Check it out and hear word of God. Lindab

name: New Image Christian Center - Tallahassee Campus
reviewSummary: It’s an amazing feeling know that I attend a word filled church. I have never learned scripture the way I have here. We are encouraged to know learn the principles and stand on Gods promises. NICC is a wonderful place to worship the Lord. I’ve been attending New Image Christian Center, and it has been such an amazing church! Every sermon is refreshing, encouraging, and filled with practical wisdom. Pastor Eggleston is not only a gifted teacher but also hilarious, which makes every message engaging and memorable. If you’re looking for a church where you can grow spiritually, feel welcomed, and enjoy powerful preaching and worship, I highly recommend New Image Christian Center! If you’re looking for spiritual growth and maturity, New Image is just the place for that! The word is taught in simplicity with examples that apply to every day life. I would not be the woman I am today without the faithful teachings and community at NICC. Your church members literally served as angels the weekend before Thanksgiving, joyfully handing out bags full of festive food and full-sized frozen turkeys. You are a blessing to so many, including our family. We look forward to visiting New Image Christian Center in the very near future. Continue shining your light! God bless. Thank you. This was my first time going and they made me feel very welcome. Very wonderful people and welcomed me with open arms! Thank you guys for providing a church I can come and worship God in. And for providing a place where love and joy fills the room. You guys are amazing. And I will be back.

name: New Life Christian Church, St. Augustine
New Life Christian Church, St. Augustine - St. Augustine Campus
New Life Christian Fellowship - Jacksonville Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Nice church. Pastor Zink preaches good messages. He just doesn’t offer for anyone to come and get saved, healed or baptized in the Holy Spirit with evidence of speaking in tongues. This is a spectacular Christian church that offers services in English with Spanish translation. The people are very kind and welcoming, and there are many activities for the whole family. It’s a wonderful place to grow in faith and community. A very warm and welcoming church. Pastor is spot on. We visit every time we're in Jacksonville. Go east on Beach Blvd, turn left at light. Destination on right. Main entry leads to sanctuary. Signage for office and school clearly marked. New life is a phenomenal place to fellowship. Learning levels for all ages. The people are always welcoming. The unadulterated Word is taught, and worship is genuine!

name: New Life Church - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary: A warm and welcoming church which gathers each Sunday in a school with many multi-national young families, young adults and college students based on sound and solid Christian reformed theology. The leaders are sincere and sermons are earnest and succinct, based on personal reflections and biblical doctrines and truths. They have weekly kids ministry, lunch gatherings in homes for the young adults and students, and recently launched a Mandarin-speaking service concurrent with the English service. Strongly recommended if you live, work or study in this area to connect with this vibrant community devoted to the Christian faith. Very warm, welcoming, and accepting.  Really easy to make friends.  Preaching is solid and sensitive.  Children's program takes good care of children from birth through middle School.  There is a growing youth program for teens.  There are midweek activities to help people connect in smaller groups.  Good worship team.  Meets at Beacon Park School. Warm, friendly church. Very diverse. People are very open. Pastors are very thoughtful, caring, and gospel-centered. Highly recommend! Sweet worship and warmest folks will beckon you into this place

name: New Life Church of Irvine - Main Campus
New Life Worship Center-Fort Myers, FL
New Life Worship Center-Fort Myers, FL - Fort Myers Campus
reviewSummary:
I used to think this church was like family until I begin to question my walk while attending this church.  They are very money hungry!!! My kids, my kids father & I have been attending here for nearly 8 years I recently stopped maybe 4 months ago, I reached out to Denise Johnson as well as Bishop Johnson on Several occasions for therapy about the turmoil I have been dealing with in my household with my spouse they haven’t PUSHED us for therapy or pushed us for marriage the ENTIRE time we attended this place, I was living a life of sin they accepted thousands of dollars from me knowing the struggles and life I was living for their “new building” that still hasn’t manifested.  Denise has also called me on several occasions asking me for money/donations for their building after I gave a huge donation from my heart the first time, but she never prayed or worked or helped towards pronouncing the blood of Jesus over my house and my family and kids, I went crying several times to her about my situation and having 3 kids by this man I was with for 10 years I begged pleaded they never helped just always turned it into a situation for their self gain.  This church has ruined my family but thankfully I didn’t loose my faith in God.  I pray God touch the heart of all the members of this center.  Be careful. I love this church. I feel that they are super sincere in their worship and committed to the cause. God bless this ministry. I pray they expand and grow to become a staple in the community and the city at large I joined Newlife Worship Center 6 years ago and truly my life has NEVER been the same !  I came in, not really knowing what to expect because I'd only been to church for funerals.  When I left, I left  filled with so much excitement, the experience of encountering the presence of God, the love of God and a hunger to know him more. New life is a teaching ministry,  and that's what I needed, I needed to be taught. They taught me how to seek God and get to know him personally for myself. I thank God for my church and my Passionate Leaders, Bishop Eric Johnson & First Lady Denise Johnson. They are truly great leaders after the heart of God, wanting to see God's children fulfill their purpose in him. Because of this ministry, I divorced my past and married my future and I'm determined to never go back ! I love New Life Worship Center December will make 3years that I have been going to this church.  Since being at  New Life Worship Center I been totally set free from drugs,clubbing and sleeping around with different men.Bishop Johnson and First Lady Denise Johnson are awesome spiritual leaders they break the Bible down so you can have a understanding so you can grow in God.  If you ever walk through them doors that's exactly what you will receive a new life.. I thank the lord for placing me in a ministry where I can grow and learn how to pray and read the Bible and do daily devotions and build my personal relationship with God. New Life Worship Center is definitely a place where God is glorified and the people of God is edified and the Devil is terrified. My family and I attended New Life for the first time on New Years Eve. Service started at 9:30p and concluded at midnight. One word: Phenomenal! The  pastor spoke a powerful, moving word for 2020, the year of vision, clarity and living in your divine purpose. I was changed after that service and now I’m ready to allow the Lord to work through me.

I must also add that the congregation is filled with young, talented members with voices that will give you chills, and words that will bring tears of joy to your eyes.

I definitely felt the presence of the Lord in the place. Thanks Google for helping me find this church. We will be back!

name: Newport Beach Campus
reviewSummary: Deeply liturgical Anglo-Catholic sung Mass. Outstanding pastoral care.

name: Newport Harbor Lutheran Church and School
reviewSummary: Beautiful traditional Lutheran service. Organ and choir are top tier.

name: North Naples Church - Naples Campus
reviewSummary: The congregation is very friendly & sermons are always with meaning. The music, choir, concerts & light shows are beyond fanaminal! At times I haven’t been able to attend the Church svcs, but I’ve been fortunate that they offer a website to listen to the sermons while being at home! 🙏 So nice we can enjoy big bands concert often just for a modest donation,  the acoustic in the big concert hall was really good, big audience , parking lot very big, many availability and wheelchair accessible to the hall location Enjoyed music from 20 Harps playing all familiar pieces. The church recorded the hour and a half and sent it to each of us via email.  Additions to the program were Celtic dancers and a soloist. Show was excellent. North Naples Church was a beautiful place to worship this Sunday! The congregation was full of passion, and Pastor Mark Caldwell’s sermon, Afraid to Give, was powerful. He reminded us, "Where your treasure is, there your heart will be also." What a great way to start the week! :) My husband and I are so happy to have discovered North Naples Church! Friendly/warm atmosphere  and an outstanding Pastor.  We are home.

name: North Orange Christian Church - Orange Campus
reviewSummary: NOCC has been my church home for the past 10 years, and I cannot think of going anywhere else. I love serving alongside my fellow sisters and brothers in Christ. We truly are a community that loves to serve The LORD and others. As a mother of three and family of six ,I am super grateful for the support the church offers with their weekly food banks .I do want to say that it took me alot to go and ask for help .I've always had to much pride to do it .But I did and am so thankful for everything they offer without asking for anything in return .I do want to say that there is one woman there that makes me feel uncomfortable and almost I am a burden to her .It is burning hot out,I am pregnant and I stood in the shade just as the others did in front of me but she asked me to move so I did and apologized as I was feeling faint due to the heat and waiting .Then I get inside the older Asian woman asks me how many people are in my family and what their ages are .I told her no problem and proceeded .The same woman that told me to stand in the sun then proceeds to keep staring at me and when I approach the counter where they hand out dairy and frozen items she hands me a couple of bags rather then letting me choose two items as they normally would .I then asked if they had any dairy (Milk,eggs,yogurt etc)She then asked how many are in my family I again told her even though I already said it when I entered and had not received any dairy items even though there was several on the counter behind her .I then ask if I may have one container of the guacamole she has behind her as there was 10 .She seemed really annoyed and said oh my lord there is some on the wall over there can't you see ?I said I'm sorry I didn't .Then hands me the guacamole.I then asked if there was any milk .She says no they didn't receive any this week .I said ok and left .I don't want to complain .I understand this is free and nothing is guaranteed.I also am very grateful but it just made me feel down and like I was a bother or maybe she thinks I don't need the help .Coming down here after being able to support myself my whole life so far and now struggling was a huge thing for me to accept I needed to do .I would never take more then what my family needs nor take from others.I just thought this needed to be said so that hopefully others don't feel the same way when they come looking for help and are made to feel like they are stealing or are a bother. But thank you to all the people that volunteer and make this possible you are truly God's warriors. Seems like this place will turn away anyone that they don't see fit to be there. Church is meant to be a place of gathering and love and I felt neither here. I moved here recently and loved to use my old church as a safe place to worship and skateboard when we weren't in service. Do not come here seeking comfort, safety, or family. They will turn you away. Instead of pushing your community away you should invite them in and make them feel welcome in your community. "Do unto others as you would have them do unto you" We moved to the area in 2021 and started church shopping.  North Orange Christian Church was the first church we checked out.  We wanted a church with solid bible teaching, worship that helped you draw closer to God, a good Life Group / Small Group program, a Children's ministry and a Youth ministry, and NOCC  checked all the boxes.  It felt like home immediately, and the people we met made us feel welcome.  We never left.  If you are looking for such a church, come check it out.   You'll be blessed that you did. Went into the church office with a fellow brother in Christ to inquire about getting him some help. After he received a bag of groceries, we went over to a bench in front of the Chappell to pray, and I answered some of his questions regarding the sabbath. Less than 10 minutes after sitting there, Andrew, who helped us in the office, came out and told us we needed to leave immediately. When I asked why, he said there have been stabbings there, and the police don't want anyone hanging around. I told him we were fine that we trust in the Holy Spirit to protect us. Then he said it's the law and we have to leave! He couldn't tell me which penal code we were breaking, but to avoid confrontation, we left. It makes me wonder if God is working in this church when I experience actions such as this? Needless to say, I will not be returning to this church and I will tell everyone about my unbelievable encounter with one of many demons that do attend here!

name: North Point Community Church
reviewSummary: Andy Stanley's 'practical application' teaching style is the defining feature. The environment is designed to be accessible to the unchurched. High focus on small groups ('Circles are better than rows').

name: North Tampa Church of Christ - Tampa Palms Campus
reviewSummary: My family started attending this church 2 years ago, and I immediately knew this was the church we'd call home. Everyone is so genuinely warm, loving and welcoming. I love that we sing traditional hymns! The children's programs are phenomenal. Everyone in the church has a chance to serve others in one way or another. It's life giving! The most important thing about this church is that they're Bible believing, and they go by the Book! I can't say enough good things about the preacher, Neal Pharr. Come check it out! Love one another, for love is from God ❤️ I visited this church for a service and was so impressed by Neal Pharr's authenticity, empathy, social awareness and kindness that I think I will make this my new church home. Very sweet little church with a good vibe. No crazy musical acts. No silliness. Just good people helping and loving others. Very welcoming, loving, and Spirit-filled church. The minister, Neal delivers engaging and heart felt sermons. I love the singing and communion devotionals! So glad our family found this church! Highly recommend it to anyone searching for a church to join. Genuine loving church!! Great people who strive to be active followers of Christ. Good children’s ministry with the sweetest teachers and plenty of events for families to be involved. Great leadership for their dynamic youth (teens) I have been encouraged in my Christian walk by attending here! This is a very loving and caring church family. We came here 3 years ago and knew immediately we were in the right place! All age groups are well represented, and classes are available for all. The Holy Spirit is working in our lives to help us be passionate followers of Jesus.

name: Northeast Christian Church - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary: Most of everyone was amazing sweet and calm, food selection was amazing best I have seen. But at one point a older man with the church was raising his voice at my deaf brother in law I tried to tell him that he was deaf and instead of listening to me walked passed and continued to raise his voice until he reached him. I understand no one was supposed to be standing on that side of the hall but it's very disrespectful to raise your voice at a deaf person as if they will magically hear you. Also after that he went back to his chair than around 10 minutes later calmly walked over to other hearing people and politely told them to move over and get out of the hall. Other than that was amazing please don't let this post deter you church was great that just soured our time there. I felt that there must have been a better way to distribute the food, especially to the elderly and physically challenged people. Great place to come realize that the cracks in your mirror are not crevices but the roots that tie us all together into the family of God. They have the best pantry in town but they're rude to people. They have no organization to how they hand out numbers for pantry they don't care if you work or if you were at the church to get a number at 1am but went home bc your a human and tired and disabled wkth disabled children at home. Apparently you should just sit outside the church all night if that's what it takes to get a reasonable number. So even after going through all that I had to wait and be number 88. They don't not welcome comment or opinion on bettering the process. For those reason I have no confidence in the churches ability to deliver anything in an.organized or respectful manner and I wont be attending any services. Doing these things correctly are part of doing God's work. I am way too sick to sit outside in the heat and wait for someone to show up at a different te every week. I love this church!  It is exciting to see God grow his people here.  There is compassion for others.  And the Bible is taught as infallible word of God - absolute truth.  Worship is powerful.  This is a place that accepts you as you are, cares for your needs, and then teaches you what it means to know and trust God and his Word.  I am definitely fed here.

name: Northstar Church - Panama City - Panama City Campus
reviewSummary:
We instantly felt at home and as a military family that was extremely important to us. Pastor Marty and his wife Angela are so kind, as well as my husband connected very well with Pastor Ivan’s Men’s Group. Military- make sure and try out Military Assistance Support Hub- MASH (Ask Guy about it) Kori and Zach Smith are the most welcoming people. Very supportive and loving church, amazing people. I thought I was going to Cornerstone but realized after spending 15-20 minutes that I was at Northstar. It may have been an omen since the service met my needs. There was a good mix of seniors which I relate with and the younger people offer a needed vibrancy. Wendell's music selections were contemporary without being over powering. Most importantly, Pastor Roy's sermon was on point. Biblical teaching made relevant to modern times with just the right amount of humor. I may have found a church home Came for the coffee stayed for the service. It was about self-care and unplugging.
These people were welcoming folk. I did not perceive any political bias here. Went there for utility assistance and my 1st thought was God must be happy this place is gorgeous and even has its own coffee shop and kids indoor playground (like ones in McDonald's), and friendly faces every where you look! I'm thinking of attending just off my experience here. Lovely place and people! God is great all the time! Amen! I have been going there for the past 7 years. Intermittent as I left the area for 3 years and then the pandemic began. I attended online during the pandemic, finally retired and returned to Northstar when I returned to Florida. I can honestly say that I have never been been happier than than to be back. Pastor Marty is like none that I have ever known. He's genuine, honest, transparent but mostly kind with the greatest love for God and his members. It's an honor and a privilege to be a member of this home. Not church, but home because that's what it is. Pastor Roy is my hero and he met a need for me when my brother passed away. name: Prestonwood Baptist Church - Plano Campus - Plano Campus
reviewSummary:
The pastor is not afraid to speak the truth, and his sermons are powerful. The kids ministry is safe and secure, but the little kid ministry (pre-k) videos are too long and there are always teachers talking through the videos so it’s very distracting (and a tiny bit rude- it’s hard enough to focus.) However, they do big lesson cards that reiterate the lesson back in the classrooms so I love that. And I will say all the teachers and volunteers (including me) are SO sweet and love kids. They truly seem to have a passion for Christ and children.

Also, if you have to use the restroom during the adult service you get locked out!!! I have health issues and had to use the restroom and tried to go back. A security guy told me I can’t go back to my seat unless I’m on the back row. He was pretty rude about it and I told him I was on the back row (only by coincidence and God’s grace,) and he did let me in (probably because I was starting to panic and start crying) but he gave a stern warning that once the service starts… if you leave… you can’t get back in. I 100% understand churches needing security, but if you have health issues or are older— this is an issue! Don’t forget your cell to text your husband that you’re not allowed back in.

Also, my mom tried to join this church with us, and they wouldn’t let her be a member unless she got BAPTIZED AGAIN because she wasn’t baptized into a Baptist church. She was baptized at 14 yrs old by being dunked in a tub of water at a non-denominational church. I understand asking people be baptized again if they were sprinkled as babies or never baptized (as those aren’t biblical baptisms,) but my mom was of age, accepted Christ, and dunked in water as a public proclamation; if you’re baptized legit then you’re baptized. I think it’s ethically wrong to demand someone be baptized again.

Don’t get me wrong, this is a Bible-based Spirit-filled church. The sermons and worship are AMAZING. They are so loving and there’s always something going on. Get involved and it’s a wonderful place to be. I just don’t agree with everything they do, and my health makes their security rules hard. Prestonwood Baptist Church is a phenomenal place of worship, and our family is incredibly grateful for the impact it has made in our lives. This summer, our kids attended the Vacation Bible School (VBS), and they had an absolute blast learning about God in a fun, high-energy environment. The entire experience was exceptional, largely thanks to the wonderful staff and volunteers who were incredibly friendly, approachable, and truly dedicated to the children.
The facilities here are absolutely amazing—modern, safe, beautifully maintained, and perfectly equipped for families. If you love the energy, resources, and dynamic worship of a mega-church, this is absolutely the place to be. While the scale of the campus is massive, the church has a beautiful way of making the community feel tightly knit and deeply personal. To experience that close fellowship, you just need to be intentional about plugging in, whether that is through small groups, volunteer ministries, or family events. Prestonwood excels at providing a welcoming sanctuary where families can anchor themselves in a strong, biblical worldview. It is a true blessing to have such a vibrant, Christ-centered community right here to help us grow together in faith. NOT a welcoming or open community for outside families.

I am writing this to warn other parents who are considering sending their children to Prestonwood's youth programs or Vacation Bible School (VBS). We chose to send our 8-year-old daughter here thinking it was a kind, welcoming, Christian environment. Instead, it proved to be an incredibly rigid, exclusionary, and hurtful space.
During a discussion about baptism at camp, my daughter mentioned that she had been baptized as a baby (in our Episcopal tradition). An adult instructor literally told an 8-year-old child that hers "wasn't a real baptism."

To say something so deeply invalidating and disrespectful to a young child is completely unacceptable. We have raised our daughter to respect other people's religious backgrounds, yet she was met with judgment by an adult leader who decided her family’s faith traditions weren't legitimate.

If this church community cannot handle questions, differences, or basic respect for other Christian backgrounds, they need to limit their programs strictly to their own congregation. What my child experienced here was not Christian. Look elsewhere if you want an actual welcoming environment for your kids. We were visiting Dallas and wanted to try a negachurch. Giant churches can tend to get a bad rap. We wanted to decide for ourselves (we went to several on our journey from Canada). This one was very Spirit-led. It was so evident. Far more than we expected. We expected amazing production and professionalism but got so much more.

We were hugely blessed at this church. Treated like royalty when we told them our was our first time. We had front row seats! Pastor Graham came and spoke to us and we didn't even know he was the pastor until he preached. He preached truth unabashedly. You won't get a watered down gospel here. The message was powerful and I couldn't take notes fast enough. Great quote from pastor Jack in the photos.

Worship was quite the production but I don't mean that in a negative way. They are giving their best for God and it was beautiful. Orchestra, huge choir, incredible worship leaders.

After the service we visited the guest center where we were given free passes for lunch (available weekly), a book by Pastor Jack and free kids Bibles for our kids.

The free lunch was fantastic! So much variety. Menu posted. It allows for fellowship. There were hundreds there.

We checked out the gift shop and it was very unique. Not just your typical Christian bookstore wares. A lot of beautiful art especially. We bought an adorable animated kids Bible.

Fantastic experience here in every way. Our kids didn't attend the Sunday school as they wanted to stay with us so I can't speak to that. Such a beautiful sanctuary. Loving staff was very helpful and got everything rolling right away to transfer my membership from my former church. Looking forward to making this my new home church.

name: Radiant Church - Lexington, KY - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary:
I truly believe the Lord led me by the hand to this church, and has become home. As a newcomer, I was met by such warmth and the unmistakable light of Christ from each and every person. Worship is always 🔥 and PK, Pastor Cameron and Pastor Scott are always ready with the meat of the Word and the milk and honey of the Gospel—and there’s always room for some good humor for dessert.

This church has become my family, and is where I heard the Holy Spirit call my name and break off every shackle I had been placed in.

Come see us, meet Him and Be Radiant! ✝️❤️‍🔥 If you're looking for a church in Lexington, I cannot recommend Radiant enough. From my very first visit, I felt genuinely welcomed. The person greeting at the door didn't just point me toward the sanctuary, but walked me there, took the time to find people my age, and introduced me so I wouldn't have to be alone. That small act made such a huge difference and showed me what this church is all about.

The sermons are always biblical, practical, and incredibly relatable. The pastors have a way of teaching God's Word that is easy to understand while still challenging you to grow in your faith. They're also some of the kindest, most personable people you'll meet, and they truly care about every person who walks through the doors.

The worship is powerful every single week. Radiant is a non-denominational church where people are free to worship and pray in whatever way they feel led. Whether that's raising your hands, praying at the altar, or quietly spending time with God, there's so much freedom to encounter Him without judgment. Every service creates space for people to pursue Jesus wholeheartedly.

More than anything, God's presence is so evident here. You can truly see His hand at work in the lives of the people, the leadership, and the church as a whole. It's a place where lives are being transformed, people are finding hope, and relationships with Jesus are growing.

The community has completely changed my life. People are friendly, welcoming, and intentional about helping you find connection. Whether it's through Sunday services, serving, or small groups, it's easy to find a place to belong.

If you're searching for a church in Lexington, KY that teaches the Bible, has authentic worship, caring pastors, and an incredible community, Radiant Church is truly a special place. I'm so thankful God led me here. What a great church God lead me to this morning! You can truly feel the presence of God in this place. The worship team is fantastic. Pastor Kevin's "PK" message was spot on! With a warm welcome and friendly faces this church blesses all who enter. It seems like a wonderful church with nice preaching music  and atmosphere. However this is a very conservative, ultra right-wing church, and the pastor made multiple political statements which were not professional. name: Radiant Church — New Tampa - Tampa Palms Campus
reviewSummary:
This church is the reason why we stopped going to church. I've been wanting to make this post because of our experience here when they 1st opened and finally have the courage to do so. We as a family were so excited because this location was new and we wanted to start from the beginning. Let me tell you. If you're looking for a church family, this place isn't it. You will be judged. Compassion goes a long way & if your heart isn't in ministry then please step down. I'm so thankful that God sees every heart and intent. Character will outlast performance any day. We started attending Radiant NT when they first opened after moving to the Wesley Chapel area and immediately felt at home. We have two little ones and our kids (that are under six years old) love the children’s ministry. Community is strong here🤍 We are new to this church and we really like the people, environment and the weekly sermons. It is a very welcoming community and there are many opportunities for church community connections. The lead pastor is great and I love the messages he puts out. My only complaint is how loud it is. The folks running the sound at my location always have it very loud to the point where they feel the need to offer ear plugs at the front door. We are going to keep going, but I wish they would make it a little more accessible by lowering the volume. Absolutely love this church! Great church if you have a family with kids! Started on their inauguration day.
It's been wonderful every Sunday!
Absolutely love it💜💜

name: Reality Church Miami - Miami (Downtown/Brickell) Campus
reviewSummary:
I attend Sunday morning services here when I am visiting Miami. Wonderful music, bible-based preaching, and exceptionally friendly people. Regardless of your background, you will feel welcome and loved here. Reality Church Miami has been a great place for my family and I to grow closer to God. Every week, we come together with friendly people who have been welcoming to our family. Whether you're new to Miami, or have lived here for years, this is a great place for you to learn what it means to follow Jesus and make friends along the way. My teenagers are volunteering and loving it. In my experience, the people in the congregation were judgmental, and ironically, remind me of the Pharisees from the bible. They judged me according to their moral ethic, many did not communicate with me in an honest straightforward way, I did not feel welcome at all over the months of being there. It was during a transition part of my life where I was looking for healing and community.

They would encourage you from the stage to get involved and volunteer, but whenever I ask how I can get involved in volunteer, they would never let me and kept on telling me to talk to the pastor, I don’t know why. It may be because we had differing beliefs or doctrine about the scripture. In my view, I just wanted to help them do good things in the community, but they kept on creating a rift because of their perceived difference in our doctrine. They never really explained it.

but I feel like the people were not able to resolve this agreement and instead my intuition tells me that they kept it to themselves and discuss Only behind my back. It was a strange experience, I felt like there were always looking at me judgmentally but they would not communicate it. I’ve been to many churches, and none of them have ever treated me like this.

Somebody also lied about my conduct and accused me of doing something that I was warned not to do, which is not true. I stepped into the Sunday school room to say hi to somebody that I knew and they accused me of violating safety protocols that supposedly somebody told me not to go in there, which was not true at all.

It makes me wonder where this kind of behavior and perception comes from, it’s still a mystery to me that I pray about.

I pray that we can all move forward and grow from this experience. I do feel like the people are good people and maybe I am a teaching lesson to them and they are teaching lesson for me . All the best. I can’t recommend this church enough. It’s a beautiful community that truly lives out its love for the gospel, the people, and the city of Miami. If you’re searching for a church home, you really need to come by and experience it firsthand. Reality Church of Miami is a wonderful place to come, where they will welcome you with open arms. From the wonderful worship music, to the great teachings of the word, and everyone involved that volunteer every Sunday. It all has such a community atmosphere that welcomes you in if it’s your very first time at church or if you’ve been going your whole life. God has a lot in store for them for the future!

name: Redeemer Church OC
reviewSummary: Excellent PCA congregation. Expository preaching and highly welcoming.

name: Redeemer City Church - Tampa (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Looking for a place where you can freely worship God? This is the place! No pretenses with this Pastor. His messages are down to earth and apply to today's life problems. Fantastic contemporary music! Two services 9:15 and 11:00 am Sundays with weekly City Group (small group) meeting throughout the Tampa area during the week. All ages are welcome and represented. A great place for children to learn the word of God. This is a very welcoming church with a great kids ministry and Bible teaching from the lead pastor Mitch. This is a church to call home and find community. Words cannot adequately express how much I love this church. The sound biblical teaching from Pastor Mitch is second to none. This church is my family, and I couldn't imagine doing life anywhere else. If you're looking for a fantastic church home, and live anywhere near Tampa, I highly recommend Redeemer City Church! If you are looking to be a part of a church community in a meaningful way and are unhappy with typical sermons that are simply self-promoting or filled with platitudes, then you should come check out Redeemer City Church.  This is an incredible new church with a warm and welcoming community. My family hunted all over South Tampa looking for a church community; we found an authentic and biblical one here at Redeemer. The teachings challenge (not just help us feel better about ourselves) us all to be more Christlike, emphasizing the point that we are not "better" than others because we call ourselves Christians - we struggle to live out our faith every day and try to be more faithful through life with our community. I would describe the preaching to be of a similar vein as Tim Keller (unapologetic, yet approachable, Christian teachings meant for everyone without ridicule). The church is also committed to having a demonstrable impact on the community of Tampa Heights through frequent service opportunities by partnering with local charities. The building is easy to miss, but don't let that fool you. Being a military family, we’ve been to a myriad of churches everywhere we’ve moved. This move to Tampa was the hardest for us to find a place where we could belong as grace-needy, in-process, don’t-have-it-all-together people until we stumbled into Redeemer City Church. Since then, we’re still those same grace-needy people, but we’re having those daily needs met with solid gospel preaching and shepherding, meaningful membership, a place to use our gifts and serve others, and a people to call our own. It’s truly a place where you can come as you are, consistently hear the good news about Jesus, and leave better than you were.

Our four kids are excited about the children’s and youth ministry (a first in the last several churches we’ve been a part of) and my husband and I are nourished by our weekly City Group where we can go deeper in Scripture and relationships as we break bread and open our bibles together.

We only wish we had stumbled into Redeemer sooner!

name: Redemption City Church - Daytona Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
This is the most welcoming loving Church I’ve ever been to. I’ve been with them since the beginning, and I can say they live by there Motto:  It’s not about nickels and noses. It’s about life-change in Christ. Fire and brimstone? Not here… There all about the love and GRACE of GOD and discernment.❤️✝️ This is home.
We find this church 3 years ago and we got plugged in very easily. Now it feels like family. The teaching is always clear, church staff is friendly and kind. There's kids care, students ministry, life groups during the week so there's plenty ways to participate and connect with others.
Check services time to visit 😊 So thankful God brought our family to Redemption City! God’s word is faithfully preached, the Gospel proclaimed, and people are known and loved. It took me a long time to find a new home church when I moved back home to Ormond Beach, and a great friend invited me to Redemption City Church and after my first visit I knew this would be my home church, period!
Thank you Jesus for bringing me here! A great place to attend; to follow Jesus.

name: Relevant Church - Daytona Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I've quite literally grown up while attending this church. The community support is incredible. We've made life long friends, connected through serving on the media team, and I could go on and on about how much fuller my life has become from being here.

I would 1000% suggest anyone of any walks of life, all backgrounds, any age.. to come just try walking through the doors. You will feel the love and warmth, and leave feeling empowered and full of purpose. I recently moved to the area, I was really missing my home church and was in search of a church where I could build connections and be a part of a Church family that connects with the community. This is the place!!!  I love being around like minded people who love Jesus!  The  pastors of this church are absolutely amazing and Holy Spirit filled!!!  They welcomed me with open arms. If you’re looking for a church where you are family ,this place of worshiping Jesus is for you. I have to mention how many different groups they offer at this church. Just check out their webpage. A huge shout out to my Pastor back home for helping me find this church. When my husband and I were first married and moved here to Daytona Beach from Jacksonville, we were looking for a place to call home. We went “church shopping”, I attended as many connect groups as I could, but I felt like we never quite fit… UNTIL we came to Relevant Church. One service — and we instantly knew. This was home. A place to start and raise a family. Fast forward to 7 years later, three kids later, we are so blessed by all that God has done and is yet to do in our lives at this amazing church!!! To God be the glory!!!!! "At Relevant Church, we don’t do 'religion as usual.' We believe in Jesus Christ—yesterday, today, and forever. Period.
We know the world is loud, but we’re here to provide a safe place to grow for every believer. You’re going to get the uncut Word of God here—no filters, no watering it down, just the truth that sets you free. As soon as I came to the door I had my backpack with me because I was just doing a little exploring and they asked to search my bag and I told them  no lol so I started to walk away but I said you know what I'm going to worship the Lord so I let them check my bag and at first they said you could let us check your bag and you can go in. Then they asked me if I would just keep it in the front entrance and I started in my head like what the heck so I said okay go ahead so I went in there tell me why when I sat down they had two big old guys come sit behind me so me being me I got up and went to the other side LOL 😂 then they followed me over there. But when I got there it was like already like 45 minutes into the service so I stayed for the second service and then they approached me and asked me my name and I said you all don't make me feel welcome LOL anyways we got into the worship and I went up to the front and started worshiping and they kept coming up to me saying sir can you come sit down we don't allow people in front and I said well I'm worshiping I'm in the presence of the Lord and you guys are grabbing me and disturbing me and and still during worship they finally came up to me and said you got to come with us or we're going to call the cops and so I go back to in the back with them and they're like sir you just look too suspicious and I said are you serious right now you guys got my bag in the front with you you guys checked it and you passed it what do you want from me I just want to worship the Lord and hear the word and they were like well this is our church and I said hold up hold up I thought this was God's church and he said no this is our church and I said okay I'm sorry I came to the wrong place LOL

name: Relevant Church - Tampa (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
I have been to this church twice. Pastor Paul's message is great and based in the Bible with verses cited. Not just a feel good message but teaching that challenges you to grow in your faith. He is authentic and real. The worship is great, it really is corporate and ellicts a response from the congregation. It is contemporary and loud but it is great. I don't know if this is the best church in Tampa, but if you want real Bible based teaching with great worship try Relevant in Sundays. After leaving the church I’ve been at for my entire life, Relevant was a welcoming new church home. You can come as you are. The sermons are biblical & realistic for things we are dealing with today. It’s not a giant church, but the people are kind & compassionate. They do so much for the Ybor and surrounding communities. I am glad to be going to Relevant during this phase of my life.  ❤️ I don’t know how exactly this place passes as a church. This is one strong example of the Western/American modern church that cares more about filling seats, than the Spirit filling up the people who are in desperate need of Him.

A few, and I mean a few of the people I've met there, I've grown to know more, and still to this day, I love having them as brothers and sisters in Christ.

However, my experiences personally with certain people have made my time there very challenging. Especially after providing the gifts God has given me to bring God's light, I became burnt out and discouraged that my involvement with Relevant wasn't truly valued. I don't see a leadership that exemplifies patience or gentleness, which is truly sad. They have made this church run more like a corporation rather than a church. Roles shouldn't be filled for the sake of being filled. That, by the way, is a toxic form of leadership. Roles should be in place of people who have been gifted the role and are honored in their ways. May I add that as I was leaving Relevant, I felt as though I had my hands tied to not leave the church until I was met with guilt that going elsewhere to find true fellowship was a big insult to injury. Churches ought to honor that God calls certain people to minister elsewhere. I'm not the only one who has had these similar experiences.

I'll say it this way: if God calls His followers to be obedient to His call, and someone gets in the way, those who get in the way disobey God, denying their calling.

Sometimes I will even see through service that people aren't as engaged, passionate, or zealous. Rarely but notably so would I see some people just put on a front.  There was only one thing I could be positive about, which was one life/community group I knew I could be around, learn from, and gain wisdom. Outside of that, it all feels like some people are just checking off a box, living the same life, not a sanctified life. There's a thing with their baptism that I don't see in the Bible, which is whether the person getting baptized has "asked Jesus to come into their heart." It's coming to the knowledge of one's sin, repenting of it, believing Jesus died and rose for us to be forgiven and have our sins paid for, to be made new, making Jesus Lord and Savior.

After leaving Relevant, I was contacted only by a few people who truly cared. And for some reason, Relevant decides to block me on social media. Guess I'm not good enough for them. But God has made me new, a new creation, a new identity, and that's what matters more.

I personally wouldn't recommend Relevant Church, whether you're just moving to the area, or trying to profit the Kingdom with the gifts Jesus has given you. Anyone can read the Bible, but their actions will tell a different side of the story. It's a Geral place for the family to praise the Lord, kid friendly rooms. Summer Vocational bible class for a week. Kids have a wonderful time. Volunteers provide free water every last Friday no strings attached. Great staff members and volunteers, overall I give this place 100 stars. Just absolutely an amazing  church to wordship/hear the TRUTH of GOD!  Where you can just simply be yourself  without being  judged. ❤️❤️❤️
