name: Rich Pond Baptist Church Main Campus
River Church West Palm Beach - West Palm Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
I am with the person who stated if they weren’t a Christian they would sue them. I also had a horrible experience here. Went to a back to school event that they dragged on for over 4 hours. We were hungry and thirsty. My child and I went up for prayer- which is normally fine. They started speaking in tongues which really freaked us out. They were touching all over us. One person even blew in our face. Where I come from you don’t blow or put your air in someone’s face. The one lady who spoke tongues over me and my child had the creepiest eyes-I was so freaked out I looked away. I feel wronged but should have known better when I saw Pentecostal. If you were not raised in a similar church do yourself a favor and stay away. Excellent Church, we have been attending for about 5 months now & WOW! God has done some great things indeed. My husband & I just recently began members as well as join in their bible school. My husband also received the Holy Ghost at this ministry. (I’m proud of him) 👏🏽 .

This church stand straight forward on the word of God. ( I love that) and they have a true heart ♥️ for the things of God, they're about the father’s business. Fantastic Pastor & great people.

Come check them out if you’re looking for a place to worship or call home. I highly recommend the River Church especially if you’re serious about being everything, God has called you to be. I want to Thank you to pastor Corey and pastor rose for coming to west palm beach with the anointing  I am forever grateful for your Obedience to the lord. Coming to this church has changed my life the power of God and the presence of God has completely healed my soul. And I have experienced Gods love and joy like I’ve ever known. Joy that bubbles up and comes out as laughter I laughed the loudest I’ve ever have in my life and felt the holy presence of the lord. Laughter is medicine and the joy of the lord is my strength. I’ve been delivered set free from fear trauma depression and am the happiest and freest I’ve ever felt in my life since coming here and deciding to plug in come consistently and started serving and eventually joined the Bible college. I have seen the fruit and best outcomes in my life. I have testimonies after testimony every single service How God shows up and touches me in a powerful way. Come and press in expecting a touch from God and you will experience God in a beautiful, powerful, life changing way. I cannot express enough in words how amazing this church is!! Praise God! Holy Spirit led and filled services. Different than your "traditional" Churches. Had a great time with the people at the men's BBQ cook out..we had burgers, lamb and coleslaw+ dessert after. The presence of God is so strong every time I walk into River Church WPB! The worship is powerful, the Word is alive, and the pastors preach truth with fire and love. Lives are being changed, people are being set free, and you can feel the anointing from the moment you walk in. This is a church that’s full of revival, family, and the power of the Holy Ghost! So grateful to be a part of what God is doing here! 🔥

name: River City Church - Jacksonville (Southside) Campus
reviewSummary:
I had been going to another church in the area and I loved it- my kids hated it.
My friend asked me if I wanted to go to church with her one Sunday and I said yes. My kids LOVED it.
They have so much activity for the kids and it’s not too overwhelming for my ADHD son.
I can’t describe the denomination or what to expect to outsiders because it’s a perfect blend of tradition with communion every week, but has so many other aspects of blended faiths: great worship, a good break to meet new people, testimonial stories, a variety of sermons, prayer and spirit centered healing.
We worship in the round which Id never seen and the main pastor is able to bring things down to the bottom shelf for those learning about Christ and following the way.

One thing to remember is that all churches are built and made up of weak sinners.
No one is perfect and strong- except Jesus Christ.
This church helps you to know this and there is no judgement here except for your own guilt you bring in with you.. so if you’re looking for a place that has judgement, exclusion, or perfection: this isn’t the place for you. This is a place for all people and that’s why God brought me here. One of the greatest blessings in my life has been finding a church family that encourages me, prays for me, and helps me grow closer to Christ. If you’re looking for a church, I’d love to invite you to visit with me. I think you’ll find a loving community and meaningful opportunities to connect with God and others.” Went here a few times with my wife and decided this wasn't the place for us. Very surface level preaching and the lead pastor doesn't seem to know how to stick the landing with his sermons, comes off very insecure and insincere. What a comfortable place. No hype, no fake huggers, no elaborate decor. Relaxed friendly genuine people and a modern simply stylish Church. The message is the word of the Bible brought to everyday life for everyone. So honest and true. This is a Church where anyone and all ages would feel welcome. I’ve checked out many in the area and this is it. Jesus is In this place. This was the most unfriendly church I've ever been to. The lady where you feel out your information was great. Once inside nobody said hi to me. It's been three weeks since I've been there and I haven't heard from anyone at the church. There definitely not worth the drive or my time.

name: Riverside Avenue Christian Church - Jacksonville (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: Great congregation, a family oriented community church of like minded Christians. 1 visit and we found our place of worship in Jax. People travel from all over the city to come here, fortunately we live in the neighborhood. We don't go to this church but love nearby and they do so much for the community! We go to their playground a few days a week and get fresh herbs from their garden! We also love their programs during luminaria! This is a warm and welcoming place to be — they accept you as you are and invite you to seek the Lord both in service and during fun groups and activities. Their secular Arts and Music programs are incredibly helpful for homeschooling families and those on a budget. Great staff. We love the community here. They truly treat us as family 💙

name: Robbins Street Christian Church - Covington Campus
reviewSummary: I always enjoy myself at Robbins Street Christian Church. Love the messages and their choir. Wonderful Church and the Pastor and First Lady are so sweet. Love It I come here every year and it never disappoints Wholesome

name: Rock Harbor Church FL - Melbourne Campus
reviewSummary:
A very Family Oriented Church w/Sermons that hold your attention! Lots of young families & beautiful guitar music. I do wish they had piano music & a choir, just like they had when I grew up in this Church. It used to be called Grace Lutheran & My Father Sang in that Choir!✝️🌷🙌🌊🎶🦋 Rock Harbor truly is everything a church should be.

It starts w/ teaching The Word. The interpretation is sound and applicable.
Our pastor & wife have a heart for each attendee, especially the children.

I’ve never seen the kids so excited to attend. Pastor Kevin brilliantly engages with the kids under 12 in a very inspiring way :
The Brown Box. We all look forward to what treasure the child has selected to become a topic relevant to their life & God. The kids feel valued in this unique interaction w/ the head pastor. Impressive how these kids truly do their best to grow in their faith too!

When I first attended, I was impacted by the stained glass in the sanctuary! Finally felt the reverence of being in a very special place, rather than the dark auditorium style of contemporary churches.

The band is remarkable and each member so talented. They write many of the songs we sing. The one we sing for communion is my favorite.

The congregation is friendly. Everyone is involved. Small groups, volunteering, missionary support, Ladies Brunches and seminars. Parents have lots of resources. The men I hear, have dinner together , pray together , volunteer on building projects. They even helped me move! Being a single woman on a tight budget, it really was a game changer experience, that this is how the family of Christ followers work.

If you are new to the area or looking to experience a church that is remarkable,  humble and kind… look no further. This is it! See you Sunday at 8:30 or 10:30!   We can’t wait to meet you. ❤️ Our family has attended for 3 years. It’s been a huge blessing being a part of a neighborhood church that’s biblical, vibrant, full of other young families, and is an incredible resource to Melbourne Beach. Rock Harbor Church is here to help us grow our Faith in the Lord. So welcoming that you feel like your going to church with your friends. Start each service with heartfelt songs from the Worship Team that everyone sings with them in the whole church. Pastor Kevin gives us useful and helpful lessons that we can use in our lives.
So very Thankful for Rock Harbor Church. ❤️🙏 Wonderful, welcoming community of believers.
Pastor Kevin Diamond's messages are Holy Spirit
filled and so edifying. Under Pastor Angie's leadership the children's ministry is flourishing.Blessed to be a part of this gem of a church in Melbourne Beach.

name: Roman Catholic Diocese of Colorado Springs
Saddleback Church
reviewSummary: The 'Purpose Driven' flagship. Reviews highlight the extremely welcoming culture for new believers and the 'Practical' nature of the teaching (currently Andy Wood). 'Celebrate Recovery' is a major draw. While the campus is massive, the small group system is frequently cited as the way to actually connect.

name: Saint Francis de Sales Catholic Church
Saint Francis de Sales Catholic Church - Miami Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
Was eating my lunch out front got told from the pastor him self we was not allowed to eat out front and kicked us out. I thought a church was nice friendly and caring not mean and aggressive. Thank you pastor for the warm and kind words you gave us. This Catholic church is a heavenly place in Miami Beach. The priest who serves this Parish is extremely blessed and he is indeed guided by the Holy Spirit when he talks. I have confessed here twice and both times I felt as if Jesus Himself was there listening to me and talking to me. The decoration here is beautiful. The helpers are caring and loving. When in South Beach, I recommend: cone and pray at Saint Francis de Sales Catholic Church. It’s a fine church if you are bilingual but can be hard to understand the priest. It was fine until the priest on a Sunday said to please ENJOY the refreshments in the back of the church after mass, that ended up being a horrible time. We went to be nice and be part of the community but once we went to the table to grab a cookie they didn’t say a word to us, we were in that room talking and two men come up to me and my sister telling us that we stole, we thought he was joking but they all started giving us horrible faces. Now my boyfriend was talking with someone else and finished his muffin and stepped out and they all started shouting that he was a thief and he didn’t pay to go grab him that he needs to pay. Mind you, they didn’t say “that would be $3.50” or anything so how would we know? Then proceeded to make an entire scene about it. That is not how a church operates.
Then we come back to pay them in cash and they say they aren’t even part of the church. We thought that was weird.
Very disrespectful and disappointing experience. This is a place needed every Sunday. I am from NY and I make sure to find a church I can attend my weekly mass. The place where we all are 1, 1 in the father, we are all family. If you are having a ruff day or week this is the place to feel better and ask for forgiveness, which both will be bestowed upon you. I felt like I was at home with  my family. All praise given to the Alpha and Omega. If you are reading this review, may all the blessings be with you and all your loved ones. AMEN! Always 5⭐️ Great spirit within this church. Loved attending mass on my vacation.

name: Saint Jude Melkite Greek Catholic Church
Saint Jude Melkite Greek Catholic Church - Miami (Downtown/Brickell) Campus
reviewSummary:
Beautiful church that brings me peace walking around! Spend 10 minutes sitting in the garden. It will help brighten your day! Very special church and the area where it is.
This church has a style that it seems like you are visiting a place from the 1930s.
Close to it there cafeterias, a border with the sea, etc.
I recommend it. Enjoy it. Truly shining the unity of the church, a place where latinos, americans and middle easterners can all worship together. In the heart of Miami. Beautiful mosaics and Icons. Rich history. This has always been my favorite Church in the entire Miami Dade County, one of the most beautiful and peaceful churches we have in town.  The Day of St. Jude on October 28 it used to be one of the most beautiful days, the church held the St. Jude Festival, the mass is so powerful, the church gets really crowded and you feel the energy, faith and devotion of the people, and the church chorus is just amazing, it really complements the whole spiritual experience.

There is a gift shop right by the main entrance of the church where you will find ll type of religious items like rosaries, little statues of St. Jude and jewelry, with really good prices.

Parking could be an inconvenience depending on the day and time of the visit as only street parking is available in the area.

When you visit Miami if you are in the Downtown area, Brickell is just a few mins away, so I highly recommend to visit this peaceful church!

Blessings 🙏 Historic beautiful Melkate Catholic Church,ancient rite. The house of the miraculous Saint Jude. 3 masses every Sunday. 9:00 (inglish)11:30(inglish-àrabe)6:00(español)

name: Saint Polycarp Catholic Church - Stanton Campus
reviewSummary:
This Sunday's Mass was the best. Our parishoner Mr. Ramiro Lopez was introduced as our new Deacon. He has been a wonderful force in our church for decades. We are very proud of him. There is English mass at 6:30 daily, during holy Friday, they did a beautiful altar for the blessed sacrament.  Lovely. Attended a funeral mass on 2-13-23
It's a nice church. What a lovely church, inspiring music & homily, friendly people. Will return soon ❤️‍🔥 Loved it here! The band had very top tier performances. You could tell they put a lot of effort into the music, and they have a cute pianist

name: San Clemente Campus

reviewSummary:
This is one of the most amazing groups of people I’ve ever been associated with all loving and kind the service from Pastor Nick and all the other pastors that lean in and spread the word of Jesus is nothing short of spectacular. Then I moved back to FL and decided it was time to search until I found a real, genuine church to call home for my family. It took 3yrs. I looked everywhere. Tried several. No weird clicky vibes. Roll outta bed and walk in if you want. Or spend 2hrs getting ready and show up in your finest. Either way you're getting coffee, donuts and a warm smile at the door. Every message I've witnessed over the last year and a half (attending most every weekend) has been full of everything I've hoped for in a church for over 20yrs. I'm so thankful for SCC 💙🤍. We are the church!! After 25 years of practicing Judaism my husband I visited South Shore. I have been inspired at every service. The pastor is special. God gave me a pastor who speaks to me every Sunday! Every service ends with the pastor asking "Who is the church?" And the congregation replies "We are the church!" I'd love us to join this church soon. At Southshore community church attendees dont go to church they are the Church... They are believers and defenders of the Word of God.. Jesus Christ.. Dr . Pastor Nic Williams is also a acclaimed  christian author and Amazon. Best seller.. South Shore is a great family church and also focuses on recovery as well for decades now.. Their celebrate Recovery has a positive track record with alot of community envolvement. Like other churches in our area Southshore is rooted in community. Great Bible based church. Pastor Nick is down to earth and inspiring. 3 Sunday services and now Thursday nights too! "At South Shore we don't just go to Church, we are the the Church, Go be the Church!"

name: Southpoint Community Church - Jacksonville (Southside) Campus
reviewSummary:
Me and my family visited Jacksonville for the weekend and we wanted to go to a church in the area, the reviews were decent so we gave Southpoint a try. At the beginning it was ok, the music was ok, and the initial opening was ok, but then the old bald pastor (i don't remember his name) started going off topic and it never stopped, but the part where I had to walk out was when he started going off about how young people are immature and ungrateful and compared to the old days we have it easy because of (medicine being so advanced). I couldn't take it, we had to leave, with us being a young family and currently struggling because inflation has been insane and everything has quadrupled in price I've had enough. I'm not gonna be preached to by some old dude that prolly owns a 4 bedroom house and has been retired for 10+ years about how young people should be grateful for this system that his generation created and threw us into. I'm happy to announce that we will never be coming back and I will never forget about this experience, but go ahead and tithe to these people yall, so they can pay for another pastor vacation for their lead retirees. As much as my Husband liked being in church on Sundays but this Church does  not take into consideration of Kids with special needs. Something as simple as language delay in a child, there was nothing like inclusion for such child.  I believe this church can do better especially if you are teaching about Jesus christ the saviour of the world. My greatest disappointment with this church was simply that the service could have been impactful, but the pastor so overwhelmed the message with his personal biases, opinions, and politics that the depth of Christ’s teaching was completely lost.

Firstly, the screen clearly projected that the topic was Luke 3-9, yet we never read a single verse from said book. Instead, we opened to Matthew and discussed the instructions of Jesus to His disciples on how to address the public on their own. The core of the message was to “wipe the dust from your feet” or in other words to not allow the past to follow you into your present/future.

Secondly, this sentiment alone is incredibly moving and applicable to endless aspects of life. And yet, the pastor managed to make the entire conversation about how black people deserve better treatment in the form of free education and special privilege by employers (which is inherently racist despite his desperation to appear as a white ally), how young people are ignorant to the struggles of past generations and the easy way of life they provided us, and honestly I left shortly after the hour mark and he had moved on to talking about his golf game.

Thirdly, I would like to briefly dissect things he shared that are unbiblical and entirely his personal philosophies:
(1) “We are a ‘white-ish’ church and need to better understand and serve people of color since we could never understand their lament.” Paul very beautifully described how to combat racism as members of God’s Kingdom in ‭‭Galatians‬ ‭3‬:‭28‬ — “There is neither Jew nor Gentile, neither slave nor free, nor is there male and female, for you are all one in Christ Jesus.”
Recognizing there are cultures and peoples that are treated worse than others is nothing new and Jesus simply calls us to love our neighbors (all people) as we love ourselves. No need for evening acknowledging skin color.
(2)”Young people are living in the easiest time in history.”
Aside from this being blatantly false due to the state of the economy, the downfall of morality in our country, and the satanic pedophilic horrors plaguing our society as well as inexcusably dismissive of the difficulties that come with living in a sinful world in any generation, this is also unbiblical. I will list a few scriptures that I recommend reading — 2 Timothy 3:1,13; Ecclesiastes 7:10; Matthew 24:6.

Overall, the doctrine of this pastor was abhorrent. The church building is beautiful and the people were welcoming, compassionate, and respectful. But as Jesus said to the Pharisees, “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside but on the inside are full of the bones of the dead and everything unclean.”
‭‭(Matthew‬ ‭23‬:‭27‬) First of all the people were very nice, they held the doors and smiled at you. The place is also incredibly clean with comfortable chairs. The sermon was really bad though. The pastor constantly kept going off topic, giving stories about golfing, childhood church, and even going to the bathroom at his grandma's house. He would say something so basic and then give an example for it which would make him think of a story and then he would give the story... The sermon could've easily been 20 mins based off what he was talking about, but he just kept talking about something else which drew it out to almost an hour before I walked out and he still had 2 more points on the board. He would also give examples with language that made me think of Ai. I will say that he doesn't seem like the main pastor. He did say that he gets sent to other churches which makes me think that the church thinks he actually does a good job. I didn't learn anything and he made fun of his own church music, young people, and called the church full of every race "white-ish" after going on a rant where he tried to seem inclusive, but was just racist. Big church with a big diverse community and wonderful pastors. The Holy Spirit is definitely present :)

name: Spectrum Church Irvine - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
I’ve been attending this church for a few years, and it has been a really meaningful place for me. The preaching is one of the biggest reasons I stay—it’s consistently Bible-centered, thoughtful, and actually challenges me while still pointing clearly back to the gospel each week.
The music is contemporary, but it feels genuine rather than performative, which makes it easier to focus on worship instead of just the experience.
It’s a smaller church, and that’s honestly something I’ve come to value a lot. It’s easier to get to know people and feel like you’re part of a real community instead of just showing up on Sundays. I’ve felt welcomed and encouraged here. When I first moved from Utah to Irvine for my job, I felt pretty lost and was craving a church home where I could actually serve, feel apart of, and gain genuine friends that have a connection to Jesus. I stumbled on Spectrum Church  through a quick Google search one Sunday morning, and man, it changed everything. From the second I walked in, the people greeted me like family, with  genuine hugs and “we’re so glad you’re here!”
What really hooked me were the service events they have lined up. You can just sign up with members of the church with whatever fits your schedule, and it’s been the perfect way for me to roll up my sleeves and work for the Lord like I’d been praying about. Their young adults group is awesome too, super fun hangouts, real conversations, and friends who actually check in on you.
This church is soaked in the Holy Spirit, and the folks here are hands down some of the most loving, kind people I’ve ever met. It’s been such a blessing in my new chapter. If you’re in the area, check it out! You’ll feel right at home. Feel free to say hi to me as well! Spectrum Church Irvine is and has been such a blessing to our family. From Pastor Gabe’s sermons, to wonderful worship music, and Sunday School, it has gone beyond meeting our families needs.
The relationships and love I feel from and for the congregation is a treasure to me. Every week I look forward to being there with “family”. Thank you, Lord for directing us to Your church! I moved to Irvine from Los Angeles not really wanting to be here and not knowing anyone.
I found Spectrum Church online and decided to give it a try. From my very first Sunday, people actually took the time to get to know me not just small talk, but real connection.
A month later, I had surgery and didn’t have family nearby, and this church prayed for me, checked in, and remembered my name.
That meant so much.

Spectrum isn’t just a place to go on Sundays it’s a community that truly loves God and cares for people.
I’m really thankful I found this church. I have faithfully attended several great churches in my life. Spectrum Church Irvine is the one I attend now and absolutely love!
Our pastor, Gabe Fung, is not only extremely knowledgeable, he is also an excellent writer and speaker!
Our congregation, board, musicians, tech team, are just like our welcome team, whom are always caring, warm, and welcoming!
Please join us and you’ll see what I mean!

reviewSummary:
I love The Cathedral. Everyone is do welcoming. It offers so much and does so much good in our community. Everyone is Welcome and it is a wonderful place to spend time with God. Such positive uplifting messages and I would recommend it to everyone looking for a church home or in town visiting. Very Inclusive and accepting of all people. Come for a Visit. Ancient Being. Antique Surroundings. Heritage Place. Cathedral Hill Neighborhood. Congregation. Theological Seminary. Permanent Art Collection. Music Hall. Events: Concerts. Every year, St. John's Cathedral hosts amazing pipe organ concerts as part of The Beaches Fine Arts Series. These free concerts are open to the general public and show case some of the world's most accomplished pipe organists. Listening to the mighty pipe organ in the beautiful church sanctuary is one of the most moving and amazing experiences to be had in Jacksonville! Thank you for opening your church to the larger community for these much appreciated, deeply enjoyed and memorable performances! My husband and I have been members of the choir at St. John's Cathedral since 1981. My husband and I love the music program there. Both our former choirmaster/organist, John Barry, and our current one, Tim Tuller, are amazing musicians. It has been and is a privilege to work with both of them. We love the Anglican style choral music. I love to play my cello in the services from time to time. Our choir has made two pilgrimages to England, singing services at Ely Cathedral, Westminster Cathedral and Canterbury Cathedral. We also went on a pilgrimage trip to Washington DC where we were in residence at the National Cathedral. The congregation at St. John's contains some of the nicest people around and we always welcome newcomers. Hope you'll visit. Warm & inviting. Although I'm Baptist by birth, I couldn't have felt more welcomed.  The minister, Rev. Mark Anderson, delivered a very encouraging & worthy message that inspires hope!

Rev. Anderson shared an unforgettable story about two particular groups who were stranded out in the Arctic.  One resorted to crude means of survival & only 3 survived.

However, the other group cleverly appointed tasks based on ingenuity of the individuals, even assigning a minister.  This bonding teamwork provided a better outcome of survival for the two groups.

reviewSummary: A wonderful, warm, and highly supportive Catholic church. Mass is extremely reverent. Beautiful parish with fantastic priests and highly involved youth programs.

name: St. Margaret's Church & School
reviewSummary: Beautiful traditional sanctuary and exceptionally reverent services. A wonderful community.

name: St. Mark Presbyterian Church
reviewSummary: Extremely open, progressive, and affirming PCUSA church. Great community.

name: St. Martin of Tours Catholic Church
St. Martin of Tours Catholic Church - Main Campus
St. Mary Cathedral - Downtown Austin Campus
St. Mary's Episcopal Church
reviewSummary: A beautiful, deeply traditional parish in Laguna. The choral Eucharist is truly sacred.

name: St. Nicholas Catholic Church
reviewSummary: A beautiful, reverent Catholic church in South County. The Vietnamese choir is wonderful. Extremely caring priests and very helpful parish staff.

name: St. Patrick Catholic Church - Miami Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
We visited St. Patrick Catholic Church in Miami Beach over the holiday weekend, and it was a beautiful experience. The church itself is absolutely beautiful, and we were blessed to participate in a very reverent and moving Mass.

I especially appreciated Father Russell. He was a wonderful priest to listen to, and the way he celebrated the Mass really stood out. He seemed to have everything memorized, but more than that, he prayed and spoke in a way that felt personal, almost as if he was saying the words directly to each parishioner. It made the Mass feel fresh and meaningful, almost like hearing it for the first time again.

Overall, it is a beautiful church with a beautiful Mass, and we were very grateful to have visited. Absolutely beautiful Catholic Church. The parking is easy to find across the street but when there’s a large event definitely go early. It becomes nearly impossible to find a space. Also avoid if it’s raining this area floods excessively. Mass is great and everyone is friendly here. There’s also dogs allowed in the rear of the church. A special atmosphere! The Monsignor gave a wonderful homily on the occasion I attended, as it was a confirmation ceremony for the students from the school affiliated with St. Patrick’s Church! I highly recommend checking the Mass schedule and attending services. Beautiful church,
Beautiful garden on the side.
Everyone was very welcoming San Patrick is one of the most beautiful churches in Miami and Miami Beach area. Not only in its architecture, but also in its celebrations, the music, the staff, everything.

The liturgy is always impeccable, and the choir and orchestra are one of the best I have heard. I really like going because you get to enter a very spiritual environment.

On days of big celebrations like Christmas and Easter, many people go to masses. It has ample parking and is very well located.

It also has a small store that sells religious items.

Without a doubt one of the best churches in the city to visit or attend mass.

name: St. Patrick's Cathedral
reviewSummary: The most famous Catholic cathedral in America. A place of history, beauty, and reverence.

name: St. Rita Catholic Community
reviewSummary: A vibrant Catholic community in the Dallas area known for its welcoming parish life and liturgical tradition.

name: St. Timothy Church
reviewSummary: A highly reverent and beautiful local parish in Laguna Niguel. Outstanding community. Excellent Spanish Mass. The liturgy and music are wonderful.

name: St. Vincent de Paul Catholic Church
St. Vincent de Paul Church
reviewSummary: Extremely beautiful historic church in Petaluma. Mass is very reverent and the priests are outstanding. A wonderful, welcoming Catholic parish family. The community is very supportive.

name: Stonebriar Community Church
reviewSummary: Founded by Chuck Swindoll. Known for deep, expository preaching and a rich radio/media ministry legacy.

name: Suncoast Community Church - Sarasota Campus
reviewSummary:
If you are seeking well produced with a very up beat professional band making you feel that you just attended a world class Christian concert this is for you.
If you want a church that welcomes all just like Jesus did this is for you.
If you are looking for a Bible based church with clear teaching from Jesus this is for you.
No membership required, no demands of you required and no shame put on you.
No this community church is not going to put a label on you.
No everyone is perfect, only Jesus.
Come in and feel welcomed.

Blessings Before you go, Please be aware this is NOT a church based on Jesus Christ as Lord and Savior and the Way, the Truth, and the Life. They changed their doctrine, and I have found they are not sharing this change publicly, so people don't know.  I just want people to be informed before they open their hearts and families to it who are looking for a Christian Church! I love this Church. Pastor and people are down-to-earth.  The message is love-filled. The music is  Awesome! I have moved to the other side of town and stopped going. I need to go back. This place is hands down the best church I've ever gone to. It's been 15 years since I committed to a church, and I won't be leaving any time soon! I love it so much I offered to volunteer, and I never volunteer for anything! A church that truly lives out grace.

This past Sunday was my first time attending Suncoast Community Church, and I was genuinely moved by the experience. From the moment I walked in, I felt welcomed—not judged, not sized up—just welcomed.

The message was rooted in the story of the prodigal son, and the takeaway was powerful: You are not too broken. You are not too different. And it’s never too late.

Pastor Larry emphasized that the church is a hospital, not a courtroom—a place for healing, not condemnation. And that’s exactly what it felt like. The message was honest, heartfelt, and deeply grounded in grace.

Oh—and the band? Phenomenal. Seriously talented musicians who don’t just perform—they lead with soul. The music set the tone beautifully and made the whole experience even more powerful.

I’ve been looking for a place where I could reconnect spiritually without pressure or pretense, and I found that at Suncoast. Whether you’re curious, hurting, questioning, or simply searching for a church that leads with love, this is a beautiful place to begin again.

Highly recommend visiting—just as you are.

name: Sunrise Community Church - Jacksonville Beach Campus
reviewSummary:
This is a wonderful Bible-teaching church. Pastor Allen Cagle is very knowledgeable and kind, does expositional teaching. Also offers counseling.
Women’s Bible studies are ah-mazing.
Wonderful people in the nursery and the children’s ministry is also very Gospel-centered. Warm welcome and clear teaching from God’s word. I even laughed at one of the preacher’s jokes. :-) Grateful for a group of brothers and sisters in Christ trying to love God and neighbors here in Jacksonville. Great place of worship, people are friendly and outgoing. Great children's program. Highly recommended. Great service and very welcoming to visitors. They use the Bible, read from the Bible, and their sermons help relate what you read to our life today. This church fills A large part of my heart. It is a wonderful place to worship Jesus Christ our Savior; and find like spirited Christians Such as my wife and I are!

name: Tampa Life Church - Tampa Palms Campus
reviewSummary:
Visited Tampa Life and it's a wonderful church. They truly praise the Holy spirit in this place. The only issue is this church is mislabeled because it is truly a full Pestecostal church, not a Non-denominational. So seek the Holy spirit, but be ready for a rich experience on Pentesocal rituals and approach. This should not be classified as a Non-denominational church. Visited 3 times, this ministry is big on baptism (every Sunday), dedicating babies to Jesus, being filled with the Holy Spirit, and praying for your neighbors.
Not sure if they have small groups, that would be nice to build community.
Huge church, so no ushers to seat people (but they're there during altar call), no tissues if you cry during worship...lol, so pack your own Kleenex.
Blacks and whites worship together and that's beautiful. A flex.
If you're at the back of the church you might feel a little left out of the action, but participate anyway.
Some speakers at the back of the church could enhance surround sound.
The service is broadcasted so it may feel like a front stage show to people who are not used to in-person, online synchronously.
*Disclaimer: 3rd-time Visitor review, not my church home per relocating.
**Possibly a higher rating, but only if I'd been attending much longer. Tampa Life Church is truly a place where you can feel the presence of God. From the moment you walk in, there is an energy that is warm, welcoming, and full of life. You do not just attend a service there, you experience a move of the Holy Spirit.

The worship is powerful, the atmosphere is uplifting, and the message is always delivered with purpose, truth, and love. There is a genuine sense that God is working through the people, the leadership, and the entire church family.
Pastor Tisdale and the Tampa Life team have created an environment where people can feel encouraged, strengthened, and spiritually refreshed.

What stands out most is the sincerity. Tampa Life Church does not feel like a performance. It feels like a family gathered in faith, worship, and expectation. The energy in the room is inspiring, but even more importantly, the presence of the Holy Spirit is evident. You leave feeling renewed, challenged, and reminded that God is moving.

I am grateful for Tampa Life Church and highly recommend it to anyone looking for a church home where faith is alive, people are loved, and the presence of God is truly felt. What a great place to go and feel the presence of God.  From the moment you step on the grounds of Tampa Life Church, you can feel an expectancy in the atmosphere,  like God is about to do something.  From the beginning to the ending of service, there is a real connection to God.  Pastor Tisdale is the real deal.  He preaches the true word of God in such an incredible way... its easy to understand, receive, and apply.
If you are looking to have a relationship with God, or want to have a greater relationship and grow in grace and knowledge of God, Look no further.  This is the place! Such an awesome place to connect spiritually. Bible focused, spirit filled, seeking truth. Every time we visit Florida we go there. Its a blessing every time.

name: Tates Creek Christian Church - Lexington Campus
reviewSummary:
Tates Creek Christian Church is the most welcoming, loving, Gospel centered church I’ve ever been to. I’ve been going to Tates Creek for 6 months now and have never felt so loved. God is doing wonderful things through the people here! The music is outstanding, the sermons are always so impactful that I listen to them two or three times online throughout the week, and it’s very easy to get involved here and make friends because everyone is so kind and excited to welcome new people. 10/10 recommend no matter what age you are, but I would especially recommend this church to someone with kids because the youth ministry is amazing❤️ Victory for Life Ministry!! Thanks to Mr Larry, and Mr Don and Sharon!! Thank you to those who prepare and serve the food! Thanks for the revival of faith that I have lost! Anyone knows that a lot of churches say " Come as you are" ! Most lock the door when they see your homeless! This little program I only just today learned of ! What a welcoming group of people!! I pray that God blesses each of you for the open door you provide for those who are trodden and troubled!! Absolutely the best church I have ever been apart of. They minister to all the generations with their Traditional and Contemporary Services. Their Youth and Children's Ministers are all in and truly love my kids. The Senior Minister is approachable and friendly. They are currently remodeling the church to better prepare for the future. They are doing great things for the community. I mean they are hitting on all cylinders.  I would highly recommend coming and checking out this Church Family! For about 6 months we visited several churches in Lexington.  During our search, we would visit each church for about 6 weeks to get a feel about the church, the minister and if we felt it was a good match for our family.  Luckily, our search lead us to Tates Creek Christian Church.  We love the minister, Tommy Simpson.  We love the youth ministry.  We love the "feel" of the church and how nice and inviting the members were to us!

Tates Creek Christian Church offers two services, the 1st is a traditional format starting at 9:30 am and the second is a more contemporary/blended format starting at 11:00am.  Sunday school classes are available at either hour and there are a lot to choose from.

If you are looking for a church to call home, I would suggest you come visit Tates Creek Christian Church. You will be glad you did! I have been a member of this congregation since 1997 and have been blessed above and beyond all expectations. The love of the  people and their dedication to service to others make it a shining example of Jesus Christ. The church is dedicated to being a light and home to those searching for a warm welcome and a place to serve.

name: TCF - Tampa (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
Without a doubt one of the best churches I've been to in a long time. Pastor Sixto and Pastor Susan are truly doing God's work. They welcomed my family with open arms. Everyone made us feel truly blessed. Pastor helped us the first day we walked in the church. He even gave my husband a job on the spot. I am so glad we found our new home church! God bless them and the wonderful work that they are doing! TCF is our Church family. I can vividly remember the moment when my husband and I entered through their front door for the first time a year ago, we instantly sensed the powerful and tangible presence of God in there. We sensed the LOVE ❤️ of our ABBA FATHER through our pastors and everyone else. We love being a part of Jesus Christ believers who are Spirit-filled and continues to grow in Christ even beyond the Church walls. Loving God, loving His people. Serving God, serving His people. That is the heart of the Father. That is the TCF Church. ❤️ I didnt know about the church until I went to see John Ramirez there and the annointing is so tangible . You feel the 🔥🔥🔥🔥 on the atmosphere from Pastor Sixto , Susan John and all his team . Was beyond words
God bless
Carlos ( Saint Augustine) They are truly God sent and appointed! A Wonderful community of believers who believe in practical applications of showing God’s love. Their heart for the community is phenomenal, but focused one heart at a time rather than building a mega church.

name: Thanh Le Church - Stanton Campus
reviewSummary:
This church has both Vietnamese and English-speaking congregations, which creates a welcoming and diverse community. It became my home church after I married my husband, and I feel incredibly blessed to be part of it. The love, biblical truth, and genuine care demonstrated by the pastors, elders, and members are evident in every interaction, regardless of age or stage of life.

The church offers many small groups for Bible study and fellowship, as well as opportunities to participate in local and international mission trips. One thing that I don't often see at other churches is the SALT program (1:1 discipleship), which has been beneficial for my spiritual growth and walk with God. A church that preaches the truth of God’s Word with love. The community is welcoming, genuine, and truly feels like family. A place to grow in faith and fellowship! Great place for gathering for worship.

name: The Bethel Church - Jacksonville (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary:
It was a great first time experience. And you can tell the spirit, was there. I would definitely return. My cousins homegoing celebration was held here recently, as well as my late Aunts over a year ago. All I can say is "Won't he do it! Amen
Great place to worship with a warm loving and friendly atmosphere from beginning to end. You will definitely get biblical teachings and a powerful word from God, every time. And that's the Bethel Experience. I love so much your preaching and teaching the words of God. It's helpful for all congregation. Great service! The word of God is preached. Large sanctuary with a balcony. Ushers are available to assist you in finding a seat. The parking area is large,  Children church is available.  A separate teen service is also available.  Many ministries are available, from outreach to grief.

name: The Cathedral of the Assumption - Main Campus
The Church at Channelside - Tampa (Downtown) Campus
reviewSummary: What a special experience  I had at this place last Sunday. HOLY SPIRIT filled Church  no doubt. Preaching straight out the Bible word for word and from the heart. Couldnt have asked for a better home Church to be apart of. Don't get me started with the outreach work in the community their doing too . A Spirit filled woman named Lily is a big part in uplifting the needing in the area. I can't wait to roll up my sleeves and make a difference with them . Made me feel a piece of Heaven and the Worship 🎶 Music got me pulled closer to our Heavenly FATHER. Can't wait to go again next Sunday !! What a beautiful Church!! We were in Tampa during Easter (Did not realize it was so early this year - we are from Ohio) and we were looking for a Christian (Christ) based church.  Holy Cow!  We found the Church at Channelside in the Embassy Suites across from our hotel.  What a welcoming group of Christian brothers and sisters - young, mid-life, and old.  The message was all about Christ, in this case, about Peter and his take on the resurrection before and after.  What was really great was how at the start, a young woman explained to everyone, in simple terms what Easter and the resurrection as about.  The pastor gave a great sermon that really showed, through the eyes of Peter, how we are forgiven.  I cannot say enough about this wonderful group of believers and the Holy Spirit working through them to deliver the message.  Thank you, Church of Channelside, for delivering God's word on this day of our Savior's rising. Your praise team sang the song "Jesus paid it all" and I will finish with these lyrics that they sang:  "Oh praise the one who paid my debt. And praise this life up from the dead".  May God continue to bless this community of believers. When I moved to Tampa a few months ago, I really wanted to find a church that was easy to connect with and passionate about serving the community in impactful ways. From the start, this church welcomed me beyond what I expected. It was an instant genuine sense of home. Building relationships here has never felt like work, because everyone is actively and selflessly investing in each others’ lives. Growing with this church has been an incredible blessing. This is an amazing new church right in the heart of Channelside. I've had the opportunity to sit down with the pastor and leadership team of this church and they are an incredibly genuine and welcoming bunch. In addition to being a church that is focused on biblical values and teaching, I've also admired the many ways that I've seen members of this church out and about serving the community - from street cleanups to port support for tired and weary crew members, and everything in-between, this church really cares about our city and it shows! The Church at Channelside is truly such a special part of Tampa for me. Pastor John, his wife Shea, and all of the members at TCAC do a phenomenal job of fostering community. One thing I really love about the church is how they truly meet everyone where they are at. From the Alpha class that is geared towards new believers or non-believers with questions about faith to church membership and the CORE team for devoted Christian members who want to volunteer their time serving the community and the church family. I have found so much love and peach at the Church at Channelside! It is also right in the heart of the channelside area/Downtown Tampa, making it very easily accessible and walkable.

name: The Church By The Sea - Fort Lauderdale Campus
reviewSummary:
My sister and I parked here for Tortuga 2024 all weekend, this is truly an amazing group. Firstly, I called in advance and they were extremely accommodating in allowing me to book parking in advance. Pastor Marie was very responsive & super helpful. The group working the parking lot all weekend was super cheerful & just a pleasure to be around. On our final day, there was a gentleman in the parking lot (I can’t remember his name, so bad with names I’m sorry) who was informing people who were departing that their bathrooms were open for us. This was such a kind and thoughtful gesture. On our way out, my sister asked that he pray with us for a safe drive back home (we’re from out of town). We prayed together & he wished us well. For context, Tortuga is a music festival notorious for good drinks, great food & an even better party. That being said, they could’ve easily been judgy and stuffy with us, as I know many other churches would have been. Our experience here was impactful in a such a positive way and I just wanted to share. If I’m ever in the area I would absolutely attend service. They made us feel like family & we will return every year. These are the kind of people you want to spend your money with as I just know they are the glue in their community. Thank you all & God Bless ❤️🙏🏻 Our family came to this area 3.5 years ago and did not have to go far to find a home at Church by the sea. This church is beyond welcoming, they are a ‘yes’ to anything this community needs.  Their involvement in outside projects exceeds the capacity we have in volunteers but it never stops them from getting involved, rallying whoever they can and they come through in full force.

Our personal experience has been so good I recommend it to anyone I know looking for a church family. The Pastor is such a good person and his love for all of us shines from the pulpit - he has an incredible sense of humor and brings light to a one hour sermon. His wife is an incredible leader, full of life, ready to serve, always listening to the needs of others and her smile,  kindness and generosity is boundless. The people are warm, welcoming and even if you happen to be one of those that wants to be under the radar - you can be! But moreover, if you are looking for a place to participate, volunteer, and lead - this is an incredible find. Most of all they receive everyone with openness and genuineness. This is a Christ- centered church that welcomes all denominations and lifestyles and their slogan — ‘where the less than perfect are more than welcome’ is tried and true to the culture.

Things to think about : church starts promptly at 10am. Parking can be tough when the snow birds are in town so get there early to find a space. There are two chapels and my favorite is not the main chapel but the side chapel on the right side of the main door. If you get there after 10, use the side chapel - not the main entrance so you can quietly come in and no one will notice 😉. There is a kids Sunday school and your child WILL make friends. Stay after church for a few minutes to fellowship in the courtyard- someone is always signed up to bring coffee and sweets and this is a great time to network or reconnect. We have been a part of this church for >6 years. We followed the pastor (who married us) here after he left the prior church we were affiliated with. Let me just tell you, it was best decision ever. Not only is this church like a family to us but it is truly a place to make you feel like "the less than perfect are more than welcome" (the church motto). Our children have grown up here. We are centered around God, children of God but supporters of each other. No judgment. No drama. Just wonderful people praising our Lord together. Uplifting eachother.  So happy to be part of this church. Wonderful church , people friendly, lovely and accepting of everyone.
The staff is stellar, inspirational and full of love, wisdom, kindness and compassion. They are also filled with the spirit and are very smart🙏🏻👍 You are more welcome than anywhere else

name: The Church Without Walls
reviewSummary: Led by Dr. Ralph Douglas West. A powerhouse of 'Expository' preaching within a high-energy, multicultural context. Deeply committed to community engagement.

name: The Cross Church - Pensacola Campus
reviewSummary: The Cross Church has excellent teaching and sound doctrine provided by the pastors. Very theologically rich music absorbed in Biblical truth. Family integration is also key in The Cross Church as the elders encourage families to practice family worship weekly. There are also parenting seminars, men’s internships, men’s and boys gatherings, women’s prayer groups, women’s Bible studies, and youth events. For youth events, the goal is for the entire church to be bringing up the youth in the ways of the Lord and is not merely for the youth to have “fun” though that does happen as well. There are “city group” Bible studies most evenings throughout the week which are dispersed around the city. City group leaders conduct a gospel catechism with the rest of the group and then discuss in-depth the sermon preached from that Sunday. If you are looking to grow as a Christian and become more like Christ, please give The Cross Church a chance! Reformed baptistic, the pastors/elders are John-Mark and Kent, and both are good teachers. The layout and content of the service is very purposeful and gospel centered, and the preaching of the word is well laid out and central to the service. We take the Lord's Supper every week as a good reminder and good accountability. They have catechism for children, nursery for young ones, and early prayer for adults. Very sound teaching, and a great place to bring unbelievers who are in need of the gospel message, which is shared each week. My family moved to Pensacola specifically to attend The Cross. We had listened to the sermons online for over a year before deciding it was the right church for us. The preaching is unashamedly Bible truth and spoken with grace and a true love for the body; the doctrine is solid reformed theology; the pastors strive for excellence, are approachable, genuine, and loving members of the body; the people genuinely care for one another and are welcoming; the music is biblically based; the Lord’s Supper is taken weekly; small groups place an emphasis on sound teaching and Christian fellowship; membership is taken seriously; the atmosphere is one of true family worship. We have grown exponentially since coming to The Cross and are so thankful for it! At The Cross, there’s a genuine love for The Lord. There is right teaching, worship, and love for one another rooted in scripture. The pastors and people are genuine and intentional in your life and truly want to experience God in greater ways, and live out the gospel together. Even going through challenging or difficult times, the love shown towards me and countless others through the years was incredible. The Cross Church is a body of believers whose utmost desire is to glorify Christ. Christ and his gospel are preeminent in every service and small group meeting, and the members spur one another on to love and good works. This church has pastoral elders who shepherd their sheep well and expound with excellence the word of God.

name: The Harvest - Sarasota Campus
reviewSummary: My husband and I were ready to give up on church altogether when we stumbled upon Harvest a little over a year ago. This isn't even really a church. It is a ministry and a family, with a church attached. You know that your tithe money is going to be used to love and help the community rather than on expensive lighting rigs or something like that. And Pastor Dan's messages are challenging and new. NEVER "listen to me 'cause I am the pastor" and ALWAYS "here is a new and different way to think about this topic, decide if it is right for you." Questions are welcome! Broken people are welcome! And DIVERSITY is welcomed including LGBTQ+! If you are sick and tired of the typical toxic evangelical church presentation, then please visit Harvest. I think you will find it to be a breath of fresh air just like we did. Harvest House provides supportive community services to the homeless, veterans and families in need of housing support. Church service on Sunday at 10. I went two Sundays in a row while on vacation and it was a wonderful experience. Dan's sermons were spirited and genuine, and the church is very loud about loving people the way Jesus would (and does) --- something that made us feel welcome immediately. The music here is beautiful and powerful, too! I was moved to tears each weekend. Great job to those singers and musicians! Thanks for the expired food it was a waste of time waiting in line I threw it all in the trash seems like all you guys are trying to do is poison people with expired food instead of trying and help them I hope the wrath of God comes down on your church This church is not like any other you will ever attend. The minute you walk in, you feel a warm welcome. Pastor Dan is amazing. Not only does he play guitar with the awesome band of many, (and he can sing), but his messages are heartfelt, real, and thought provoking. This church helps our community right here in Sarasota! There are many opportunities to meet nice caring people with several weekly functions/outings throughout each month. Come with an open mind and experience this for yourself, this just could be your church home as it unexpectedly became mine!

name: The Hills Church
reviewSummary: Praise for its 'Mission' focus and 'Practical' application series. Originating from a Church of Christ heritage, it strikes a balance that appeals to a broad non-denominational audience.

name: The Journey Church - Boca Raton - Boca Raton Campus
reviewSummary:
A great church, filled with amazing people. I have been coming to the journey church for about a year and took the membership class today. The pastor is great, easy to listen to and interesting when he talks about the Bible. Update: Church just moved to a permanent building right on Boca Raton Blvd, beautiful sanctuary and kids space.

I could go on and on about how great this church is and how much they care about your spiritual growth but I'll just let my five star review speak for itself.  The clergy and the members all seem to really care.  You'll never feel awkward or unwelcome.  Dress casual.  Come with an open heart.  Great kids program too.

Update: was at the grand opening of their new patio and outdoor baptistry. Witnessed 10+ adults baptized with incredible stories and a brief message from the pastor. The outdoor cross and space is calming and inspirational.

Update: just attended Christmas Eve candlelight and it was excellent. Packed house but ushers and greeters made it easy and comfortable. Easy parking. Clean bathrooms. Hot chocolate. Great music and message. See pics. I absolutely love the journey church. Very welcoming and it has helped me deepen my relationship with God. Always a resonating message I can relate to that helps me become a better Christian. Amazing place and just what we needed. My wife was raised Orthodox and I was raised Catholic, so having this Church to learn and grow our Faith together is amazing. name: The Rock Church Fort Myers - Fort Myers Campus
reviewSummary:
I remember the first time I walked through the doors, from the moment I arrived, I felt the presence of God. Everyone was welcoming, genuine, and inviting.
Eight years later, that feeling remains the same. There is a sweet presence of God here, and it truly feels like home. There is no place I would rather be.
I have built lifelong friendships and experienced tremendous spiritual growth in this wonderful church. The pastor and his wife are truly exceptional people whose love, leadership, and dedication are a blessing to so many.
I am deeply humbled and grateful that God led my family and me here. This church has been an incredible part of our journey, and I wholeheartedly recommend it to anyone looking for a place to grow in faith and be part of a loving church family. I attended this church for over 3 years and initially loved the music and energy, but over time my experience changed. I began to feel that acceptance depended on conforming to leadership rules, giving money through tithes, and giving money for special leadership lavish gifts, overworking in ministry, and never questioning anything or showing tiredness.

While volunteering in a particular ministry, everything felt last minute and if it didn't fit my schedule then I was told I was not being flexible enough. When I decided to stop volunteering in that ministry, it was demanded that I have a meeting to get permission to stop volunteering. When I started setting healthy boundaries and asking questions, it felt I was labeled as having a “rebellious spirit” and it felt I was treated as if I was "backsliding". If I missed one service, I received texts from leadership and other nosey folks asking why I was not there.

The preaching often felt aggressive with yelling and felt very repetitive, and services seemed very production-driven with a strong focus on emotional reactions manipulated by music. My kids and I also experienced judgment and elitism, where it felt like certain families or people in the “inner circle” were treated very differently, like royalty. I felt judged constantly, whether it was something I was wearing, something I was doing or not doing, something my kids were doing or not doing, or when I'd speak up, etc.

What troubled me most was seeing leadership living very lavish lifestyles while some members, including myself, were struggling financially to support the family. I appreciate transparency with where tithes are allocated but I never seen this once while attending/giving here.

Unfortunately, I never felt the genuine love, support, or healthy community that a church environment should provide. My experience here was disappointing, hurtful, and ultimately led me to leave. I went to the rock for the first time these past Sunday with my 11-year-old daughter who almost lost her life last week. No doubt about it she was saved by our Lord Jesus Christ. I had so many proof of it. At the church, I had an experience like no other, kids running happily, the beautiful choir, making everybody jump and down in absolute joy, and the pastor was something else! I’m going back and then back and then back some more. I’m going to get baptized in this church and will baptize my daughter. The energy at this holy place is extraordinary. The people are beyond friendly and welcoming. A life changing experience! Such an amazing church. This has been my church for the last 6 years. I moved across the country and found a place that I know I could truly call home. So thankful for the Godly atmosphere and love that is in this place. Raising a family here is such a blessing, knowing my children will be surrounded by good Godly people is a huge deal. Highly recommend if you’re looking for a home church for you and/or your family. This is the place to come and be apart! What a church. TRC is truly a blessing and I thank God for the Bishop and the members. When I first came to the church in 2020. My mother and I were in a dark place. Our family had been trying to survive the devastating murder of my brother so we moved from Broward county to Lee County. God brought me to TRC using a instagram reel of the choir singing and I had ran to so my mom. She saw her coworker up in the choir and said that’s the church my coworker told me about. We immediately loved the church in our first visit. people tend to go to church to meet their own expectations or experience. But when I tell you that the spirit of the Lord is in this church I mean it. My story and testimony is long for this section. But I would compel anyone to visit just once and leave your expectations and what you think church should be and come with an open heart and trust me you will see God move like never before. Come experience the difference.

name: United Church of Gainesville - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary:
If you love the vibe of Gainesville then you'll love the vibe of UCG. It's a place to find community founded on joy & love. A Spiritual place for anyone disappointed by the dogma of traditional religions. Truly a place of "God, however known." A place for all religions and Buddhism, atheism, and agnosticism. I reached out to the church I attended as a child seeking guidance and resources during a difficult time. I hope that in the future, programs could be made available to help community members who have nowhere else to turn. Non-denominational support like this is rare and deeply needed. I was seeking assistance for immediate survival needs, but was referred elsewhere. A perfect church for anyone who wants the social & community benefits of a church without the heavy doctrine and fire & brimstone of regular churches. Sure, there are prayers during the service but without the "leave it all to god" hopelessness. Rather, prayer is to boost our own strength, resilience, and compassion. UCG treats Jesus more as a god inspired teacher to follow rather than an all powerful deity who will fix all your problems if you pray well enough. Unlike and much better than any doctrine infused church I have attended.
Also, of note, UCG is open & welcoming regardless of any label you have, like gay, trans, queer, or your race, gender, or age.
(I'm new to UCG and will soon start the membership process.) Wonderful place to find spiritual fulfillment regardless of your personal beliefs. I am agnostic -- neither religious or atheist -- and made some great friends here. They do not discriminate based on gender or sexual expression. The youth group is well-run. Most of all, they practice the teachings of Jesus in the way they were intended -- with love and acceptance. UCoG offers a joyous, open-hearted and creative celebration as a thriving Christian community. The welcome here is authentic and intelligent, socially conscious and inclusive. I am new here, but delighted to say I have not missed a Sunday since the first time I came.

name: Victory Church - Boca Raton Campus
reviewSummary:
Hi! I started going to Victory mainly for youth on Wednesdays after a friend recommended I try it. I hadn’t really been attending church and was hopeful this would be a positive experience. Unfortunately, from the moment I walked in, the environment felt noticeably judgmental and uncomfortable. We were split into groups and talked for a bit, and afterward I opened up slightly to the main worship leader. At first, she appeared kind and trustworthy, which made me feel comfortable enough to share, but looking back, that assumption was clearly misplaced. I struggle with anxiety, so opening up was already a challenge. Instead of receiving support or guidance, I was met with passive-aggressive responses and unnecessary snarky comments. I was simply talking about school and things I was going through, yet somehow left feeling out of place and uncomfortable. Later, I found out that what I shared had been discussed with other people in the church, which was especially hurtful—considering it was one of my first times opening up to someone in that setting. A church should feel welcoming and safe, and this experience was anything but that. When you are in a leadership position, sharing someone’s personal information should not be optional or based on convenience; unless someone is in danger, those conversations should remain private. Unfortunately, this situation felt far more like gossip than genuine care. I also expressed interest in joining the worship team, as I have a strong passion for singing and growing closer to God. I went through the audition process with the same leader and submitted a singing video as instructed. Weeks passed, and I continued to feel uncomfortable walking into the church, only to never hear back at all. The lack of follow-up or communication felt unprofessional and dismissive. The people are what make up a church, and unfortunately, a small group of individuals managed to overshadow what could have been a meaningful experience. Being in a “godly” environment should not feel like walking into a space filled with gossip and judgment—especially when those who claim to worship God are the ones participating in it. sadly, I’ve since spoken to several others who shared similar experiences with this same leader, including favoritism, bias, poor communication, and sharing personal information. (this is not only with one person, it’s with multiple people)
While the preaching and vocals were good, the overall environment was unhealthy and took a toll on my mental health. Because of that, I would not return, and I would not recommend you go/ send your child to this church.

name: Vida Springs Church - Gainesville Campus
reviewSummary:
Vida Springs is a phenomenal church. I have been attending church here for several years now and I have been very thankful for the community that I've found. Vida Springs is a very warm and welcoming church that genuinely has a heart for people. I moved here for college and quickly found my best friends upon attending this church.

At Vida the Sunday morning talks are centered around biblical passages and the message of Jesus Christ is always preached. The leadership here is extremely humble and always growing, challenging, and loving the community.

This church genuinely feels like a family that constantly looks to encourage, correct, and do life with each other. Vida Springs is amazing! Since my first day at Vida I have been able to experience a warm and welcoming atmosphere (specially as an international student that had just recently moved to the US). I inmediately felt like I belonged here and it's been so amazing to meet people from so many different cultures & ages. You can tell that they have a passionate heart for Jesus and that extrapolates in the way that they love and serve people and everyone is just so intentional :)

I also really appreciate how clear and Bible-based the teachings are (specially as someone whose first language is not english),  the humility displayed on the way that the Staff Pastors lead and the intentionality and care of the prayer ministry. name: Village Church of Irvine - Irvine Campus
reviewSummary:
My wife and I visited first outdoors during Covid and have made this our new church home. This is a place of authentic people seeking Jesus. We especially love the “family dinner” style first sundays of the month where you can have some great food and meet some new friends. I found the Village after several months of trying churches in Irvine and my family have been members now for over 3 years. The Village met all the Biblical criteria of a faithful bible teaching church. The authority of scripture is foundational. The Gospel is shared often. The leaders are hospitable, gracious, and humble. The church has great community groups all across orange county, where discipleship and spiritual growth take place. The Village believes in reformed theology, but they do not make secondary issues overly important. They give the congregation the room to disagree on secondary issues which allows for appropriate defense of primary issues.

If you are a follower of Christ, I highly recommend The Village Church in Irvine. On the very first Sunday we visited Village Church back in 2016, we were warmly greeted and even invited to join a community group. Nearly seven years later, we continue to be grateful every day being part of a local church that emphasizes biblical authority, gospel centrality, and community. I’ve been attending VCI for several years now, and I’ve grown tremendously in my faith here. I know so many people at this church who are real people with flaws, but who are growing because they are sincerely following Jesus and pursuing a relationship with Him. Come join us on a Sunday, and get plugged into a community group or Bible study so we can do life with you, too! We love Village Church of Irvine! Solid, Biblical teaching and training, great community, good serving opportunities, and a great kid ministry. We love being part of this church!

name: Vine Church Tampa - Tampa Palms Campus
reviewSummary:
As a follower of Christ for many years, I have had the joy of being a part of many fellowships. Last year I found Vine Church Tampa and was able to join them in worship and fellowship. I  highly recommend this church for anyone looking to grow in their faith and needing a welcoming community. This group of believers seeks to Glorify Christ in every aspect of their gathering. A family united in Christ, who gathers at the hotel-for now- every Sunday for 2 services (English and Spanish) to listen to the Holy word of God. A place to call home in the midst of this chaotic life. Welcoming family and sane doctrine preached on every encounter. We immediately felt welcomed at this church! The sermons are Bible focused and Christ centered. Community is genuine and friendly. Vine Church Tampa is a bilingual church, with one service in English and another in Spanish. Although there are two languages, the church is intentionally lived and feels like one family.

It is a church that is:

• Serious in its doctrine.

• Focused on Christ and Scripture.

• Intentionally supportive of community and its members.

This is a family of faith, a place to grow in Christ and His commission. Vine Church Tampa is a healthy church where you can find excellent biblical exposition of the Word, Jesus Christ-centered worship, and a fellowship that transcends the physical limits of a building.

name: Vineyard Covington - Covington Campus
reviewSummary: My family loves it here! So friendly and welcoming. This is a new building for the church but the church has been gathering for a few years elsewhere. It’s a great place to be! Warm and inviting place to worship Jesus! Wonderful church with wonderful people that are relatable, down to earth, and just what you need
